jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Product Marketing Manager – K-12 EdTech – RemoteRemote (U.
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Manager – K-12 EdTech – Remote

Remote (U.S.) · Up to $100K base · Reports to the Chief Marketing Officer · Own a portfolio, not just a content calendar

Shape how schools understand and adopt technology credited with helping save 2,400+ student lives. If you want to own products, not just market them, this is where your work moves adoption, pipeline, and revenue.

The role

You own product marketing for three of Securly's products: Securly Pass, Flex, and Classroom. You'll decide how they're positioned, launched, sold, and adopted. You'll translate product capabilities into narratives school leaders care about, give Sales and Customer Success what they need to win, and make sure every launch is grounded in real customer needs.

You'll be the link between Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success. You report to the Chief Marketing Officer and work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Demand Generation, Creative, and executive leadership.

You'll own:

  • Product marketing strategy for Pass, Flex, and Classroom
  • End-to-end go-to-market planning and execution for new products, features, and releases
  • Differentiated positioning and messaging for school administrators and education leaders
  • Sales enablement that helps Sales and Customer Success communicate value, differentiate Securly, and win
  • Customer insight, win-loss, and competitive intelligence that shape both marketing and product decisions
  • Repeatable launch and enablement processes, built in partnership with Demand Generation

What success looks like

You'll get a structured onboarding with clear priorities. The milestones below show what the work typically looks like as you build up.

Timeframe

What you'll be doing

First 90 days

Learn Securly's products, customers, competitors, and go-to-market model, and build trusted relationships across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. Assess current positioning, messaging, enablement, and launch processes. Join active launch planning, refresh messaging for at least one product, begin customer interviews and competitive research, and deliver initial sales enablement the revenue team actually uses.

By the 6-month mark

Own go-to-market execution for your products and launch multiple features or product initiatives. Strengthen competitive intelligence and sales enablement, build repeatable launch playbooks, and contribute to stronger campaign performance.

12 months

Be the recognized product marketing expert for Pass, Flex, and Classroom. Show a measurable contribution to product adoption, pipeline, and commercial success. Run a steady customer research and market intelligence cadence, and use it to influence roadmap discussions.

Milestones are typical examples, not fixed requirements. Specific goals are set by your manager and may change based on business needs.

Who we're looking for

You'll likely bring:

  • 2+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience
  • Experience launching software products or meaningful product features
  • A track record of positioning, messaging, and enablement that revenue teams actually use
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management and Sales
  • Experience using customer research and market insight to influence decisions
  • EdTech or K-12 experience is helpful but not required

What you'll bring:

  • Ownership: you think like an owner and are energized by bringing meaningful products to market
  • Strategy and execution: you can set direction and also roll up your sleeves to ship it
  • Cross-functional leadership: you drive multiple initiatives and influence without relying on authority
  • Clear writing: you simplify complex ideas into messages people remember
  • Curiosity: you want to understand customers, markets, and competitors
  • AI fluency: you use AI and modern tools to move faster without lowering the bar on judgment and quality

A realistic look at the job

This is not a role about producing a high volume of marketing assets. Success isn't measured by how much you create. It's measured by product adoption, launch execution, sales effectiveness, and commercial results. Some weeks you'll be deep in a launch, coordinating Product, Sales, and Creative. Other weeks you'll be interviewing customers, studying competitors, or rebuilding a pitch so reps can win more often. It's a fast-moving, collaborative environment, and the role carries real visibility, including with executive leadership.

The role is fully remote. Candidates must currently reside in the United States. Securly will not sponsor a visa for this role, at the time of hire or in the future, including for candidates on OPT/CPT status.

Where this role leads

This is an ownership role, not a support function. You'll have a meaningful product portfolio, visibility across Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership, and a direct hand in how Securly positions, launches, and grows its products. You can make a measurable contribution in your first year, and that work builds the track record for broader portfolio and product marketing leadership.

Compensation and benefits

  • Up to $100,000 base salary
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO plus a paid year-end shutdown
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Free 24/7 confidential mental health counseling and wellness tools
  • $1,000 annual learning stipend
  • Structured onboarding, coaching, and career growth opportunities

About Securly

Securly is a leader in AI-powered student safety, wellness, and engagement, trusted by 20M+ students across 20,000+ schools. Since launching the first cloud-based K-12 web filter in 2013, we've combined AI and human insight to help schools spot and respond to bullying, self-harm, and violence. We're named one of TIME's America's Top EdTech Companies 2026, a GSV 150 honoree, and an EdTech Top 40 "Most Used Product."

Our people-first culture shows in the numbers (Source: Securly Qualtrics Employee Survey; WSA Global Benchmark):

  • 82% employee engagement, vs. a 73% global benchmark
  • 94% of employees are proud to work here
  • 91% rate manager effectiveness above benchmark

How to apply

Applications close oct 9th 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
Australia Wide, Work from Home | Full-time | Permanent WFH

Job code: S21198AU

Before you read any further, answer these five questions honestly.

──────────────────────────────────────────

Q1. Do you have a strong track record in inside sales, telesales or phone-based account management?

YES - You have done this before and your numbers back you up. You know how to build relationships over the phone and you are proud of what you have delivered.

NO - If you are new to phone-based sales this role will be a stretch. We need someone who can hit the ground running from a home office from day one.

──────────────────────────────────────────

Q2. Can you manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through to close, completely from home?

YES - You know how to run your own pipeline and manage your day without someone standing over you. You do not need to be micro-managed to perform. You have the structure and discipline to get results from home and you have proved it before.

NO - If you need an office environment or a manager close by to stay on track, this probably is not the right fit. This role is built for people who thrive independently.

──────────────────────────────────────────

Q3. Does a total package of $95.8K with a guaranteed 50% OTE for your first three months work for you?

YES - Your secured package is base $65K plus 12% super $7.8K plus $23K OTE. The first three months come with a guaranteed 50% OTE so you can settle in without financial pressure. After that your effort drives your income.

NO - If you need a higher base to commit, we understand. This role rewards performance, not tenure.

──────────────────────────────────────────

Q4. Are you genuinely comfortable building rapport and trust entirely over the phone and video?

YES - You are not relying on body language or in-person chemistry. You know how to make a real connection in the first 30 seconds of a call and keep clients coming back.

NO - If you find phone-only relationship building difficult, a field-based role like our BDM or Sales Account Manager positions may be a better fit.

──────────────────────────────────────────

Q5. Do you live regionally, rurally or face a long commute that is eating into your day?

YES - This role was built for exactly that situation. Permanent WFH, no office, no commute, and a career with a genuinely growing business. Your location is not a barrier here, it is irrelevant.

NO - Not regional? No problem. This role is open to anyone in Australia who meets the brief. The WFH setup works wherever you are.

──────────────────────────────────────────

Still reading? Good. Here is everything you need to know.

──────────────────────────────────────────

ABOUT THRYV

Thryv has been helping local businesses compete for over 125 years, from print directories to an AI-powered platform built to grow small businesses through digital marketing. The businesses we work with are the plumber trying to get found on Google, the salon owner who never has time to follow up, the family restaurant competing against chains with bigger budgets.

We give them the tools to compete. And we give the people who work here a career worth having. Our culture runs on accountability, genuine relationships and doing the right thing. We take ownership, back each other and when it goes well, we celebrate it properly.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Be part of the growth story

Thryv is in a major growth phase across Australia and New Zealand, with 36 roles currently open and a further 40 to 50 positions coming. The Inside Sales team is at the heart of that growth. This is not a role you join and wait for things to happen. You are joining at exactly the right moment, with real opportunity to grow with the business as it scales.

This is a permanent, full-time work-from-home role. You are not expected in an office. You are not tied to a capital city. Whether you are in regional Victoria, rural Queensland, a coastal town or a suburb with a long commute, if you have a strong sales and account management background and a good internet connection, this role works for you.

You will manage the full sales cycle over the phone and video, reaching out to existing Thryv customers and new prospects, growing accounts, closing deals and hitting monthly targets. You will have the structure of a high-performing team behind you with the autonomy to manage your day from your own space.

Already doing great account management work but spending two hours a day in the car? This role was built for you.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Making outbound and inbound calls to existing Thryv customers and new prospects to grow and retain accounts
  • Managing the full sales cycle from first contact and qualification through to close and onboarding handover
  • Upselling and cross-selling relevant Thryv digital marketing solutions to an existing customer portfolio
  • Hitting monthly sales targets and contact centre KPIs consistently
  • Maintaining accurate pipeline records and reporting results to your Account Director
  • Collaborating with internal teams to ensure a smooth experience for new clients
  • Staying sharp on Thryv product updates and what is happening in the SMB market

YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF...

  • You have a proven track record in account management, inside sales or telesales and your numbers back it up
  • You have managed the full sales cycle before, from prospecting and qualifying through to close
  • You build genuine rapport over the phone, clients trust you and look forward to your calls
  • You are highly self-motivated and thrive working independently from home without being managed
  • You are organised, disciplined and know how to manage a pipeline and hit targets consistently
  • You live regionally, rurally or face a long commute and want a permanent WFH role that plays to your strengths
  • You understand the SMB market and can speak to business owners plainly about tools that help them

WHAT'S ON OFFER

Total package $95.8K at OTE

Base $65K + 12% super $7.8K + $23K OTE

50% OTE guaranteed for your first three months. Targets are real and attainable.

Performance pays here. The harder you work, the more you earn.

  • Genuinely permanent WFH: No office, no commute, no compromise, wherever you are in Australia
  • Be part of the growth story: 36 roles open now with 40 to 50 more coming, join at the right moment
  • Purpose with every call: Real solutions for real businesses, you will believe in what you are selling
  • Performance pays: Your effort drives your income, the harder you work the more you earn
  • Career pathways: Thryv is growing fast and promoting from within, your timing is right
  • A team behind you: Full structure, coaching and support even when you are working from home

RECRUITMENT TIMELINE

We recruit on a rolling basis, with strong candidates shortlisted and interviewed as applications come in.

Next IST commencement: Monday 9 November 2026, our final intake for 2026. Spots are limited and this is your last chance to start with us this year, so if you're ready, don't wait to apply.

Following intake: February/March 2027 (dates to be confirmed).

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

If your application is progressed you will receive an invitation to complete a HireVue video interview. Keep an eye on your inbox as you will have 24 hours to complete it once the link is sent. It is three questions, two minutes each, and it is your chance to show us who you are before we meet.

──────────────────────────────────────────

Ready to be part of the growth story?

Apply now, we are moving fast and so should you.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 257990

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Leads and oversees Virtual Workspace Engineering as an end-to-end product and engineering function, accountable for the strategy, architecture, engineering, operational stability, and continuous evolution of the Bank’s virtual workspace platforms. The role owns both the current service landscape and the future transformation roadmap, ensuring reliable, secure, scalable, and user-centric delivery across enterprise virtual workspace services.

This leader is accountable for the present and future of the virtual workspace domain, including Citrix, virtual desktop and application delivery, Omnissa Horizon, and the strategic evolution toward Windows 365 Cloud PC. The role combines director-level leadership, product ownership, and senior principal engineering depth to simplify the environment, modernize the platform, improve service resilience, and translate technology investments into business outcomes.

Ensures all activities are conducted in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies, standards, and procedures.

Acts as the senior leader for a complex enterprise virtual workspace product domain that must simultaneously run, improve, and transform. The role defines the product vision, engineering direction, and service operating model for virtual workspace technologies across the Bank, balancing user experience, resilience, simplification, security, operational control, and cost discipline.

The incumbent serves as the senior technical authority and business-facing product leader for the domain, shaping priorities, investment choices, architecture patterns, engineering standards, operational processes, and modernization roadmaps.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:
• Leads and oversees the Virtual Workspace Engineering function, ensuring strategic alignment, strong service ownership, and execution against business and technology priorities.
• Owns the product strategy and engineering roadmap for the virtual workspace domain across current and future platforms, including Citrix, Omnissa Horizon, virtual desktop and application delivery, and Windows 365 Cloud PC. Ensures the roadmap balances business demand, engineering feasibility, risk, operational readiness, supportability, and long-term simplification.
• Acts as the most senior technical leader in the domain, providing deep expertise across architecture, systems design, engineering, automation, service operations, and platform optimization. Leads complex design decisions across networking, latency, geographic distribution, resiliency, capacity, security, compliance, identity, and endpoint integration.
• Owns operational stability and service excellence for the live environment, including availability, performance, supportability, incident response, root-cause analysis, problem management, lifecycle management, and permanent corrective actions.
• Defines and drives simplification of the virtual workspace ecosystem by rationalizing complexity, improving operational efficiency, reducing platform sprawl where appropriate, and standardizing engineering and service patterns.
• Champions modernization and innovation through product thinking, proofs of concept, proofs of value, and disciplined execution. Leads the transition toward modern cloud-based virtual workspace capabilities, including Windows 365 Cloud PC, while ensuring coexistence and sound operational governance across legacy and strategic platforms.
• Translates business priorities into a clear product backlog and engineering execution plan, partnering with stakeholders across infrastructure, security, architecture, operations, support, and lines of business. Ensures technology direction is tied to measurable business outcomes, service quality, risk reduction, and user experience improvements.
• Defines target architecture, reference patterns, engineering standards, automation, and operational controls for the domain. Ensures solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and documented, and that knowledge is embedded into the organization rather than concentrated in individuals.
• Builds and leads a high-performing, inclusive, and globally distributed team through strong leadership, talent development, coaching, succession planning, and clarity of accountability.
• Drives strong governance, risk management, and control discipline across the domain, embedding security, resilience, compliance, and operational risk awareness into daily decision-making.
• Serves as a senior escalation point and trusted advisor for complex platform, architecture, operational, and transformation issues. Engages effectively with executive stakeholders, engineering leaders, vendors, and cross-functional partners to influence outcomes, align decisions, and drive delivery

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Extensive progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, Enterprise Platforms, end user compute, virtual workspace engineering, or adjacent platform engineering environments, including significant experience leading complex engineering and operational functions in large-scale enterprises.
• Strong people leadership experience, including leading managers and globally distributed teams, building high-performing organizations, and driving accountability across engineering and operations.
• Deep expertise in virtual workspace and end user computing technologies, including strong experience with Citrix, virtual desktops and application delivery, Omnissa Horizon, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, identity and access patterns, and operational tooling relevant to platform performance and observability.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, systems design, resiliency, security, network dependencies, capacity considerations, automation, and service operations.
• Hands-on technical credibility with automation, scripting, and engineering problem solving; ability to engage deeply in design and troubleshooting while operating effectively at leadership level.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate highly complex concepts into clear direction for executives, peers, customers, and technical teams.
• High proficiency in English is required. Spanish is considered an asset for global collaboration.
• Relevant certifications are an asset, particularly in Citrix, Horizon, Microsoft 365, Endpoint Management Intune, Security, Entra ID, and Azure.

What's in it for you?
• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
• Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
• Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
• Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
• Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, cooking with friends, Humans of Digital and much more!

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.excerpt: Job Type: FTE Level: Mid to Senior Department: AI Transformation Group Location: Remote (US or Canada) Rate: $115,000 to $140,000 USD (rates vary in Canada) Position Overview Cyclotron's AI Transformation Group is hiring an AI & Data Governance Consultant to help enterprise clients govern AI and agents across the Microsoft estate.
jobs.description:
Job Type: FTE
Level: Mid to Senior
Department: AI Transformation Group
Location: Remote (US or Canada)
Rate: $115,000 to $140,000 USD (rates vary in Canada)

Position Overview
Cyclotron's AI Transformation Group is hiring an AI & Data Governance Consultant to help enterprise clients govern AI and agents across the Microsoft estate. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with a broad remit: your center of gravity is AI and agent governance and data governance, with solid working skills in Power Platform and platform and workload governance. You will configure Copilot Studio and agent guardrails, build Purview controls that make Copilot safe to scale, run intake and lifecycle processes, and produce the frameworks and playbooks our clients operate from. You will work alongside a Sr. AI Governance Consultant on larger programs and own workstreams end to end on smaller ones. The right person has implemented governance in real tenants, is starting to design it, and wants to grow into leading engagements.

Responsibilities
AI & Agent Governance
  • Implement agent lifecycle governance across Agent Builder, SharePoint agents, Copilot Studio, and Copilot connectors: intake forms and routing, maker access and publishing models, ownership change processes, monitoring, and retirement.
  • Configure Copilot Studio-specific DLP and connector policy (event triggers, channels, knowledge sources, HTTP requests, Graph and federated connectors) and credit consumption caps.
  • Support Agent 365 governance: agent inventory, identity, policy, and audit alongside Defender, Purview, and Entra ID.
  • Build AI CoE operating artifacts: roles and responsibilities, monitoring cadences, Agent Insights reporting, and review and escalation workflows.
  • Contribute to AI Opportunity Labs: AI solution and agent inventory, risk and security gap analysis, and governance maturity scoring.
Data Governance
  • Configure Microsoft Purview for AI readiness: sensitivity labels, DLP, information protection, retention, audit, and DSPM for AI.
  • Perform data estate and oversharing assessments across SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams, and recommend remediation before Copilot and agents go broad.
  • Support catalog, classification, lineage, and data ownership work in Purview and Fabric, and govern Dataverse data used by apps and agents.
Power Platform & Platform Governance
  • Configure environments, environment groups, managed environments, and security group and role assignments; validate DLP impact on existing resources.
  • Implement ALM processes with Power Platform Pipelines or Azure DevOps, including approval gates and end-to-end test deployments.
  • Deploy and report from the CoE Starter Kit and Copilot Studio Starter Kit.
  • Apply Microsoft 365 and Azure governance fundamentals where they touch AI: external sharing, retention, Azure Policy, and RBAC.
Client Engagement & Communication
  • Act as a trusted advisor to client administrators, platform owners, and security teams; explain governance trade-offs clearly.
  • Co-lead governance workshops, discovery sessions, and knowledge transfer; deliver instructor-led training on Copilot Studio governance when needed.
  • Contribute to deliverables: governance frameworks, intake and lifecycle playbooks, runbooks, validation summaries, and decision logs.

Qualifications
  • 4+ years of enterprise Microsoft platform experience, with 2+ years hands-on in Copilot, Copilot Studio, Purview, or Power Platform governance or administration.
  • Hands-on Copilot Studio experience, including agent publishing, security settings, knowledge sources, connectors, and how agents interact with Microsoft 365.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Purview experience: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, and audit, ideally applied to Copilot or agent scenarios.
  • Working Power Platform governance experience: environment strategy, DLP, managed environments, and PPAC administration.
  • Solid understanding of Entra ID, least privilege, conditional access, and RBAC as they apply to AI and data controls.
  • Evidence of implementing governance in production tenants, with some exposure to designing or recommending the approach.
  • Clear, confident client communication and strong emotional intelligence; you can hold your own with technical leads and brief executives with support.
  • Able to work remotely within the United States or Canada with reliable overlap for Eastern and Central business hours.
Governance-fluent bar: we are looking for someone visibly engaged with how Microsoft AI, data, and automation platforms are governed at enterprise scale. You don't need to check every box below, but the majority should feel like a clear “yes,” and you should be ready to walk us through the relevant ones in a portfolio review:
  • You have configured Copilot Studio or Agent Builder governance controls in a real tenant and can walk through the choices you made.
  • You have run an oversharing or data readiness assessment ahead of a Copilot or agent rollout.
  • You have supported an agent intake, approval, or CoE process that clients actually used.
  • You follow the release plans for Copilot Studio, Agent 365, and Purview and try features in preview.

Additional Knowledge & Skills
  • Microsoft Fabric and Dataverse-to-Fabric integration patterns.
  • Azure AI services: Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search, and content safety.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks such as NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001.
  • ServiceNow or ITSM-based intake and approval workflows.
  • Certifications such as SC-401, SC-900, PL-900, AB-100, or MS-102, or equivalent experience.
  • Consulting or professional services experience.
About the Company
Cyclotron is a Microsoft Solutions Partner focused on the modern workplace, data, and AI. We are dedicated to empowering clients to streamline operations and achieve their business goals. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive environment, encouraging continuous learning and professional growth for its employees. Cyclotron’s mission is to deliver reliable, forward-thinking technology solutions that drive success for clients across various industries.

What We Can Offer
Cyclotron offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well-being and professional growth in a fully remote work environment. We provide competitive health, dental, and vision insurance, and we cover 100% of employee medical premiums. Our team members benefit from generous and flexible paid time off (PTO), retirement plan options, and ongoing training opportunities. Additionally, Cyclotron promotes work-life balance with flexible work arrangements and robust wellness programs, creating a rewarding and supportive workplace for all.

Cyclotron relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees to join our team, regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.
We also provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law.

Cyclotron is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Cyclotron values diversity, equity and inclusion, and aims to practice DE&I in all that we do.

Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

This is a remote role based in Washington, DC

Why You’ll Love This Role

This is a people-first technical leadership role for someone who enjoys developing high-performing teams while staying close to the customer. You’ll lead and mentor the Solutions Engineering team supporting the Department of War (formerly DoD) and the Intelligence Community, setting clear standards for technical excellence, sales partnership, and execution. This team works in some of Cribl’s most complex and mission-critical environments – from enterprise SOCs to classified networks – alongside the channel and Federal Systems Integrator (FSI) partners who deliver with us.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape how pre-sales work gets done - reinforcing strong methodology, coaching consultative selling skills, and partnering closely with Sales leadership to drive meaningful revenue outcomes. You’ll balance strategy with hands-on leadership, supporting complex customer engagements while helping your team grow their technical depth and confidence.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will ...

  • Lead the Department of War and Intelligence Community (DoW/IC) Solutions Engineering team, reinforcing sales methodology and metrics-led best practices
  • Provide ongoing mentorship to SEs on pre-sales techniques for securing new clients and expanding within existing customers, across our full portfolio of solutions
  • Continually assess and develop the technical capabilities of each team member to ensure each SE reaches and maintains the required technical knowledge to perform their pre-sales duties effectively
  • Provide periodic performance reviews, assess skill sets, coach through performance and personnel matters, and create personal/professional development opportunities
  • Partner with the DoW and IC Regional Sales Directors and their Regional Sales Managers, aligning SE coverage, sales plays, and campaigns to achieve revenue targets
  • As the technical leader for DoW/IC, deliver customer presentations, present technical information about Cribl’s products and services, conduct product demonstrations, and oversee SE-led Proof of Value events, including in classified and air-gapped environments when required
  • Build and leverage relationships across the channel and Federal Systems Integrator (FSI) community, partnering with Cribl’s Partner SE and Alliances teams so partners can land and expand Cribl within DoW and IC programs
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard SEs as the team grows, building a bench of mission-aware technical talent in the National Capital Region
  • Stay current on the DoW/IC mission, budget, and acquisition landscape – contract vehicles, FedRAMP and DoD Impact Level authorizations, Zero Trust and federal logging mandates – and translate it into how the team positions Cribl
  • Identify problem areas, formulate relevant solutions, and execute on them effectively.
  • We are a remote-first company, and work happens across many time zones – you may be required to perform duties outside your standard working hours occasionally

If You Got It - We Want It

  • Proven track record of successfully leading a technical pre-sales team or region at a software company, driving target attainment against monthly, quarterly, and annual quota targets
  • Background of successfully landing and expanding deals within the Department of War (DoD) and the Intelligence Community, including working through the channel and Federal Systems Integrator (FSI) communities
  • Ability to teach SEs how to identify new and existing opportunities through consultative selling methodologies
  • Experience in understanding and executing sales plays with an SE team, specifically land and expand plays, and tailoring those plays to drive revenue in your segment
  • Ability to communicate effectively in presentations with executive-level customers, direct reports, and the Cribl Leadership Team
  • Experience building technical champions within customers and prospects, including fostering relationships with senior executives and government and military leadership
  • Proven self-starter with a motivated attitude to be able to manage multiple tasks, projects, and responsibilities simultaneously
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a pleasant and professional attitude towards your team, customers and co-workers
  • Working knowledge of the DoW/IC operating environment – classified and unclassified networks (e.g., NIPR, SIPR, JWICS), cross-domain considerations, FedRAMP and DoD Impact Level authorizations, and federal acquisition and budget cycles
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent AND a minimum of 5 years of experience in pre-sales, preferably in a leadership capacity
  • Ability to travel up to 30%
  • Strong preference will be given to candidates with a background in selling Security, Observability, and/or data pipeline solutions (e.g., SIEM, log management, telemetry) into DoW and IC customers.
  • Active or prior U.S. security clearance is a plus, but not required.
  • Residence in the DC/VA/MD area.

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

jobs.description:
Mayflower is a technology company building large-scale entertainment products for a global audience. Our platforms serve millions of users worldwide and rank among the top-50 most visited websites globally. For more than 10 years, we've been creating reliable, high-performance solutions at the intersection of product, engineering, and entertainment.

As a Content Writer, you'll play a key role in keeping our Support & Moderation knowledge accurate, accessible, and up to date. You'll create and maintain internal documentation, identify knowledge gaps, communicate important updates, and improve content based on feedback. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, is comfortable working with ambiguity, and uses AI responsibly to improve efficiency without compromising quality.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain hundreds of content items across Support and Moderation, including knowledge base articles, process documentation, macros, bot replies, announcements, and internal guides.

  • Write clear, simple content for different audiences: agents, moderators, and customers.

  • Turn complex processes and rules into easy-to-understand documentation.

  • Keep the knowledge base well-organised, up to date, and easy to navigate.

  • Follow content standards for structure, terminology, formatting, and tone of voice.

  • Review content regularly to remove outdated, duplicate, unclear, or missing information.

  • Gather requirements from stakeholders and create accurate content based on business needs.

  • Build and continuously improve the content creation and maintenance process across Support and Moderation.

  • Use stakeholders' feedback, QC results, and business changes to drive continuous improvement of content.

Requirements

You will thrive if you have…

Must-haves

  • Strong English writing skills (C1+).

  • Experience in content writing, copywriting, knowledge management, content design, or similar.

  • Experience with Confluence or similar knowledge-base/documentation tools.

  • Experience using AI tools for writing, rewriting, summarising, structuring information, and content quality checks.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high volumes of content and manage repetitive writing/editing tasks without losing quality.

  • Ability to adapt content for different audiences: support agents, moderation specialists, internal teams, and end customers.

  • Understanding of tone of voice and ability to adapt wording based on context, topic sensitivity, and audience.

  • Strong attention to detail, consistency, terminology, and structure.

  • Ability to organise information logically, identify duplicated, outdated, conflicting, unclear, or missing content, and maintain documentation so it is easy to find, use, and update.

  • Ability to maintain naming conventions, labels, page hierarchy, templates, and version control.

Mindset and working style

  • Fast, practical, and execution-focused.

  • Comfortable working with large volumes of information.

  • Detail-oriented, but not perfectionistic.

  • Able to create a good version quickly, test it in practice, and improve based on feedback.

  • Understands digital users, online communication, and live entertainment context.

  • Supports company and team values in the way content is written and maintained.

  • Motivated by clarity, consistency, and usability.

  • Comfortable working remotely with a high level of ownership, transparency, and self-organisation.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Zendesk, Slack, chatbot tools, macro tools, or support platforms is a plus.

  • Experience in Support, Moderation, Customer Operations, or similar is a plus.

  • Experience with Jira, Asana, Monday, Notion, or other task/request management tools.

Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.

  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.

  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.

  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.

  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.

  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.

  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

Benefits are provided in accordance with the company's policies and eligibility criteria.

jobs.description:
TÉRMINOS DE REFERENCIA

CONSULTORÍA PARA EL DESARROLLO DE UNA METODOLOGÍA DE FORMACIÓN DE FORMADORES SOBRE EL PROTOCOLO PARA LA INVESTIGACIÓN Y JUZGAMIENTO DE CASOS DE VIOLENCIA SEXUAL EN OAXACA

Título de la consultoría: Desarrollo de una metodología de formación de formadores sobre el Protocolo para la investigación y juzgamiento de casos de violencia sexual en Oaxaca, México

Unidad organizativa: Programas

Reporta a: Representante Regional para ALC y Associate Manager, ​Advocacy LAC

Ubicación: Remoto

Idiomas: Español

Fecha límite de solicitud: 2 de octubre de 2026

Duración: finales de octubre - finales de febrero

Honorarios de la consultoría: Fase 1: $3,000; Fase 2: $2,500 USD

SOBRE EQUALITY NOW:

Equality Now es una organización global de derechos humanos dedicada a lograr los cambios legales y sistémicos necesarios para poner fin a la discriminación contra todas las mujeres y niñas, en todo el mundo. Desde su fundación en 1992, ha contribuido a la reforma de 140 leyes discriminatorias a nivel global, impactando positivamente en la vida de cientos de millones de mujeres y niñas, así como en sus comunidades y países, tanto en el presente como para las generaciones futuras.

Trabajando con aliadas y aliados a nivel nacional, regional y global, Equality Now combina una profunda experiencia jurídica con una diversidad de perspectivas sociales, políticas y culturales para seguir liderando, orientando e impulsando los cambios necesarios para alcanzar una igualdad de género duradera, en beneficio de todas las personas. Para más información sobre Equality Now, visita.

OBJETIVOS:

Diseñar una metodología híbrida de Formación de Formadores (FdF) para aplicar el Protocolo para la investigación y juzgamiento de casos de violencia sexual, con enfoques de género, derechos humanos e interculturalidad. La metodología fortalecerá las capacidades de las personas operadoras de justicia de Oaxaca para replicar y adaptar la formación de manera autónoma y sostenible, mediante espacios de formación cruzada con otros actores clave.

ENTREGABLES:

Producto 1. Documento metodológico de Formación de Formadores

Propuesta pedagógica y operativa para formar a personas operadoras de justicia de Oaxaca en el Protocolo para la investigación y juzgamiento de casos de violencia sexual, con una duración de 16 a 24 horas en modalidad presencial, síncrona o asíncrona.

El documento incluirá objetivos y competencias; perfiles de participantes y personas formadoras; módulos, contenidos y actividades; criterios éticos y de autocuidado; evaluación del aprendizaje; seguimiento de la aplicación y réplica del Protocolo; y criterios para el pilotaje, validación y ajuste de la metodología.

La propuesta deberá contemplar tres componentes articulados:

  • Componente teórico-conceptual: apropiación y aplicación práctica de los contenidos técnicos y jurídicos del Protocolo, con énfasis en los estándares de derechos humanos y su aplicación en la investigación y juzgamiento de casos de violencia sexual.
  • Componente metodológico-pedagógico: desarrollo de competencias para la enseñanza de personas adultas en el ámbito jurídico, incluyendo estrategia de facilitación, uso de los recursos pedagógicos y manejo de situaciones que puedan surgir durante la formación.
  • Componente

    práctico

    de

    microenseñanza: ejercicios de simulación en los que los participantes pongan en práctica la facilitación de contenidos y actividades, con retroalimentación y evaluación de sus competencias técnicas y pedagógicas.

Producto 2. Caja de herramientas pedagógicas para la Formación de Formadores

Materiales editables y accesibles para implementar y replicar la formación, incluidos guías de facilitación, presentaciones, ejercicios, casos prácticos e instrumentos de evaluación, según corresponda.

Los materiales deberán facilitar la aplicación del Protocolo con enfoques de género, derechos humanos, interculturalidad e interseccionalidad, y criterios de confidencialidad y no revictimización. La caja de herramientas y el documento metodológico se ajustarán durante el pilotaje para entregar sus versiones finales.

Producto 3. Validación y pilotaje progresivo de la metodología y la Caja de Herramientas para la Formación de Formadores (ToT)

La persona consultora implementará, por etapas, un pilotaje de la Formación de Formadores con personas operadoras de justicia de Oaxaca, en coordinación con Equality Now y conforme al cronograma acordado. Equality Now facilitará el componente técnico y jurídico; la persona consultora estará a cargo de los componentes metodológicos, pedagógico y prácticos.

Durante el pilotaje, la persona consultora deberá:

  • Poner a prueba la metodología y los materiales desarrollados en los Productos 1 y 2.
  • Facilitar ejercicios de aplicación y microenseñanza para que las personas participantes practiquen cómo replicar la formación.
  • Observar y valorar sus competencias de facilitación mediante criterios definidos previamente.
  • Recoger y sistematizar la retroalimentación sobre la claridad, pertinencia y utilidad de la metodología y los materiales.
  • Identificar e incorporar los ajustes necesarios para facilitar la implementación y réplica de la formación.

Entregables:

  1. Informe breve de pilotaje y validación con los resultados, la retroalimentación recibida, las fortalezas y áreas de mejora identificadas, los ajustes realizados y las recomendaciones para futuras réplicas. La persona consultora presentará el informe en una reunión con el equipo de ALC.
  2. Versión final validada del documento metodológico y de la caja de herramientas, con los ajustes derivados del pilotaje y lista para su implementación y réplica.

La consultoría se llevará a cabo en dos fases:

Fase 1

octubre-diciembre 2026

  • Productos 1 y 2
  • Revisión y retroalimentación

Fase 2

Enero–febrero 2027

  • Validación del componente metodológico-pedagógico
  • Validación del componente práctico
  • Revisión y retroalimentación.
  • Versión final de la metodología y Caja de Herramientas para las formaciones híbridas/online.

El orden de los contenidos en este calendario está sujeto a modificación según las recomendaciones de la persona consultora.

PERFIL Y CUALIFICACIONES DE LA PERSONA CONSULTORA:

Formación académica y capacidades

  • Formación universitaria en ciencias jurídicas, ciencias sociales, educación, estudios de género, derechos humanos o áreas afines. Se valorará la formación especializada acreditada en violencia sexual, acceso a la justicia, derechos humanos, perspectiva de género, interculturalidad o educación de personas adultas.
  • Capacidad para analizar y sintetizar contenidos jurídicos y técnicos complejos y comunicarlos de forma clara, accesible y no discriminatoria.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, organizar el trabajo, coordinarse con equipos interdisciplinarios y cumplir con los productos y plazos establecidos en los TDR.

Experiencia y conocimientos técnicos

  • Al menos cinco años de experiencia profesional relevante en derechos humanos, igualdad de género, acceso a la justicia o reparación, particularmente en relación con la violencia basada en género o la violencia sexual.
  • Experiencia en el diseño, desarrollo y evaluación de procesos de Formación de Formadores (FdF) dirigidos a personas adultas, preferentemente a personas operadoras de justicia, al funcionariado público u a otros actores institucionales. Los procesos deberán contemplar la transferencia de conocimientos y el desarrollo de competencias para que las personas participantes puedan replicar la formación.
  • Experiencia en diseño instruccional y en metodologías de aprendizaje para personas adultas, con enfoques participativos y orientados a la aplicación práctica. Se valorará el uso de casos, simulaciones, ejercicios participativos y otras metodologías activas, en modalidades presenciales, virtuales o híbridas.
  • Experiencia en la elaboración de guías metodológicas, manuales, currículos, cajas de herramientas y otros materiales técnicos y pedagógicos que faciliten la implementación y la réplica de procesos formativos, con un lenguaje claro, accesible y no discriminatorio.
  • Conocimiento y aplicación de estándares nacionales e internacionales de derechos humanos relacionados con la violencia basada en género y la violencia sexual, en particular en materia de igualdad y no discriminación, debida diligencia, acceso a la justicia, derechos de niñas, niños, adolescentes y mujeres, protección de víctimas y sobrevivientes, y reparación integral.
  • Conocimiento del funcionamiento de los sistemas de procuración e impartición de justicia en casos de violencia sexual y violencia basada en género, incluidos los procesos de investigación y juzgamiento, los estándares probatorios, la actuación de las instituciones competentes y las medidas para prevenir la revictimización. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en el diseño, la implementación o la evaluación de protocolos, herramientas o capacitaciones dirigidos a personas operadoras de justicia.
  • Experiencia en la facilitación de procesos formativos y de espacios de intercambio entre distintos actores, incluidas instituciones públicas, fiscalías, poderes judiciales, organizaciones de mujeres y de la sociedad civil, y personas defensoras de derechos humanos. Deberá demostrar capacidad para conducir procesos participativos y abordar con cuidado situaciones sensibles relacionadas con la violencia sexual y las experiencias de victimización.
  • Experiencia en la incorporación de enfoques de género, derechos humanos e interculturalidad en procesos pedagógicos, adaptando los contenidos y las metodologías a los contextos, perfiles y necesidades de las personas participantes.

Conocimientos y experiencia deseable en el contexto de Oaxaca

Se valorará especialmente que la persona consultora cuente con:

  • Conocimiento del contexto sociocultural y territorial de Oaxaca, en particular de las condiciones y barreras que afectan el acceso a la justicia de mujeres, niñas y adolescentes sobrevivientes de violencia sexual.
  • Conocimiento de los sistemas normativos indígenas y comunitarios, así como de las dinámicas de articulación entre estos sistemas y el sistema estatal de justicia, desde un enfoque de derechos humanos e interculturalidad.

POSTULACIÓN:

Las personas interesadas deberán presentar:

  • Una breve carta de presentación en la que describan su experiencia relevante para la consultoría e incluyan enlaces a ejemplos de metodologías o materiales pedagógicos que hayan desarrollado.
  • Un cronograma de trabajo propuesto, que indique las principales actividades, etapas y tiempos previstos para el desarrollo de los productos, incluyendo los momentos de coordinación, validación y pilotaje.
  • Un currículum vitae (CV) que acredite la formación y la experiencia señaladas en el perfil requerido.
Salary: Fase 1: $3,000; Fase 2: $2,500 USD

jobs.title: Practice Lead, Growth
jobs.excerpt: Build the Practice.  Scale the Teams.  Partner with Growth-Stage Operators.
jobs.description:
Build the Practice. Scale the Teams. Partner with Growth-Stage Operators.
In 2008, Propeller reinvented the way venture-stage companies build finance teams, and in the process we defined the category the market now calls fractional. Three years ago, we quietly began building what comes next, expanding to serve our breakout clients as they scaled past venture and brought leadership in-house. That became our Growth practice: today it serves our largest clients and generates a third of Propeller's revenue. Now, with the practice staged to break out, we're hiring the leader who will professionalize and scale it.
You'll own the practice end to end: its commercial engine, its embedded delivery teams, and the strategic relationships that anchor it, bringing the horsepower Growth-stage Consumer companies need as they scale from $30M to $300M and beyond.
Growth-stage companies operate differently than venture-stage startups. The financial infrastructure is more complex. The operational stakes are higher. The boards are more demanding. The margin for error is smaller as companies approach exit velocity. And turnover in the finance seat stays high, because these companies accelerate faster than even exceptional talent can adapt. These clients need a CFO partner who has lived the $30M-to-$300M journey; someone who knows where the landmines are, how to build the systems that scale, and who has the career experience and confidence to make the case for uncomfortable truths when a situation requires it.
This is an equity-track leadership role for someone ready to build a practice, not just a portfolio.

Who We ARE
Today, Propeller's 250+ professionals serve as the embedded finance and accounting partner to some of the most iconic emerging companies in Consumer, Technology, Blockchain, and Business Services. All are full-time employees, across three continents; none are contractors or freelancers. Behind us: 1,500+ companies served, $105B+ in enterprise value created, 26 unicorn alumni, and $29B+ raised. Ahead of us: the transformation of professional services through AI-enabled intelligence.
Our embedded teams integrate seamlessly into client operations in multi-year partnerships. We attend weekly leadership meetings, participate in board prep, collaborate on strategic decisions, and have direct access to client CEOs and CFOs. This embedded positioning creates trust, access, and influence that traditional providers never achieve.
PropellerOS, our financial operating platform, combines human judgment, precision accounting, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled insight to transform finance from a back-office function into the central nervous system of growth. The system enables finance-grade standards of lineage, reconciliation, auditability, and explainability, with a named human accountable for every number we ship.

Key Responsibilities

Most leadership roles emphasize one dimension. This role requires three.
At $30M to $300M there is no bench to delegate to, so the finance leader architects the data systems, engineers the process change, and directs the AI that now carries the mechanical work, all at once. The market treats each of those as its own job. We built the infrastructure that makes them one: embedded access, AI fluency training, and dedicated change-management capacity behind every engagement.

Commercial Leader
You own the Growth practice's expansion: pipeline, bookings, retention, and P&L. You think like a business owner. You build relationships before you need them, identify opportunities others miss, and close deals that grow the practice. You develop go-to-market strategy for Growth-stage Consumer companies and build the private equity, investor and advisor relationships that generate referrals. Sixty-seven percent of our closed-won new business comes from referrals, so the network already produces; your job is to point it at Growth and extend it. If you wait for business development to hand you leads, this isn't your role.

Service Leader
You build the teams that carry our Growth portfolios: Controllers who each run their own client book. Controller and CFO are parallel tracks here, not rungs on one ladder, and part of your job is placement, putting people in the seat where their strengths compound. A brilliant controller running five clients flawlessly outranks a miscast CFO in every way that matters to a client. You set service standards and hold people accountable for client satisfaction, deliverable quality, and engagement profitability. You know that excellence at scale requires systems, not heroics. You conduct regular portfolio reviews, build capacity through hiring and development, and step in when engagements need senior attention. If you need to do everything yourself or avoid difficult management conversations, this isn't your role.

Strategic Partner
You serve as CFO-level advisor to Growth-stage Consumer operators, bringing the pattern recognition that only someone who has scaled companies from $30M to $300M can offer. You maintain strategic relationships with the most complex clients in the segment. You walk into boardrooms and command respect, translate financial data into strategic insight, and deliver difficult messages with clarity. You know where companies break as they grow: the systems that stop working, the hires that become urgent, the board dynamics that shift. The exposure compounds, too: across the portfolio you'll sit in more boardrooms in a quarter than most operating CFOs see in a year. And when an AI-produced analysis goes to a board, you are the one who certifies it and stands behind it in the room. If your experience is primarily early-stage or primarily enterprise, this isn't your role.
  • Drive business development through networking, referrals, strategic partnerships, and direct outreach.
  • Own financial performance of the Growth practice: revenue, margins, utilization, and profitability.
  • Lead and develop the practice's embedded teams, placing people in the seats where their strengths compound.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and escalation point for key accounts.
  • Participate in board meetings and investor conversations for strategic clients.
  • Make informed decisions about pricing, resource allocation, and engagement scope.

jobs.description:
Digital Forms is a consulting-led digital transformation firm, founded in Warsaw in 2015 and now 70+ people strong. We work with mid-market and enterprise clients across Europe, the UK, and the US — helping them turn operational complexity into measurable business outcomes. We started as a mobile development shop. Over ten years, we built something different: a firm where every product is grounded in a real business case, and where engineering quality is as important as strategy. Our team is fully remote, our clients are international, and our standards are high.

This role sits at the heart of that delivery.

As Senior Mobile Developer, you will be embedded in a high-stakes client engagement - building a greenfield mobile app for a premium international luxury retail brand, from the first architectural decision to launch.

The role and responsibilities:

We are building a brand-new iOS and Android app — from scratch — as part of a major digital transformation for a premium international luxury retail brand. The app will serve 250k+ daily active users across global markets from the moment it launches.

The product replaces static navigation with a dynamic, content-driven Feed ecosystem: personalised brand stories, exclusive offers, and live in-store updates, delivered with the engagement depth of social media. It is a greenfield project — no legacy code, no technical debt, full architectural ownership from day one. The app goes live in Q3.

As Senior Mobile Developer, you will own the architecture and delivery of the app end to end. You will write code every day — this is a pure hands-on engineering role, with no team management responsibility. The client expects senior autonomy from the start. You will work alongside a senior cross-functional team: backend engineers, frontend web developers, UI/UX designers, and a PM.

Architecture & technical leadership

  • Architect from scratch: Design the React Native app structure, patterns, and coding standards that the entire project will build on.

  • Define the content model: Work alongside FE Web developers to design the mobile content model powering dynamic, segmented delivery.

  • Drive technical decisions: Own integration choices for CMS, DAM, and personalisation tooling — and be able to defend them.

Feature development & integrations

  • Integrate CMS, DAM & personalisation: Connect the tooling that delivers the right content to the right user — context-aware, segmented, and real-time.

  • Implement deep linking: Build campaign-tied navigation flows and personalised user journeys across iOS and Android.

  • Ship push notifications: Design and implement the full push notification layer, including deep links and campaign landing flows.

  • Collaborate on features: Build and maintain new features together with backend engineers; work with UI/UX designers to assess feasibility and deliver high-quality UX.

Performance & quality

  • Optimise for scale: Own caching strategy, content-fetching architecture, and rendering performance for an app used by hundreds of thousands of people daily.

  • Instrument analytics: Implement event tracking that supports personalisation decisions, A/B testing, and experimentation.

  • Write quality code: Idiomatic, well-tested React Native — unit and component coverage as standard practice.

  • Own distribution: Manage iOS and Android release cycles and store submissions.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • React Native — 5+ years of professional experience building production iOS and Android apps from scratch.

  • iOS and Android platforms — both, including distribution cycles, store submissions, and platform-specific behaviour.

  • CMS & DAM integration — hands-on experience delivering dynamic, segmented content in mobile via headless CMS and DAM tooling.

  • Personalisation & experimentation platforms — integrating decisioning tools, recommendation engines, or A/B testing systems into a live mobile product.

  • Deep linking — production experience implementing campaign and personalised navigation flows.

  • Push notifications — full implementation including deep links and campaign flows.

  • REST API integration — connecting mobile apps to backend services at production scale.

  • Performance optimisation — caching, content-fetching, and rendering strategies for personalised, high-traffic apps.

  • Analytics & event tracking — instrumentation supporting personalisation and product experimentation.

  • Testable code — appropriate unit and component test coverage as standard practice.

  • English C1+ — written and spoken; direct communication with an international client team is a hard requirement.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with streaming APIs or AI-assisted feature integration.

  • App analytics platforms such as Firebase or Amplitude.

  • Consent management and third-party privacy tooling (GDPR).

  • Mapping SDKs — Google Maps, Mapbox, or similar.

  • Automated testing beyond unit and component level (E2E, integration).

  • Broader JS ecosystem: , React, .

  • A/B testing, feature flagging, and mobile attribution.

  • Headless CMS architectures in retail or e-commerce environments.

  • Understanding of UI/UX design principles and ability to assess feasibility.

  • Polish is a plus; all project communication is conducted in English.

Highlights

Build a brand-new mobile app for a premium luxury retail brand, used by 250k+ daily users.

Own the full architecture — React Native, CMS, DAM, personalisation — from day one.

jobs.excerpt: The Energy, Infrastructure, & Project Finance underwriter is responsible for leading all aspects of the underwriting process for complex energy, infrastructure, and project finance loans and investments, including Shared National Credits (SNC).
jobs.description:
The Energy, Infrastructure, & Project Finance underwriter is responsible for leading all aspects of the underwriting process for complex energy, infrastructure, and project finance loans and investments, including Shared National Credits (SNC). This role independently assesses credit risk to ensure transactions align with the organization’s credit standards, internal policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines in a fast‑paced environment. This position involves in‑depth analysis of financial models, contracts, due diligence materials, and engineering reports to develop well‑supported credit recommendations for energy and infrastructure projects nationwide.

Are you ready to learn more? Apply and ask about this opening!

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the end‑to‑end underwriting process for energy, infrastructure, and project finance transactions, including loans, tax equity investments, and syndicated facilities.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, internal origination teams, and third‑party providers to obtain all information necessary for a complete and accurate credit assessment.
  • Develop, analyze, and review complex financial models and projections to evaluate project cash flows, sensitivities, and key risks.
  • Underwrite and support the ongoing servicing of Shared National Credit (SNC) loans, working alongside agent banks and participating lenders.
  • Perform independent credit analysis, annual reviews, amendments, waivers, and servicing actions for SNC transactions in accordance with intercreditor agreements and regulatory expectations.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external lender groups to support credit approvals, servicing actions, and portfolio monitoring for SNC exposures.
  • Review agent bank credit packages, financial models, and reporting to assess ongoing performance and emerging risks within SNC portfolios.
  • Perform comprehensive credit analysis by reviewing financial statements, project contracts, legal documentation, and third‑party reports to assess project viability through underwriting and closing.
  • Prepare clear, well‑reasoned credit memoranda for loan committee review, outlining transaction structure, key risks, mitigants, and recommendations.
  • Conduct market, industry, and company research to support underwriting assumptions and credit conclusions.
  • Review and interpret complex legal and structured finance documents related to energy, infrastructure, and project finance transactions.
  • Independently underwrite syndicated loans for both new originations and ongoing servicing actions.
  • Lead credit analysis for early‑stage development opportunities and complex deal structures.
  • Take primary responsibility for portfolio underwriting assignments involving multiple common facilities.

jobs.description:
Must have experience with resolving edits and denials for Hospital Billing Services.


Work Location-Remote

Fully Virtual

Note: Remote positions at Parkland for this team can only hire from candidates who live in these states:

  • Arkansas
  • Wisconsin
  • Texas
  • Florida (cannot hire Miami-Dade county)

Primary Purpose
As a part of our Coding Quality team, our coding editors plan an integral role of reviewing coding quality alerts and/or billing edits for hospital, outpatient and ambulatory encounters. Providing a great review and oversight of opportunities before final billing. This team will also review coding denials and evaluate areas of improvement through out the revenue cycle process.

MINIMUM SPECIFICATIONS

Education

  • Must have successfully completed an approved coding program OR
  • Must be a graduate of a Health Information Management program.


Experience

  • Must have five years of coding experience in an acute care hospital environment.


Equivalent Education and/or Experience

  • May have an equivalent combination of education and experience in lieu of specific education and/or experience as stated above.


Certification/Registration/Licensure

  • Because of the lag in SCCE, HCCA, NCRA, and AHIMA updating the status of certifications, current employees whose certification is granted through one of these associations are allowed up to seven (7) calendar days, after expiration, to provide proof of renewal. Although an additional seven (7) calendar days is allowed to provide proof of renewal, there cannot be a lapse in the certification's 'active' status.
  • Must be certified through the American Health Information Management Association as one of the following:
  • Registered Health Information Management Technician (RHIT)
  • Registered Health Information Management Administrator (RHIA)
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified Coding Specialist 'Physician Based (CCS-P)
  • OR
  • Must be certified through the American Association of Procedural Coders as one of the following:
  • Certified Professional Coder-Hospital (CPC-H)
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC)


Skills or Special Abilities

  • Must be able to demonstrate advanced knowledge of coding and abstracting skills.
  • Applicants must pass applicable coding test with an 85% or above prior to placement into position. Current Parkland employees requesting reassignment into role must have applicable coding test on file.
  • Must be able to demonstrate knowledge of reimbursement (Medicare and Medicaid) principles.
  • Must have extensive knowledge of medical terminology, the human disease process, anatomy and physiology.
  • Must be able to demonstrate good organizational and leadership skills.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
  • Must be able to demonstrate knowledge of computer software applications including MS Office.


Responsibilities

  • Verifying accuracy of assigned CPT codes for complex and/or error prone procedures.
  • Verifying diagnosis coding accuracy for complex and/or error prone encounters.
  • Reviewing charge and procedure mismatches
  • Reviewing codes with revenue integrity edits for NCD/LCD coverage
  • Reviewing invalid codes, code conflicts and missing modifiers.
  • Working with other teams in billing, revenue integrity, coding operations, coding compliance and other revenue cycle counter parts.
  • Combining codes for payment window encounters
  • Assisting with resolution of accounts with HIM/Coding unbilled hold reasons preventing final billing.
  • Validating certain discharge dispositions.
  • Assigns appropriate diagnosis and procedure codes, and codes all inpatient and/or outpatient episodes of care recorded in the patient record, including review for APC/MS-DRG options, according to ICD-9-CM /ICD-10 conventions and guidelines, determining secondary diagnoses which meet reporting criteria, and referring to coding references to ensure accuracy of medical records, facilitate record transfer for billing and/or optimize reimbursement for patient care rendered. May assist other coders by training and advising on coding and abstracting according to ICD-9-CM conventions and guidelines, responding to coding inquiries, reviewing and noting coded charts, providing feedback and monitoring chart corrections to ensure that noted changes have been made to facilitate coding consistency, accuracy, efficiency and appropriate billing and reimbursement.
  • Assist in resolving billing edits that are holding patient claims from billing, by reviewing claims information, medical records and other applicable documentation. Assists with work flow, priorities for work completion, and communicating workflow issues to the supervisor. Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction. Makes recommendations to supervisor, implements and monitors results as appropriate in support of the overall goals of the department and Parkland.
  • Serves as a liaison between management, coders, physicians, nurses, medical staff, Patient Financial Services, and hospital employees regarding Correct Coding Initiatives, medical necessity and revenue and coding edit issues. Communicates with physicians and nurses by telephone or in writing to clarify documentation issues by obtaining missing diagnoses, procedures or information, resolving ambiguous coding episodes to ensure that missing information is corrected and resubmitted for payment.
  • Maintains a positive working relationship to ensure that medical record information is documented and coded according to established conventions and Parkland's policies and guidelines.
  • Assist in the identification and reporting of potential quality issues. Maintains knowledge of applicable rules, regulations, policies, laws, and guidelines that impact the coding and abstracting of medical records. Develops root cause analysis that identify systematic issues. Analysis details of benchmarking and creates resolution of the edits. Develops effective internal controls and monitor reports. Promote adherence to applicable state/federal laws, and the program requirements of accreditation agencies and federal, state, and private health plans. Seeks advice and guidance as necessary to ensure proper understanding.
  • Ensure unbilled items are addressed properly and timely. Maintains departmental quality standards, prepares and submits productivity logs to supervisor, as required.
  • Identify and review charging, coding, and clinical documentation issues. Stays abreast of the latest developments, advancements, and trends in the field of coding and abstracting of medical records by attending in service training, coding meetings, seminars/workshops, actively participating in professional organizations, and maintaining licensure. Integrates knowledge gained into current work practices.
  • This position is 100% Virtual. Virtual employees must also comply with all Parkland policies and procedures governing the use of Parkland information resources. Virtual employees must maintain all equipment lent by Parkland for performing the agreed upon job duties in good working condition. All employment responsibilities and conditions in applicable Parkland policies and procedures apply to employees while working virtually.

Job Accountabilities

  • Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction. Makes recommendations to supervisor, implements, and monitors results as appropriate in support of the overall goals of the department and Parkland.
  • Stays abreast of the latest developments, advancements, and trends in the field by attending seminars/workshops, reading professional journals, actively participating in professional organizations, and/or maintaining certification or licensure. Integrates knowledge gained into current work practices.
  • Maintains knowledge of applicable rules, regulations, policies, laws and guidelines that impact the area. Develops effective internal controls designed to promote adherence with applicable laws, accreditation agency requirements, and federal, state, and private health plans. Seeks advice and guidance as needed to ensure proper understanding.

You will be expected to create opportunities from scratch, navigate multi-location organizations with more than one decision-maker, and develop messaging that resonates with owners and operators managing growing, complex businesses. We are looking for someone who is no stranger to overcoming obstacles, comfortable with longer sales cycles, and strives to exceed expectations.
