jobs.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

Financial Examination – Director / Managing Director / Partner

Risk & Regulatory Consulting, LLC

(Regulatory Insurance)

Work from home-any US location

Position Overview
The Financial Examiner Director / Managing Director / Partner roles primarily focus on providing oversight over financial examinations and regulatory consulting services, in a lead role, on behalf of clients (state insurance departments). This position has significant opportunity for advancement as well as personal and professional growth. Responsibilities will include developing relationships with and selling regulatory services to clients; preparing and performing QA reviews of proposals; serving as an Examiner-in-Charge (EIC) on examinations; ensuring work is delivered with high quality, on time, and within budget; supervising/developing staff; recruiting; and leading thought leadership initiatives, among other responsibilities. The successful candidate will work remotely, which may require travel at times, and must be highly self-motivated and goal-oriented.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities

KNOWLEDGE

  • Demonstrate deep knowledge of, and provide guidance relative to, the NAIC Financial Condition Examiners Handbook (the Handbook), insurance laws, rules, statutes, and regulations (both current and evolving). Ensure the team’s work appropriately takes these into account in forming examination findings and recommendations.
  • Have experience drafting compelling proposals, including scoping, workplans, and budgets.
  • Consistently enhance personal and team knowledge of risk-focused examination approaches and methodologies. Train and develop other team members (including state department personnel) to deepen their knowledge and skill sets on risk-focused examination principles.
  • Have prior EIC experience on financial examinations of significant size and complexity.
  • Possess deep insurance industry experience.
  • Have expertise or significant knowledge and understanding of all lines of insurance.

SKILLS

  • Own growth, management, and quality of a multi-million-dollar portfolio of financial business.
  • Cross-sell other service lines to clients, including investment, actuarial, IT, and market regulation
  • Build, foster, and maintain client relationships as the primary point of contact; leverage these relationships to manage, grow, and sustain a significant book of business.
  • Lead numerous comprehensive multi-state risk-focused, targeted, and interim financial examinations in accordance with the Handbook on behalf of state insurance departments.
  • Handle all aspects of the client relationship and project execution responsibilities from start to finish – e.g., RFP/proposal stage, contracting/risk management process, planning and execution of work, and wrap up/completion of all deliverables and client requirements.
  • Perform reviews of assisting examiners’ examination work papers to ensure high quality and, as applicable, provide on-the-job training, developmental coaching, and feedback.
  • Ensure the quality and integrity of the regulatory examination process on specific assignments. Serve as a trusted business advisor to regulators. When applicable, serve in an EIC role or as a subject matter expert on examinations of all sizes, including those of significant size and complexity.
    • Review and assess insurance company’s documentation and data to determine compliance with states’ insurance statutes and regulations.
    • Review and sometimes assist in drafting examination work papers that meet clients’ expectations and objectives.
    • Take the lead on drafting key examination deliverables (e.g., Report on Examination, Management Letter, Summary Review Memorandum, etc.), exhibits, and other supporting documentation and schedules and recommend solutions for inclusion in Management Letters or other communications to the client.
    • Draft and submit examination reports and other deliverables for supervisory review.
    • Recommend/document actions to ensure compliance with insurance statutes and regulations.
    • Lead discussions of issues with examinee companies and support clients with issue resolution.
  • Analyze reports and records relating to specific and overall operations of insurance companies; prepare clear, complete, concise, and informative examination reports and other examination exhibits and deliverables for the client’s review.
  • Provide trainings and presentations to small or large groups of state insurance department employees or internal staff on insurance industry and examination topics, including but not limited to, risk-focused examination matters, “hot topics”, etc.
  • Make decisions based upon input and analysis from the examination team or regulators.
  • Demonstrate strong computer and technology skills, including experience in using software for producing presentations, spreadsheets, and project planning (e.g., TeamMate, Access, and MS Excel, Word and Power Point).

ATTRIBUTES

  • Possess:
    • A demonstrated history of successful project management experience, including managing numerous large and complicated assignments concurrently.
    • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks, projects, and assignments using effective time management skills.
    • Ability to interact with all levels of management, including commissioners and deputy commissioners, chief examiners and their designees, and executives and senior management at insurance companies.
    • Outstanding interpersonal, presentation, analytical and examination/audit skills.
    • Dynamic/flexible demeanor with an emphasis on exceptional client service skills.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Be a forward-thinking leader with a collaborative focus who can consult effectively with key constituents and become recognized as a valued resource.
  • Be self-motivated, think critically, be resourceful, work well independently, suggest solutions to problems and offer suggestions for decision making, and possess a strong sense of urgency and the ability to work at whatever times are needed focused on client deadlines.
  • Be strong in team building and coaching, and people development/management.
  • Demonstrate integrity and maintain professionalism in difficult conversations and situations with staff and client.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree with a preference in Accounting or Finance.
  • Minimum of 10+ years insurance experience with a State Insurance Department, insurance company, examination firm dealing with financial examinations, or with a public accounting firm as an internal or external auditor of insurance companies.
  • Candidates must have completed or are actively pursuing the professional insurance designation of CFE (Certified Financial Examiner); CPA preferred but not required.
  • Flexibility for travel, when necessary.

Risk & Regulatory Consulting, LLC (RRC) was formerly a business segment of RSM US LLP (formerly McGladrey) until 2012 when the separate legal entity was formed. RRC is a strategic business partner with RSM providing actuarial and insurance industry consulting services to RSM clients.

Risk & Regulatory Consulting, LLC (RRC) is a national, leading professional services firm dedicated to providing exceptional regulatory services to clients. With over 100 experienced insurance professionals located in 22 states, we believe RRC is uniquely positioned to serve state insurance departments. We offer services in the following regulatory areas: financial examinations, market conduct examinations, insolvency and receiverships, actuarial services and valuations, investment analysis, reinsurance expertise, market analysis and compliance, and special projects. We are a results oriented firm committed to success that builds long term relationships with our clients.

RRC is managed by eight partners and our practice includes full time professionals dedicated to our regulatory clients. We are focused on listening to your needs and designing customized examination, consulting, and training solutions that address your needs. We bring multiple service lines together to provide superior and seamless service to our clients. We are committed to training our customers and our team. We have developed various comprehensive in house training programs that have been tailored to meet the needs of our regulatory clients. We offer competitive pricing, outstanding experience, credentials and references. RRC is an active participant in the NAIC, SOFE, and IRES.

At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at .

As a trusted subject matter expert, you'll tackle complex underwriting challenges, support key business decisions, and champion best practices throughout the region. If you're a relationship-focused leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about helping agriculture succeed, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

  • Oversee underwriting operations, maintain workflow expertise, assist with business processing as needed, and support departmental staffing during absences or peak workloads.

  • Evaluate underwriting information, make final underwriting determinations, and prepare and process policies and endorsements.

  • Possess the ability to apply knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures of underwriting in day-to-day and strategic work.

  • Solid written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on confidentiality, tact, and diplomacy to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

These solutions include SailPoint, Azure Active Directory, Federated Authentication Services, Privileged Identity Management, and the underlying technology that supports them. The Identity and Access Management Engineer is an important member of the IAM practice who works with internal and external partners to deploy and manage advanced technology which drives excellent user experiences while following security architecture best practices. This role combines software engineering and IAM experience to improve IAM platforms, automate main access processes, and ensure a and auditable approach to user access at SNHU.

What you'll do:

  • Manage the day-to-day functions of the Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solution including implementation of automation, scripting, configuration-as-code, and administration to extend platform capabilities.

jobs.description:
We are hiring an Investment Banking Associate to bring investors into the opportunities on Pairs, and to run each investor process with a banker's discipline.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

This role sits on the investor side of Pairs. You know how a process runs: the investor list, the first approach, the follow-up, the meeting and the next step. Here you run that process for the companies that clear our diligence.

You bring the investor relationships you built on deals, and you open new ones every month: family offices, high-net-worth individuals, angels and funds that invest directly in companies.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so a network made up mainly of fund LPs or institutional mandates is not the right fit for this role. Our model is introductions and relationship management, not deal execution.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to investor conversations, and to judging which investors will actually commit capital.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

We are looking for someone who has sat on the outreach side of a deal and wants to own the relationships, not only the materials.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Investor processes. For each opportunity, the right investors approached in the right order and followed up until there is a clear answer.

  • Your investor relationships. The investors you bring and those you add here, kept current and qualified. They remain yours.

  • Investor matching. A clear understanding of what each investor looks for, so the opportunities you share are relevant.

  • Ongoing engagement. Staying useful to investors between opportunities, so they continue to work with us.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have worked on live capital raises or M&A processes and run investor or buyer outreach yourself, not only built the deck and the model.

  • Hold investor relationships you built personally, and can explain how each one began.

  • Know what an investor needs to see before taking a meeting, and how to get a busy one to reply.

  • Hold a high bar for precision. A wrong figure in an investor email costs trust that is hard to win back.

  • Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor names in your application.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote, asynchronous role

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

  • Insight into our internal processes, including how we screen deal flow

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation Range: $120K - $180K

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Observability)
jobs.excerpt: introductionIAM Cloud builds software that simplifies IT management in the cloud.
jobs.description:
introduction

IAM Cloud builds software that simplifies IT management in the cloud. We are a fully employee owned, bootstrapped company - which means we answer to our customers and our team, not investors. With around 35 employees, we serve more than 3,000 organisations worldwide.

Being employee owned shapes how we work. Decisions are long-term, the culture is collaborative, and the people who build the company share in its success. We have leaned deliberately into AI and agentic workflows across the business as a core part of how a focused team competes with companies ten times our size. We are fully remote with employees in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany and Argentina and have been remote for years, as a deliberate choice about how good work gets done.

about the role

IAM Cloud is an Azure-first SaaS company with a small, fully remote engineering team. We run our own platform end to end: infrastructure, pipelines, releases and production operations all sit with the same handful of engineers. That means ownership is broad, documentation matters, and reducing toil is treated as a first-class goal rather than a side project.

We recently added a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to own our CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code foundations. This role is the reliability counterpart: the person who owns how we see, measure and respond to what production is doing. You will own monitoring, observability, alerting and on-call at IAM Cloud, as the person who sets the standards, writes the policy and makes the engineering team better at running its own services.

Today our telemetry lives in Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, with Azure Managed Grafana for dashboards and alerting. It works, but it has grown organically. Alert thresholds are inherited rather than designed, retention and cost are not governed, instrumentation is inconsistent across services, and our on-call tooling is reaching end of life and must be replaced on a fixed deadline in the first half of 2027. We want someone who can come in, take a clear-eyed look at all of that, and turn it into something deliberate.

Where we are heading

Over the medium term we intend to move more of our workloads onto Kubernetes (AKS), with Prometheus alongside Azure Monitor and OpenTelemetry as the instrumentation standard. That is a direction rather than a dated plan, and it is not the focus of this role in its first year. What matters now is that whoever owns observability here has a view on what good looks like on that platform, so that the standards you set today carry over cleanly when we get there.

What you will own (outcomes)

  • Define and evolve the observability strategy, target architecture and standards for the platform - what we instrument, how, where it lands, how long we keep it and what it costs.
  • Make Grafana the place engineers go to understand production: dashboards and alerting designed around services and customer journeys, not around whichever metrics happened to be available.
  • Establish service level objectives for our customer-facing services, with error budgets that engineering and product actually use to make decisions.
  • Rationalise alerting so that every page is actionable, owned and has a runbook - and so that the on-call engineer's phone is quiet when nothing is wrong.
  • Lead and champion the move to a modern incident response and on-call platform (incident.io or similar) integrated with Microsoft Teams, and design the on-call model around it: rota, escalation, and the post-incident review process that feeds back into the backlog.
  • Champion observability-first thinking across the engineering team, so developers instrument their own services well without needing you in the loop.

First-quarter deliverables

  • A written telemetry governance policy covering Log Analytics table plans, retention tiers, sampling and cardinality controls - with a baseline of current ingestion and spend and a target.
  • An alert rationalisation pass across Azure Monitor and Grafana: every remaining alert mapped to a service, an owner, a severity and a runbook; noisy or unowned alerts removed or downgraded.
  • Selection, delivery and cutover of a new incident response and on-call platform (incident.io or similar, Teams-integrated) to replace our current tooling before its end-of-life date, including parallel running and a documented on-call model.
  • SLOs and SLIs defined for the top customer-facing services, with dashboards and burn-rate alerting.
  • Looking further out: as our Kubernetes and Prometheus direction firms up, you will own the observability standards for it - collector topology, log routing, dashboards and alerting - so that it lands well-instrumented from day one.

Day to day

  • Design and implement OpenTelemetry instrumentation across our .NET services, and the collector pipelines that shape, sample and route telemetry.
  • Own Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights configuration, managed as code alongside the rest of our estate (Bicep first).
  • Own Grafana end to end: data sources, dashboards-as-code, alert rules and the conventions the team follows when adding to them.
  • Run the incident response and on-call platform once it is in place: routing, escalation policies, integrations with Azure Monitor and Grafana alerting, and the Teams workflow around an incident.
  • Contribute observability requirements and standards to our Kubernetes and Prometheus direction as it takes shape, alongside the platform engineer who owns that work.
  • Build and maintain Grafana dashboards and alert rules that answer real operational questions, and retire the ones that don't.
  • Lead incident response when it matters, run blameless post-incident reviews, and turn findings into engineering work.
  • Track and reduce reliability metrics that matter: MTTR, alert volume per on-call shift, incident recurrence, telemetry cost per service.
  • Evaluate tooling and AI-assisted operations capabilities on their merits, and give the team a clear recommendation rather than a shortlist.
  • Write things down: standards, runbooks, decision records, and the "why" behind thresholds.
  • Take part in a light-touch on-call rotation with the rest of the engineering team.

what we're looking for

What we're looking for (must-haves)

  • 6+ years in engineering, with 3+ in a reliability, observability or production-operations role where you owned outcomes rather than executed tickets.
  • You have defined SLOs, SLIs and error budgets for real services and can talk through how they changed decisions.
  • You have reduced alert noise - you can describe an alerting estate you inherited, what you cut, what you kept, and how you knew it was safe.
  • Hands-on OpenTelemetry: instrumenting services, running collectors, and making deliberate choices about sampling and cardinality.
  • Telemetry cost and retention governance: you understand that observability has a bill, and you have managed it.
  • Deep Azure Monitor / Log Analytics / Application Insights experience, including KQL, and strong Grafana skills - dashboards, alerting and managing both as code.
  • Infrastructure as code - Bicep is our standard; strong Terraform experience is fully transferable.
  • Clear written and spoken communication at C1 level or above, or native-level business English. You will be setting policy for a remote team; if it isn't written down, it doesn't exist.

Nice to have

  • Experience selecting, implementing or migrating incident-management and on-call platforms - strongly desirable given the first-quarter deliverables.
  • Prometheus-based monitoring and alerting, including exporters, recording rules and cardinality management.
  • Kubernetes in production, ideally AKS, and the observability patterns that go with it.
  • A software development background, ideally .NET, so instrumentation conversations with developers are peer to peer.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted operations and coding tools, and a considered view on where they help and where they don't.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305) or the CKA.
  • Experience in a small or scale-up environment where you were the observability function.

why us?

How we work

  • Fully remote across the UK. We meet in person a few times a year for team events, but day-to-day work is remote.
  • Small, senior team. You will work directly with engineering leadership and have real input into technical decisions.
  • Async-friendly. We use writing as our default mode of communication and avoid meetings when a written update will do.
  • On-call is shared and light. We invest in making the platform boring rather than relying on heroics.

Our Offer
£80,000 - £95,000 salary (dependent on skills & experience)

Guaranteed £2,000 pay rise every year you're with us, separate from any merit or promotion increases.

Time off and flexibility

  • 26 days holiday plus public holidays, with the option to swap public holidays for days that are more meaningful to you.
  • Your birthday and work anniversary day off, every year.
  • Up to 4 weeks per year working from anywhere in the world.
  • Genuinely flexible, fully remote working - we trust you to manage your own time.

Health, family, and wellbeing – UK employees

  • Generous Becoming a Parent leave, designed to support every kind of family.
  • Medical scheme including remote GP, dental, optical, and diagnostics.
  • Access to Support Room - confidential counselling, therapy, and coaching.
  • Help@Hand employee assistance programme.
  • 5x salary life insurance through Unum.

Money and growth

  • Up to 10% pension match (UK employees).
  • Annual learning and development budget per function.

Interview process

We respect your time and aim to keep this efficient. Our typical process looks like this:
  • Initial conversation (45-60 minutes): a chat with our Head of People about you, the role, and any questions you have.

Senior Videogame Designer (Remote)

Seismic Squirrel LLC

Job Title: Senior Videogame Designer

The Role: Designing gameplay, systems, mechanics, maps, and levels for our studio's videogames.

The Games: Narrative-driven RPG videogames set in an alternate-history 1930s New York City.

Experience: Senior Level – 10+ years of professional videogame design experience.
Must have successfully shipped at least one videogame in a Senior Designer role.

Location: USA or Canada (Remote) – Must reside within the UTC-4 to UTC-8 timezones.

Company Size: ~24

Job Type: Contract-to-Hire -or- Employee (see below)

Pay: $45-65 USD per hour – Depends on skills and experience.

Overview

We are looking for a creative and resourceful Videogame Designer to join our team. They will work with other departments to design, document, and implement a variety of game systems, mechanics, levels, and mission types. This position requires excellent collaboration and communication with various stakeholders. The job demands a clear understanding of the gameplay experience, player needs and expectations, a logical and systemic thinker, an iterative approach to development, a collaborative spirit, and an enthusiasm for our studio's genre of videogames.

The ideal candidate is driven to create a fun and cohesive gameplay experience, able to empathize with both new players and with experts of the genre. They possess a sense of urgency and enjoy working with talented designers, engineers, writers, artists, testers, and management.

This is a remote position which requires regular collaboration online during our core work hours (9:30 AM – 4:30 PM Pacific), attending relevant team meetings (e.g. daily scrum, retrospectives, sprint planning, and design meetings). Occasional calls during late evenings, nights, and early mornings should be expected for meetings with international collaborators. Occasional travel may be expected. Applicant must have an ergonomic and secure workspace separate from their personal activities and roommates during work hours.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the USA or Canada. Whether an applicant qualifies for contract-to-hire or full-time employee, and the option to convert, depends on the applicant's location, skills, aptitude, fit, project needs and schedule, and pay expectations. H-1B transfers and sponsorships are not available at this time.

For more information about Seismic Squirrel, go to

Quests

  • Guide the design of gameplay, systems, and mechanics, including unit balancing, and in-game economy.
  • Work with other departments to design and implement game levels and missions, including establishing mission objectives, level layout, and support the integration of art and narrative assets in Unity.
  • Preside over design meetings and clearly document game designs in the requirements.
  • Actively collaborate with the development team on the game concept and design.
  • Effectively communicate needed mechanics to Engineering.
  • Maintain outstanding UX quality throughout the game's design.
  • Participate in internal game testing and feedback.
  • Openly communicate with team members on progress and problems, define deliverables, and help to set realistic project timelines and expectations.
  • Champion intuitive UX to ease new players into the game with an engaging first-time experience.
  • Help predict, identify, and resolve user experience issues that could detract from player enjoyment.
  • Help to identify where to add analytics instrumentation and interpret the resulting analytics data to improve the user experience.

Character Stats

  • 10+ years of professional experience in the game design role through the full lifecycle of game development from start to finish:
    concept, design, prototype, production, content creation, testing, polish, launch, and support.
  • Possess a strong understanding of combat and travel systems and mechanics and level design best practices.
  • Expert as a Designer in Unity.
  • Experienced integrating and implementing narrative within gameplay.
  • Experienced working with professional narrative authoring tools (e.g. Articy, Arcweave, Pixel Crushers).
  • Understand the unique needs and opportunities developing games for PC and console.
  • Enthusiastic for quality gameplay and a familiarity with many games and genres, past and present.
  • Passionate for the videogame industry and a desire to grow within it.
  • Strong self-discipline, motivated, a self-starter with a drive for excellence.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, able to work fast and loose or carefully with quality as needs require.
  • Courteous and patient, able to give and receive constructive and inspirational feedback gracefully.
  • Able to work effectively with people having a variety of personalities and backgrounds.
  • Adaptable: The job can change according to the needs at hand and requires wearing various hats.
  • Outstanding documentation, information organization, and cross-referencing skills.
  • Strong written, visual, and verbal English language communication and presentation skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, resourceful, able to find solutions when needed.
  • Able to balance and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines, working within agreed timeframes and budgets.
  • Adept at working remotely using various collaboration tools.
  • Has an ergonomic and secure workspace separate from their personal activities and roommates during work hours.
  • Experienced applying UML in design.
  • Proficient in Atlassian Jira and Confluence.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Visio.
  • Passionate to learn new tools and technologies.

Bonus Points

  • Proficient using tools for art (e.g. Adobe), modeling (e.g. Blender, 3ds Max), and design (e.g. Adobe XD, Figma).
  • Located in one of our hub metros: Seattle, Los Angeles, Edmonton, or Austin.

The Company

Seismic Squirrel is a close-knit fully remote videogame studio with a passion for developing thoughtful story-based games. Our nimble size allows for everyone to have a voice in the projects we create, demanding the ability to be both detail-oriented and flexible.

If this sounds like an exciting opportunity for you and you're located in the USA or Canada, please submit both your Résumé and your Cover Letter to Seismic Squirrel. And if you have a MobyGames page, please provide that as your Portfolio link.

Salary: $45-65 USD per hour – Depends on skills and experience

About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We're looking for a Senior People Systems & Operations Generalist to build and scale the systems, programs, and processes that support employees throughout their journey with Prenuvo. You'll own HRIS data integrity and its connection to SSO/identity provisioning, lead system implementations and migrations end-to-end, and serve as a hands-on People Ops generalist, a strong fit for someone who enjoys both technical systems work and day-to-day employee experience. You'll partner closely with P&C Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll/Benefits, IT, and other stakeholders to keep people processes efficient, secure, and compliant.

You'll partner closely with People & Culture Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll and Benefits, IT, and key stakeholders to ensure our people processes and systems are efficient, secure, compliant, and enhance our employee experience from onboarding to offboarding.This role is remote-first, with a preference for candidates who are able to work primarily within the Eastern Time Zone (ET).

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

  • Own HRIS data integrity (audits, corrections) and configure workflows/business rules in platforms like Rippling or Workday.
  • Serve as escalation point for HRIS/P&C systems issues, including HRIS-to-SSO provisioning, partnering with IT/Okta and vendors on root-cause fixes.
  • Support system upgrades and rollouts (UAT, documentation, training) to reduce recurring support tickets.
  • Build people analytics reports and automation to support data-driven leadership decisions.
  • Lead cross-functional projects: comp/performance cycles, system implementations/migrations, and policy changes.
  • Improve core People Ops processes (onboarding, offboarding, lifecycle transactions) and act as SME on policy/compliance, partnering with Legal on employment law adherence.
  • Manage global mobility/immigration cases and support employee relations escalations with P&C BPs.
  • Draft SOPs and policy documentation; mentor junior People Ops team members.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years in HR/People Ops, HRIS administration, or related generalist experience
  • Strong knowledge of Canadian employment law and payroll/tax compliance; US experience a plus
  • Hands-on HRIS platform experience (Rippling, Workday, or similar)
  • Strong analytical and communication skills; comfortable explaining policy to all levels
  • Process-improvement mindset with high discretion handling confidential data
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; CPHR/PHR/SHRM-CP preferred, not required
  • Bonus qualifications: benefits/leave/comp administration experience, global mobility/immigration program experience, high-growth or global company background

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a high-growth or scaling company environment
  • Global company people operations experience
  • Familiarity with payroll processes and systems integration
  • Experience building or improving employee self-service resources
  • Experience managing global mobility and immigration programs

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventive healthcare for everyone. This role includes whole-body scans as part of our employee benefits.
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize

jobs.excerpt: Job Description:B12's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

B12's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it. Our engineers are responsible for prioritizing, conceptualizing, co-designing, building, testing, and engaging users for any concept we are building out. We’re generalists in encouraging each other to experience the full stack, but we’re also aware of each other’s preferences in the stack. For this role in particular, we’re searching for a tenured full-stack engineer who brings strong backend/infrastructure skills (and an interest in using them) to the product. We mentor and teach where we can, both inside and outside of the company, and as a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible not only for your ownership of major projects, but also mentorship of the team members with whom you ship those projects.

We value sharing our work with the outside world. Our team has published papers on forming expert flash teams and machine-mediated worker hierarchies. We’ve baked our research into various open source tools in the space of creativity, expertise, and knowledge work.

We hope our engineers have more longevity than any one tool we use, but here is a sampling of our current thoughts about technology:

  • We live on Python/Django and TypeScript/React.
  • We store blobs in Amazon’s S3, munch on them in Amazon’s EC2, develop in Docker, and deploy containers to Amazon’s Elastic Beanstalk.
  • We believe PostgreSQL should be the first system you consider when thinking about persisting structured data.
  • We clean and centralize data in Amazon’s Redshift, and are able to answer almost any question in SQL.
  • We leverage AI in our product and our internal tooling, and faced with a landscape in constant flux, try to pick the right model or agent on a task-by-task basis.
  • Our new code is almost 100% LLM-generated, and we’ve thought hard about ensuring quality in the face of ever-increasing review loads, what processes humans are still best at, and how the practice of mentorship must adapt in the face of these new tools.
  • We have near-full test coverage on the backend, and are making progress on our frontend and integration tests.
  • We set up continuous integration and deployment because, while this model comes with its own pains, we’ve disliked being on fixed release schedules on previous projects.
  • We like to move fast and support point-in-time recovery :).

You’d be a good fit if

  • You have 10 or more years of experience building products and systems in production.
  • You are an amazing communicator.
  • You feel comfortable managing your time and deciding among competing priorities.
  • You are curious.
  • You have a high ownership mentality.
  • You enjoy learning and teaching.
  • You are comfortable working with backend and frontend technologies, but have a deeper background and interest on the backend/infrastructure side.
  • You care about and want to contribute to our mission of helping people do meaningful work.

What does a staff engineer do here?

This is B12’s first Staff Engineer hire on a ~10-person product team that includes a designer, product manager, and CTO. To understand what we’re looking for in someone with this much experience, here are some concrete examples of tasks you’d work on in a month:

  • Own the delivery of a project of the magnitude “we ship one or two of these a quarter,” both individually shipping code and rallying and supporting team members in doing so.
  • Participate in quarterly planning to identify key projects to work on next quarter.
  • Mentor other engineers who are in the planning, prototyping, or implementation phases of a project.
  • Respond to an incident, write up a postmortem, and improve tooling and infrastructure to help us prevent or more quickly respond to the issue and others like it in the future.
  • Identify and optimize some infrastructure that costs too much, is too slow, or isn’t stable enough.
  • Discuss an early design/prototype with a designer or product manager to help shape its direction and explain what will be easy or hard to implement.
  • Unblock an operational team member on a data analysis project that answers a hairy question facing our business.
  • Run a brainstorm with engineers to identify how we might work more effectively or ship with a higher level of quality.

Don’t fear:

  • We highly favor talent and interest.
  • Some candidates may see this list and feel discouraged because they don’t match all the items. Please apply anyway: there’s a good chance you’re more wonderful than you think you are.
  • B12 is a safe place for human beings. We particularly encourage you to apply if you identify as a woman, are a person of color or other underrepresented minority, or are a member of the LGBTQIA community.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: Advanced Utility Systems, a division of Harris; is seeking a Senior Account Executive who is a proven new-business hunter ready to join our sales team.
jobs.description:
Advanced Utility Systems, a division of Harris; is seeking a Senior Account Executive who is a proven new-business hunter ready to join our sales team.

You will win new municipal utility customers for our CIS Infinity platform and the products around it. This role is not an account management or install base expansion position. We hire people who open doors, earn a seat at the table before the RFP exists, and carry a pursuit from first conversation to signed contract.

Municipal utility buying decisions run through formal procurement. Boards, city councils, finance directors, and operations leaders all weigh in, and the RFP often decides the outcome. The Account Executive who wins in this market builds relationships early, understands what a utility is trying to fix, and helps shape the evaluation criteria before a competitor does. You will treat every RFP as a campaign that starts months before the document is published, not as a form to complete after it arrives.

This is an individual contributor role, built to be rewarding and fulfilling as a career in its own right. It carries no formal management duties. It does offer an informal opportunity to mentor and develop a new sales team member who supports new customer acquisition, and to guide that person as an aide to your pursuit work. We plan to expand the sales team to grow faster in 2027 and 2028, and you will help shape how new sellers learn our market and our process. You will also set the pace for how our sales organization uses AI in RFP response, proposal writing, demonstrations, and closing. Leadership development is a possible path for people who succeed in the role and want it, but it is not a requirement of the job.

The Profile We Recruit:

A seasoned enterprise software hunter who has sold to municipal utilities and won. You earn business by building trust with public sector buyers over long cycles, and you can show the deals you opened, not the accounts you inherited. You see AI as a practical tool for winning more bids with less effort.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST timezone.

Salary:

85K - 95K

OTE including base: Up to 200K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

Win New Municipal Utility Accounts

  • Own a new-logo quota across North American municipal electric, water, wastewater, and gas utilities, with no install base farming responsibility.
  • Build and work a target account plan that identifies utilities with aging CIS platforms, upcoming contract expirations, leadership changes, and budget cycles that signal a buying window.
  • Develop relationships with the full buying group, including utility managers, finance directors, customer service leaders, IT leaders, and city or board decision makers.
  • Run disciplined discovery that connects a utility's operational pain, such as staff retirements, billing accuracy, call volume, and cost to serve, to a business case the buying committee can defend.
  • Apply MEDDPICC to qualify opportunities, manage the funnel, and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast. Report on pursuit health, win rates, and lessons from lost deals.

Shape RFPs Before They Are Written

  • Engage prospects early, during needs assessment, budget planning, and consultant selection, so that our platform capabilities inform the requirements a utility writes.
  • Build working relationships with utility consultants, procurement officers, and the consulting firms that often draft RFPs.
  • Make a disciplined bid or no-bid recommendation for every RFP, weighing fit, relationship strength, competitive position, and cost of pursuit.
  • Own the RFP response from kickoff to submission, and coordinate product, professional services, and finance contributors to meet deadlines with a compliant, persuasive proposal.
  • Lead orals, finalist demonstrations, reference calls, and best-and-final negotiations through contract signature.

Mentor and Develop New Sales Talent

  • Mentor a new sales team member, including a sales engineer or sales intern, in an informal guidance role. You do not manage this person's performance, pay, or employment.
  • Bring that person into your pursuits as an aide, and give them real exposure to account research, RFP support, discovery calls, and demonstrations.
  • Show how you build relationships, qualify opportunities, and shape an RFP, so the person learns our approach to new customer acquisition by working on live deals.
  • Help prepare demonstrations that follow each utility's stated requirements and workflows, working alongside the sales engineering function.
  • Share what you learn with sales leadership, so the team can bring new sellers on faster as we grow in 2027 and 2028.

Accelerate AI Adoption in the Sales Process

  • Use AI tools to analyze RFPs, extract requirements, draft compliant responses, and build tailored proposals in a fraction of the current cycle time.
  • Apply AI to account research, stakeholder mapping, demo preparation, and closing plans so that the team enters each meeting better prepared.
  • Work with sales leadership and R&D to document which AI-assisted practices improve win rates and response quality, and share them across the sales organization.
  • Measure results with concrete metrics, including hours saved per RFP, proposal quality, bid volume handled, and win rate.

What we are looking for:

  • Five or more years of quota-carrying software sales experience, with a recent track record selling CIS, billing, or other enterprise software to municipal utilities or comparable public sector buyers.
  • A history of new-logo success. You can name the utilities you won, the size of each deal, the length of the cycle, and your role in it. Candidates whose results came mainly from renewals, upsells, or install base expansion will not fit this role.
  • Demonstrated experience with public sector procurement, including RFP response, bid or no-bid decisions, evaluation scoring, orals, and contract negotiation.
  • Proven ability to influence a buying process before the RFP is issued, through consultant relationships, requirement shaping, and executive sponsorship.
  • Strong relationship builder with credibility among utility managers, finance leaders, and board or council members.
  • Clear, persuasive writer who can produce or direct an executive summary, a differentiated technical response, and a pricing narrative.
  • Willingness to mentor a new sales team member informally, and the ability to work effectively with a sales engineer or demo specialist. Prior management experience is not required.
  • Commitment to learn and apply MEDDPICC. Advanced has adopted this framework to guide funnel management and sales process discipline, and it supports scalable growth. You will use it to qualify opportunities, build pursuit plans, and forecast. Prior experience helps, but a willingness to learn it and use it consistently is required.
  • Curiosity and hands-on initiative with AI tools. You can describe how you have used them, or how you would use them, to shorten proposal cycles and raise quality.
  • Willingness to travel to prospect sites, conferences, and finalist presentations, as the pursuit calendar requires.

What would make you stand out:

  • Knowledge of the meter-to-cash cycle and the challenges facing municipal utilities, including workforce retirements, aging systems, and pressure to reduce cost to serve.
  • An existing network among North American municipal utilities, utility associations, and utility consulting firms.
  • Experience selling against established CIS competitors and displacing a legacy platform.
  • Prior working knowledge of MEDDPICC or a similar qualification framework, such as MEDDIC or Challenger.
  • Familiarity with CRM and pursuit management tools, and with proposal automation platforms.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!
  • A Market Position Worth Building On: Advanced serves the North American municipal utility industry with 30 years of domain experience. You sell the leading private cloud for utilities platform with a modernization roadmap and a credible AI story, into a market where aging systems and workforce retirements push utilities to act.
  • A Role Built for Individual Contributors: You focus on winning new customers, with the chance to mentor a new sales team member as we grow in 2027 and 2028. Leadership development is available to those who succeed and want it.
  • Autonomy and Accountability: You own your territory, your pursuits, and your results. Leadership expects a clear plan and honest forecasts, and gives you room to run.
  • A Front Seat for AI in Sales: You will help build and refine the AI-assisted RFP, proposal, and demo practices we roll out across the sales organization.

About Advanced Utility Systems:

Advanced Utility Systems was established in 1997 to provide Customer Information and Billing solutions exclusively to municipal, investor owned and cooperative utilities. With more than 150 successful customer deployments across North America, Central America, South America and the Caribbean, Advanced has the experience required to deliver a successful implementation of your mission critical CIS.

About Harris:

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, financial acumen, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Reconcile study milestone payments against study progress and status updates.
  • Track and maintain payment activity, accruals, and financial records within established timelines.
  • Support budget development by providing financial input and feedback prior to Fair Market Value (FMV) assessments.

  • Ability to work independently while effectively contributing to cross-functional teams.

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionABOUT VICTAULICVictaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors.
jobs.description:
Job Description

ABOUT VICTAULIC

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world's most critical and prestigious structures.


An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation

At Victaulic, we're committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

Let's Build a Better World Together.

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

• We build from within.

• We stand behind our people.

  • We foster an environment for constant learning.
  • We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE

Victaulic's Enterprise Data & AI Services organization is scaling a formal AI Governance capability spanning policy, risk classification, vendor and model risk assessment, and platform-enabled compliance monitoring. As Senior AI Risk Analyst, you will execute and continuously improve Victaulic's AI risk assessment processes by evaluating AI use cases, vendor and model risk, and agentic and generative AI deployments against Victaulic's AI Governance Framework (V-RAIF) and Acceptable Use Policy (AUP v2.0). You will work hands-on in Victaulic's AI governance platform, Credo AI, and partner closely with Legal, Cybersecurity, Procurement, and business stakeholders to help AI adoption move quickly without introducing unmanaged risk.


WHAT YOU'LL BUILD & OWN

  • Execute end-to-end AI use case risk assessments using Victaulic's formal 41-item risk assessment checklist across six phases, producing clear risk ratings and mitigation recommendations.
  • Administer and continuously improve AI risk workflows in Credo AI, including intake forms, risk-scoring logic, evidence collection, and reporting dashboards.
  • Apply Victaulic's three-tier risk classification model to new AI agents, generative AI tools, and MCP or connector integrations as they move through the registration process.
  • Lead AI vendor and contract risk reviews, including data rights, intellectual property ownership, audit rights, and model change notification, in partnership with Legal and Procurement.
  • Build and maintain repeatable governance processes and playbooks for intake, triage, escalation, remediation tracking, and periodic reassessment so risk review scales with AI adoption across the business.
  • Prepare risk findings, metrics, and talking points for the AI Governance Committee and executive updates.
  • Monitor the regulatory and standards landscape, including NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act, and translate relevant changes into updates to Victaulic's Acceptable Use Policy and governance artifacts.
  • Partner with AI Engineering, Data Governance, and AI Enablement & Adoption to ensure risk controls are embedded in delivery rather than added after the fact.
  • Support insurance and cyber-risk assessments related to AI use and contribute to incident and near-miss reviews involving AI systems.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of experience in AI or technology risk, compliance, information security, or IT governance, including at least 2 years focused specifically on AI or machine learning risk.
  • Direct, hands-on experience configuring workflows, risk assessments, or governance reporting in Credo AI.
  • A demonstrated track record of building AI governance processes from the ground up, such as intake and triage workflows, risk classification models, or assessment checklists.
  • Working knowledge of AI risk and governance frameworks, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or an equivalent framework, and how they translate into operational controls.
  • Experience evaluating third-party AI or SaaS vendor contracts for data rights, intellectual property, and audit-rights risk.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for governance committees or senior stakeholders.
  • Structured, checklist-driven risk thinking balanced with pragmatic judgment about business impact.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity while a governance program is being built.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work fluently with Legal, Cybersecurity, Procurement, and business and technical teams.
  • A platform-oriented mindset that treats Credo AI as a system to configure and improve, not simply a form to complete.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Risk Management, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Familiarity with agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration risk.
  • Certification such as CIPP/AI, AIGP, CISA, or CRISC.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or industrial enterprise IT environment.

WHAT WE OFFER


Build A Better Career

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.
  • Career development programs and internal promotion pathways - we build from within.
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities.

Build A Better Future

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Retirement savings plans with company match.
  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

Build A Better You

  • Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable.
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources.
  • Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another.

Build A Better World

  • Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day.

IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP

Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full-time basis without the need for employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.


EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. Background checks may be required as part of our pre-employment process.


VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY

All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries, and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic's Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process.


Let's Build a Better World Together.

You will work in close alignment with Marketing to turn campaigns and leads into qualified pipeline and closed business.

This is a key revenue-generating role with a clear path for growth in the robotics and advanced automation sector.

jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

What's this role about?

Rule #1 of the Auvik Way: Wow our customers!

As a key player in Auvik’s customer success team, you’ll drive expansion and retention by helping our existing customers unlock the full value of our product—ultimately fueling revenue growth. You’ll be a strategic partner to your accounts, guiding adoption, identifying upsell opportunities, and influencing renewals. Internally, you’ll act as the customer’s voice across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Support, ensuring a seamless experience that supports both their success and Auvik’s. You’ll manage a portfolio of customers, lead them through implementation and product integration, and connect them to the right resources to maximize satisfaction and long-term partnership.

What will I be doing?

As an Account Manager at Auvik, you’ll be a key player in ensuring the success of our Managed Service Provider (MSP) customers. You’ll be responsible for fostering strong client relationships, driving revenue growth, and ensuring that customers are fully utilizing Auvik's products and services to meet their business goals. Every day, you will:

  • Manage Client Relationships: Be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of customers, building and maintaining positive, long-term relationships.
  • Support Customer Success: Understand your clients’ needs and help them implement Auvik effectively within their operations, from initial adoption through ongoing use.
  • Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed revenue targets by upselling and cross-selling additional products or services to your accounts.
  • Drive Product Utilization: Develop strategies to ensure your clients are maximizing the value of Auvik’s features and are aware of new updates and developments.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work with Auvik’s internal teams (e.g., onboarding, product, support) to ensure seamless client experiences and effective solutions.
  • Customer Training and Demos: Conduct product demos and training sessions to help clients adopt and use Auvik’s features to their full potential.
  • Provide Feedback: Collect and document feedback from customers regarding potential product improvements or new features, sharing insights with our engineering and product teams.
  • Resolve Problems: Address client issues in a professional and timely manner, ensuring that solutions are both effective and aligned with customer needs.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a customer-facing role, with strong sales and account management skills, particularly in a SaaS environment. You should have:

  • Experience in Account Management: Proven ability to manage client relationships, particularly in a SaaS or IT service provider context, with a focus on driving revenue and demonstrating business value.
  • Experience building strategic account plans: Experience developing and executing plans that drive product adoption and growth within customer accounts.
  • Strong IT Business Understanding: A solid understanding of IT concepts and the ability to apply them to help grow and improve their service offerings.
  • Sales Skills: Comfortable identifying opportunities to upsell and cross-sell, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong ability to assess and address client challenges, and a knack for offering creative, practical solutions.
  • Excellent communication, organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage client concerns and conflicts with professionalism, ensuring positive outcomes
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly grasp new products, features, and functionalities
  • A commitment to continuous improvement

Are there bonus points?

Yes! We’ll give your application extra credit if you have one or more of these:

  • Knowledge of IT infrastructure operations or IT service provider business concepts
  • Knowledge of Salesforce

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.

About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

Salary Range:
$60,900—$79,450 CAD
OTE (On-Target-Earnings) Range:

jobs.description:
We are hiring an Account Executive, Venture Capital to run the first conversation founders have with Pairs, and to turn the right ones into clients.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

You sell to founders, not to funds. Every call is with a founder in the middle of a raise.

You take that first call. You learn the round, the traction, the runway and what has not worked so far, and you decide whether we can genuinely help.

When we can, you explain how Pairs works, what it costs and what it does not do, and you book the next step before the call ends. When we cannot, you say so plainly.

Some founders are better served by our platform tier. For them, you run the demo and close it yourself.

We sell access to investors, not promises. The expectations you set on the first call are the ones we deliver against, so honesty is part of the job.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our closing team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen companies, what we decline and why.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • First calls. Every founder you speak to leaves with a clear picture, whether or not they work with us.

  • Qualification. The judgement on who is raising, who can decide, and who we can actually help.

  • The handoff. A next step booked on the call, and a written read for the person who runs it.

  • Your pipeline. Every founder you speak to, kept current until they sign, pass or come back.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have carried a target and can walk us through a deal you won: the hesitation, what you said and what happened.

  • Have sold to founders or executives, ideally in fundraising, finance or venture.

  • Understand a round well enough to ask the second and third question, not just the first: structure, lead interest, runway, why investors pass.

  • Set expectations you can stand behind. You never promise an outcome, and you would rather lose a deal than oversell one.

  • Can tell a polite yes from a real one, and take a no without losing the relationship.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote role, with working hours that overlap US Eastern time, where most of our founders are

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our closing team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • A sales process that already works, and recorded calls to learn it from

  • Insight into how we screen companies and match them with investors

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation Range: $110K - $160K

Job Title:

Role Overview:

Role Overview
The Federal Professional Services Manager is a key leadership role within Trellix’s Global Services Organization, responsible for directing a team of technical consultants on our U.S. Federal customer base. Reporting to the Director of Public Sector Professional Services, you will oversee delivery execution, operational rigor, scope management, and revenue realization across Federal Civilian (FedCiv), Department of Defense (DoD), and Intelligence Community (IC) agencies.

This role requires a TS/SCI or higher.

In this role, you will bridge strategic leadership with technical delivery execution. You will coach and lead a team of 5–10 Federal Professional Services personnel, partnering closely with Federal Sales, Customer Success, Technical Support, and Engineering to deliver complex cybersecurity deployment, custom integration, and architectural advisory services. Your primary objectives are driving billable utilization, project margin, Statement of Work (SOW) delivery, and ensuring consultant success across mission-critical agency operations.

Role Requirements:

Location: Remote, USA

Clearance Required: TS/SCI

Up to 50% Travel Required


About the Role:


People Leadership, Team Coaching & Capacity Planning

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Federal Professional Services consultants, building a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and mission alignment.
  • Establish clear individual targets for billable utilization, professional development, technical certifications, and operational compliance.
  • Guide team members through complex technical deployments, customer escalations, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, scope negotiations, and staffing assignments across high-priority Federal agency programs, balancing project timelines with clearance requirements.

Service Delivery, Scope Management & Financial Performance

  • Own the delivery performance and financial health of the Federal Professional Services portfolio, driving billable utilization, project margins, and recognized services revenue.
  • Ensure all technical engagements are delivered on-time, within budget, and in full compliance with active Statements of Work (SOWs) and performance specifications.
  • Identify project risks, manage technical blockages, and implement recovery plans.
  • Oversee change-order processes for out-of-scope customer requests, partnering with Sales to scope and convert expansion opportunities.

Federal Governance, Compliance & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build strong working relationships with key agency stakeholders, including Contracting Officer's Representatives (CORs), Contracting Officers (COs), CISOs, Program Managers, and Prime System Integrator partners.
  • Maintain strict adherence to Federal procurement regulations (FAR/DFARS), agency-specific security controls, FedRAMP mandates, and technical clearing procedures.

Practice Scoping & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Public Sector Sales Account Executives and Solutions Engineers during pre-sales phases to scope technical engagements, write detailed SOWs, and estimate project effort accurately.
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to ensure a seamless transition from solution deployment to long-term operational adoption and expansion.
  • Coordinate with Product Management and Engineering to provide direct agency feedback regarding deployment friction, product gaps, and integration needs.

About You:


Education & Experience


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical/business field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Clearance: Must hold a TS/SCI or higher clearance
  • Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Technical Consulting, or Systems Integration within enterprise IT or cybersecurity environments.
  • Leadership Experience: 3+ years of direct people management experience leading technical consulting or professional services delivery teams.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the U.S. Federal market (FedCiv, DoD, IC) and the operational dynamics of Federal IT deployment.

Technical & Functional Competencies

  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity architecture, platform deployments, and technical domains (Endpoint, XDR, Network/NDR, Data Security/DLP, or SIEM/SecOps).
  • Expertise in project management methodologies, SOW development, Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) and Time & Materials (T&M) contract structures, and Salesforce.
  • Strong working knowledge of Federal contracting frameworks, FAR/DFARS standards, and CPARS processes.

Leadership & Security Clearance

  • Executive Presence: Ability to brief and engage with senior agency leaders, CISOs, and contracting officers.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to collaborate with Sales, Product Development, and Support to remove delivery friction and scale service offerings.
  • Citizenship & Clearance: Must be a U.S. Citizen. Active Secret, Top Secret, or Top Secret/SCI clearance (or immediate eligibility) required.

Company Benefits and Perks:

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

  • Retirement Plans

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Our Commitment to You:

At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.

Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews.
