jobs.title: Art Director - Mobile Casual F2P Games
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityUserWise is looking for an experienced Art Director to own and elevate the visual direction of a premium mobile Free-to-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

UserWise is looking for an experienced Art Director to own and elevate the visual direction of a premium mobile Free-to-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role for someone with exceptional visual judgment, deep experience in mobile casual/F2P games, and the ability to lead a small multidisciplinary art team.

You will own the visual quality of the complete game experience across 2D, 3D, UI art, characters, environments, animation, VFX, lighting, and overall presentation. We are looking for someone who can evaluate how the entire game comes together on screen — not just individual assets — and raise the visual bar through clear direction, strong feedback, paintovers, mockups, references, and hands-on iteration when needed.

A key part of this role will be balancing the accessibility and readability of a premium casual mobile game with the spectacle, lighting, personality, excitement, and sense of occasion of a major entertainment property.

The ideal candidate also embraces AI-assisted creative workflows and understands how AI can amplify a talented art team by increasing exploration, accelerating iteration, and allowing artists to focus more time on high-value creative decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the overall art direction and visual identity of the game.
  • Establish and maintain a consistently high visual bar across 2D, 3D, UI, character art, environments, animation, VFX, lighting, and gameplay presentation.
  • Ensure the game retains the accessibility of a premium casual title while delivering the stage presence, spectacle, energy, and entertainment value expected from a major IP.
  • Review the game holistically and ensure all visual disciplines feel like part of the same cohesive experience.
  • Identify areas that feel generic, inconsistent, underdeveloped, or disconnected from the core fantasy and drive them toward stronger solutions.
  • Provide clear, actionable visual feedback through art reviews, paintovers, mockups, reference boards, and direct iteration.
  • Directly manage and mentor a small multidisciplinary art team spanning 2D, 3D, UI art, characters, environments, and VFX.
  • Set clear expectations, priorities, and quality standards while building a healthy culture of constructive critique and iteration.
  • Partner with Production on art priorities, capacity, dependencies, and delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Direction, Game Design, UX, Product, Engineering, and Production.
  • Work with UI/UX to ensure usability and clarity are supported by strong composition, hierarchy, visual storytelling, and presentation.
  • Guide VFX and animation toward a coherent language for anticipation, impact, transitions, rewards, celebration, and game feel.
  • Translate established IP and brand pillars into a modern mobile-game visual identity that feels authentic without becoming generic.
  • Participate in recruiting, portfolio reviews, and hiring as the art team evolves.

AI-Assisted Art Direction

AI-assisted creative workflows are an important part of how UserWise approaches game development.

The Art Director will be expected to actively champion and help evolve the use of AI across the art team.

You will:

  • Explore and incorporate AI tools where they can accelerate ideation, concept development, visualization, reference creation, iteration, and production.
  • Help artists use AI as a creative multiplier, not as a substitute for artistic judgment, craftsmanship, or ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive production work and increase the amount of time the team spends on high-value creative decisions.
  • Establish workflows that combine AI-assisted exploration with traditional 2D, 3D, UI, animation, VFX, and engine-based production.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and techniques based on whether they genuinely improve quality, speed, or creative range.
  • Maintain strong artistic standards, visual consistency, and IP integrity as these workflows evolve.

We are looking for someone who is excited to actively shape how AI-assisted workflows can augment the creativity, capabilities, and output of a talented art team.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience as an Art Director, Associate Art Director, Lead Artist, or equivalent visual leadership role in games.
  • A portfolio demonstrating an exceptionally strong visual bar and clear artistic judgment.
  • Shipped experience on mobile Free-to-Play games.
  • Strong experience with casual or mass-market mobile games.
  • Proven experience managing and directing multidisciplinary artists.
  • Demonstrated ability to direct visual quality across multiple disciplines.
  • Strong visual judgment across 2D character and concept art, UI, environments, 3D characters, animation, VFX, lighting, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to provide effective visual feedback through paintovers, mockups, references, or direct iteration.
  • Strong understanding of how UI, art, animation, VFX, lighting, and audio combine to create game feel and emotional payoff.
  • Experience working closely with UI/UX, game design, product, engineering, and production teams.
  • Ability to balance a strong artistic point of view with readability, performance, technical constraints, and production realities.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain not only what should change visually, but why.
  • Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.
  • Comfortable working in Unity or closely within a real-time game-engine production environment.
  • Comfortable managing a distributed, international team.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for adopting and advancing AI-assisted creative workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with major entertainment, television, film, toy, or other licensed IP.
  • Experience adapting an established brand into a distinctive mobile-game visual identity.
  • Experience with game-show, social, party, board, puzzle, Match-3, coin-looter, or adjacent mass-market genres.
  • Experience on games with strong progression, characters, collection systems, rewards, and highly expressive moment-to-moment feedback.
  • Experience developing art-direction bibles, style guides, visual systems, and scalable LiveOps content standards.
  • Experience with generative AI, AI-assisted 3D workflows, or other emerging creative technologies.

Portfolio

A strong portfolio is essential for this role.

We are particularly interested in portfolios that demonstrate:

  • Shipped mobile and F2P work
  • Casual or mass-market visual sensibility
  • Art direction across complete game experiences rather than isolated assets
  • Multidisciplinary direction across 2D, 3D, UI, characters, environments, animation, or VFX
  • Paintovers, visual development, style exploration, or examples showing how you elevated the work of a team
  • The ability to create a cohesive visual identity across multiple disciplines

Where possible, please identify your specific role and contribution to the projects shown.

Benefits

Why Join UserWise

  • Help bring a globally recognized IP to life with real brand reach and growth potential.
  • Own and elevate the visual direction of a flagship mobile game across 2D, 3D, UI, animation, VFX, and presentation.
  • Help shape modern, AI-assisted creative workflows that amplify the capabilities of a talented art team.
  • Work with a veteran-led team in a lean, high-ownership environment.
  • High visibility and direct creative impact on the product.
  • 100% remote, flexible work with a small, passionate, execution-focused team.

Benefits

  • Market-competitive compensation
  • Paid Time Off
  • Performance Bonus
  • Annual Performance Reviews

Marketing and Communications Specialist

General Description

Centering Healthcare Institute (CHI) is a 25-year old 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization whose mission is to champion and advance the evidence-based Centering group model of care to transform how healthcare is practiced and experienced, empowering healthcare providers and patients to improve health outcomes. CHI partners with approximately 480 provider organizations across the U.S. to implement and sustain its three Centering group models of care - CenteringPregnancy®, CenteringParenting ®, and CenteringHealthcare ®.

Why You’ll Love CHI!

  • Professional Development - your development is our priority.

  • Comprehensive Health Benefits - Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with 6% Company Match

Position Summary

The Marketing & Communications (MarComms) Specialist plays a critical role in executing CHI’s multi-channel marketing and communications strategy. This position supports day-to-day content development, campaign execution, communications, and brand management across CHI’s organizational priorities—including awareness campaigns, donor communications, internal communications, social media and partner-facing materials.

This role ensures high-quality, timely, brand-aligned messaging that advances CHI’s mission, strengthens stakeholder engagement and supports the work of the Director of Communications & Media Relations. By providing dedicated operational capacity, the MarComms Specialist enables the communications team to scale campaigns, strengthen storytelling and support CHI’s expanding revenue, partnership, awareness, and engagement initiatives.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for the Marketing Communications Specialist is $70,000-$80,000 based on the qualifications and years of relevant experience the selected candidate brings.

Work Submission

Submitting previous work, such as a portfolio, writing sample, or relevant work sample, is highly preferable. Applications submitted with at least one sample will be reviewed preferentially. The sample could be any past example of a work asset, marketing plan, press release, op-ed, email that is part of an email marketing campaign, blog post, social media posts, or anything that shows off what you can do!

All writing samples should be sent to with MarComms Specialist Sample – First & Last Name in the subject line to submit any past works.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, edit, proofread, and publish internal and external marketing and communications content across multiple channels.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Reporting Structure and Key Relationships

This position reports to the Director of Communications.

Qualifications and Requirements

Experience:

Skills:

Working Conditions

The Marketing Specialist works primarily in a remote environment with a standard full-time schedule, though occasional irregular hours may be required to support deliverables and events. This role values adaptability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Regular communication via Teams, Zoom, email, or similar tools is essential to maintain alignment and productivity. The position requires the ability to meet deadlines, deliver high-quality work independently, and use standard office equipment and technology. Occasional travel may be required for conferences, meetings, retreats, and other business-related events.

Clipping Specialist (3-month FTC)

About the role

NewGen is hiring a Clipping Specialist on a 3-month fixed-term contract to build and run our clipping programmes at scale. You will find and onboard clipping channels, run campaigns through our in-house tech, and make sure every clip we seed lands with the right audience for the right brand.

NewGen is a social-first creator and influencer marketing agency. We work with global brands in gaming, sport, entertainment and consumer, and clipping is one of our fastest-growing propositions: turning long-form content, creator streams, trailers and campaign moments into short-form clips that are distributed through a network of clipping channels on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and X.

This is a hands-on role at the centre of a new line of business. You will work with our campaign, creator and tech teams, and you will have a direct say in how the proposition and the tooling evolve.

Contract:

3-month fixed-term contract (FTC), with potential to extend or go permanent

Location:

Remote

Start:

ASAP

What you'll do

Work with the clipping network

  • Identify, vet and recruit clipping channels and clippers across TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and X, through platforms and our own technology.
  • Build and maintain a segmented database of channels by niche (gaming, sport, entertainment, lifestyle), audience location and typical reach
  • Manage ongoing relationships with clippers so we have a reliable, responsive network ready to activate at short notice

Run campaigns at scale through our tech

  • Set up and manage clipping campaigns end to end in NewGen's in-house tooling: campaign sign-up, channel authentication, view caps, tracking and payouts
  • Brief clippers on the content, the moments to prioritise and the brand guidelines, and quality-check clips before and after they go live
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and move budget, caps and channels around to hit view and geo targets
  • Manage multiple campaigns in parallel across different clients and markets

Report and improve

  • Produce clear performance reporting for internal teams and clients: views, reach by geo, CPM delivered, top-performing clips and channels
  • Feed back to our product and tech team on what the tooling needs to do better, and help test new features as they ship
  • Document the process and playbooks so the programme can scale beyond your contract
  • Keep on top of platform changes, clipping trends and what competitors and creators are doing

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • Hands-on experience running clipping, meme page, UGC or creator distribution campaigns, either agency-side, in-house or as a clipper or channel operator yourself
  • A working knowledge of where clippers live and how they operate: Discord communities, Clipfarm or similar platforms, payout models and view caps
  • A strong instinct for what makes a clip perform on TikTok, Shorts, Reels and X, and for spotting fake or low-quality reach
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of channels and campaigns at once, with the organisation to keep it all moving
  • Confident with campaign tooling, spreadsheets and reporting, and quick to learn new platforms

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in gaming, esports, sport or entertainment content
  • Experience with Twitch and YouTube creator campaigns, game launches or trailer moments
  • Experience with multi-market campaigns, especially US and UK
  • Familiarity with short-form editing tools or AI editing workflows
  • An existing network of clippers or channel owners you can bring with you

Contract details

  • 3-month fixed-term contract, full time, starting as soon as possible
  • Remote contract
  • Pro-rata salary or day rate depending on how you prefer to work:
  • A genuine route to extension or a permanent role if the programme grows as we expect

jobs.excerpt: About the JobAOA is hiring a Senior Android Engineer to build the native Android experience that runs on a custom ARM-based embedded device, not a phone.
jobs.description:
About the Job

AOA is hiring a Senior Android Engineer to build the native Android experience that runs on a custom ARM-based embedded device, not a phone. This is a full-stack device role that spans low-level hardware integration up through the companion mobile app. You will own the Android architecture for purpose-built hardware: an offline-first, modular system with encrypted per-profile storage, designed so a great experience holds up on real hardware with constrained resources.

This is the senior technical owner role for the device's Android experience. We keep specifications lean because we trust strong engineers to think deeply, resolve open architecture decisions, and shape the technical path forward. You will integrate the device's onboard cameras, sensors, controlled lighting, and physical hardware controls used as the primary navigation input instead of touch, build the shared abstraction layers the rest of the app consumes, and connect the device to the world through Bluetooth audio, Wi-Fi sync, OTA updates, and companion apps.

You will operate independently across the device and companion-app surface, partnering with designers, the product owner, and any hardware or firmware counterparts to move work forward with clarity and care. As an AI-native agency, we use modern AI coding tools and agents to increase speed, quality, and focus, while keeping strong human judgment at the center of the final product.

You may be a strong fit if you are a senior Android engineer who has built for real devices or embedded hardware, not only phone apps, takes pride in software that works close to the metal, enjoys turning ambiguity into thoughtful implementation, and wants to own the Android work end-to-end with a close-knit team that cares deeply about client outcomes.

Role Details

  • Compensation: $5,000 USD per month
  • Engagement: Contract (independent contractor)
  • Location: Remote, based in Latin America
  • Schedule: Available during standard business hours in US Central Time, for strong overlap with the team
  • Reports to: Engineering Manager

About AOA

AOA is a growing digital design and development agency that creates high-impact websites, AI-native apps, and standout eCommerce experiences for ambitious modern brands.

We partner closely with eCommerce and SaaS companies to deliver thoughtful, polished work that drives meaningful results and lasting client success. Our work spans strategy, design, development, eCommerce, conversion optimization, and custom application development.

We are a close-knit team where every person has a direct, visible impact on our clients' success and the growth of the company. We value genuine relationships, high standards, ownership, clear communication, and a true commitment to client delight.

As an AI-native agency, we use modern tools to enhance the quality, speed, and clarity of our work, while keeping human judgment, creativity, and relationships at the center.

Responsibilities

  • Key Outcome: Deliver high-quality, high-performing embedded Android experiences that AOA is known for, with predictability, agentic-efficiency, and collaborative ownership.
  • Own the end-to-end Android architecture for native Android on custom ARM-based embedded hardware.
  • Design an offline-first, modular system with local data architecture that can support future cloud sync.
  • Design encrypted per-profile storage, the local database, and build variants for the embedded device.
  • Resolve open architecture decisions and own the technical path forward.
  • Integrate device hardware into the app, including onboard cameras, controlled lighting, proximity sensors, and physical navigation controls.
  • Build shared hardware-abstraction layers for camera management, physical input, and device lifecycle behavior.
  • Design around display power states, cold boot, power transitions, abnormal shutdowns, and constrained hardware resources.
  • Build the on-device Kotlin experience from approved designs and specifications, including a UI navigated by physical controls.
  • Ensure core product features work reliably offline.
  • Implement Bluetooth audio, Wi-Fi sync, OTA updates, offline device-to-device transfer, and casting or streaming.
  • Design connected-device flows to degrade gracefully without bricking the device or corrupting data.
  • Build and maintain companion mobile apps and device-to-companion integration, including pairing, transfer, and shared data contracts.
  • Meet device performance targets for cold boot, profile switching, and camera initialization.
  • Use the device GPU and NPU appropriately for imaging and AR work while managing memory and power limits.
  • Turn product-level requirements into clear engineering work, owning the technical “how.”
  • Bring strong engineering and UX judgment to the work, rather than building only what is explicitly written.
  • Write typed, tested, maintainable Kotlin that follows the existing codebase conventions.
  • Verify every feature on real hardware before handoff and catch issues before QA.
  • Conduct code reviews and set the review bar for Android work.
  • Lead the Android work technically and raise the capability of the intermediate developer on the project.
  • Establish the patterns and abstractions other Android work builds on.
  • Size your work in points, commit within the monthly delivery cycle, and reliably deliver what you planned.
  • Time-box spikes to resolve genuine hardware unknowns before they become delivery risks.
  • Use AI coding tools and agents thoughtfully to increase throughput and quality.
  • Keep engineering judgment in control of the final output.
  • Plan and sequence your work across the device and companion-app surface.
  • Surface risks and tradeoffs early, and communicate proactively across a remote team.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years building production Android applications in Kotlin.
  • Deep, current Android platform expertise.
  • Hands-on experience building Android for custom, embedded, or non-phone hardware.
  • Experience integrating device hardware such as cameras, sensors, peripherals, or physical controls.
  • Experience designing offline-first or local-data architectures with future sync in mind.
  • Connectivity experience with Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, OTA updates, or device pairing.
  • A track record of owning Android architecture end-to-end as a senior engineer.
  • Strong judgment in resolving open technical decisions and owning tradeoffs.
  • Strong Android fundamentals: lifecycle, state management, performance, and memory.
  • Experience taking ambiguous requirements through to production on real hardware.
  • A strong quality discipline: typed, tested code and on-device verification before QA.
  • Ability to estimate your work, commit within a delivery cycle, and reliably deliver.
  • Excellent professional English, spoken and written.
  • Strong written communication and proactive, independent work in a fully remote team.
  • Reliable overlap with standard US Central Time business hours.
  • Fluent, practical use of AI coding tools as part of your engineering workflow.
  • Based in Latin America and able to work as an independent contractor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Platform or OS-adjacent work: AOSP-level engineering, native C/C++ via the NDK/JNI, or custom ROM or HAL work.
  • Multi-camera work with Camera2 or CameraX, on-device computer vision, or ML and AR using the device GPU/NPU.
  • Bluetooth audio (A2DP/HFP), Matter, or Thread.
  • Experience building or operating an OTA update pipeline.
  • Companion app and device-pairing experience.
  • Mentoring or technical leadership of other engineers.
  • A portfolio, GitHub, or code samples you can share.

You do not need to check every single box to apply. We know strong engineers bring the right experience in different ways. If you have built Android on real devices or embedded hardware, take real ownership of the architecture, and want to do it at AI-native speed, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Join Olsson's Federal Engineering & Design Team as a Project Manager I, where you will help deliver infrastructure projects for federal clients. In this role, you will coordinate with multidisciplinary teams supporting the planning, design, and construction of mission-critical facilities for military installations, VA campuses, and other government agencies. These projects require technical accuracy, strong organization, and consistent collaboration.

As a Project Manager I, you will manage projects or support project managers on larger or multidisciplinary assignments. You will participate throughout the project life cycle by helping establish scope, schedule, budget, quality expectations, and project documentation while developing your project management capabilities.

You will work with internal technical teams, clients, and federal stakeholders to support compliance with UFC, DoD, VA, and other applicable federal standards. You will also assist with proposals, project controls, and process improvements that strengthen our federal design capabilities and support successful project delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A minimum of four years of project experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry.
  • Active Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain a PE license is preferred.
  • Experience supporting engineering or design projects from planning through delivery; federal project exposure is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of project scope, schedule, budget, quality, documentation, and basic project financials.
  • Strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and client service skills.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple priorities, follow established project management practices, and escalate risks or changes appropriately.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical professionals across disciplines and build productive relationships with clients and stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Manage defined-scope federal projects and support larger or multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Assist with defining and communicating project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, and budgets in coordination with technical teams, clients, and contractors.
  • Track project progress, resource needs, costs, and financial performance; identify variances and communicate potential impacts to the project manager or appropriate leader.
  • Help organize project teams by aligning technical expertise, assignments, and schedules with project goals and federal requirements.
  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for assigned project matters while maintaining clear communication with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
  • Support compliance with UFC, DoD, VA, and other applicable federal standards, contract requirements, and established quality procedures.
  • Identify potential risks, scope changes, schedule concerns, and additional costs; document issues and assist with developing mitigation strategies.
  • Assist with contracts, change documentation, billing coordination, and other project administration under the guidance of more experienced project managers.
  • Plan, organize, and facilitate routine project meetings; document decisions, action items, responsibilities, and follow-up needs.
  • Maintain project records and assist with the preparation and delivery of project documentation, including design plans, specifications, correspondence, cost information, and performance records.

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

  • Receive a competitive 401(k) match
  • Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths
  • Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements
  • Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities
  • Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance.

Olsson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage qualified minority, female, veteran, and disabled candidates to apply and be considered for open positions. We do not discriminate against any applicant for employment or any employee because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender, disability, age, military status, or other protected status.

Olsson understands the importance of privacy and is committed to protecting job applicants’ personal information. Pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (collectively, the “CCPA”), this notice explains Olsson’s practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information for job applicants residing in California. Please read this Notice carefully to understand our privacy practices.

jobs.description:
About the COOL company

The COOL company is a global leader in AI-powered advertising technology, helping brands, agencies, and publishers simplify advertising and amplify performance.

Powered by COOL AI, our intelligent platform unifies creative generation, media activation, optimization, and attribution into one continuously learning system. Instead of relying on fragmented tools and manual campaign management, COOL AI executes thousands of real-time micro-optimizations across search, social, display, video, and connected TV—helping customers launch faster, optimize continuously, and achieve stronger business outcomes.

Our innovation and growth have earned industry-wide recognition, including being named a 7-time recipient of the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies, a 2-time Deloitte Technology Fast 500 honoree, recognized on Crain's New York Fast 50, honored by the Digiday Media Awards for helping modernize digital media, and named one of Adweek's Top 10 Fastest Growing Solution Providers globally.

We're building the future of advertising, where every signal becomes intelligence and every optimization drives performance. As we continue to grow globally, we're looking for curious, ambitious people who want to work with cutting-edge AI technology, solve complex challenges, and help redefine what's possible in modern advertising.

About the Role

The COOL Company is seeking an experienced, hands-on Assistant Controller to help lead our accounting and financial reporting function as the organization continues to scale.

Reporting to the CFO, the Assistant Controller will oversee day-to-day accounting operations, support the monthly close and consolidated financial reporting process, lead and develop members of the accounting team, and help strengthen the Company's financial systems, processes, and controls.

The ideal candidate combines strong U.S. GAAP and technical accounting expertise with proven leadership capabilities and experience operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. This individual should be comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies and have the financial acumen to support financial analysis, forecasting, and key business metrics.

We are looking for a modern, technology-oriented finance professional who combines strong accounting fundamentals with a continuous-improvement mindset and an interest in using systems, automation, and AI to build a more scalable finance organization.

This is a hands-on role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between reviewing consolidated financial results, resolving technical accounting matters, managing the close, developing team members, improving processes, and working directly in the underlying details when necessar

Responsibilities and Duties

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Lead day-to-day accounting operations and support a timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual close.

  • Prepare and review consolidated financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

  • Oversee accounting across multiple legal entities, business units, and currencies.

  • Manage multi-entity consolidation and foreign currency accounting, including transaction remeasurement, balance sheet translation, intercompany activity, and related foreign exchange gains and losses.

  • Oversee and review balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and other close activities.

  • Oversee revenue recognition, accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, and other core accounting functions.

  • Support appropriate accounting treatment and documentation for new, unusual, or complex business transactions.

  • Maintain and continuously improve the Company's chart of accounts, accounting policies, close procedures, and financial reporting processes.

  • Support annual audit and tax activities and work directly with external auditors, tax professionals, and other advisors.

  • Help maintain and strengthen an effective internal control environment appropriate for a growing organization.

  • Ensure financial reporting is accurate, consistent, appropriately documented, and delivered on a timely basis.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and development to members of the accounting and finance team.

  • Establish clear ownership, accountability, and performance expectations.

  • Review the work of team members while remaining willing to work directly in the details when necessary.

  • Help develop team capabilities and create opportunities for professional growth.

  • Build scalable processes while maintaining the flexibility required in a fast-paced organization.

  • Partner effectively with Sales, Operations, HR, Technology, and other business functions.

  • Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Financial Planning & Business Analytics

  • Partner with the CFO on budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.

  • Support FP&A analyses, including budget-to-actual reporting, variance analysis, revenue and margin analysis, and operating expense management.

  • Help develop, maintain, and monitor key financial and operating metrics.

  • Assist in translating financial results into meaningful insights for senior leadership.

  • Identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities and proactively communicate findings to the CFO.

  • Support scenario modeling and analyses related to strategic and operational business decisions.

  • Help ensure consistency between accounting results, management reporting, forecasts, and operating metrics.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the underlying drivers of the business rather than focusing solely on historical accounting results.

Systems, Processes & Scalability

  • Continuously improve financial processes, systems, automation, and reporting.

  • Help ensure the finance infrastructure can support increasing transaction volume, geographic expansion, new products, and organizational growth.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and increase efficiency.

  • Evaluate opportunities to utilize AI-enabled tools and automation to improve finance and accounting efficiency, accuracy, reporting, and insight.

  • Participate in and potentially lead ERP implementation, optimization, integration, and enhancement projects.

  • Partner with internal teams and external providers on financial system architecture, data flows, and integrations.

  • Improve the availability, consistency, and reliability of financial and operational data.

  • Help establish scalable financial policies and procedures without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Qualifications

  • 7–10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including meaningful experience in a senior accounting, accounting manager, or Assistant Controller-level role.

  • CPA preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-entity consolidation and foreign currency accounting.

  • Experience working in a startup, high-growth, or similarly fast-paced environment.

  • Proven experience leading, developing, and managing accounting or finance team members.

  • Experience managing or playing a significant leadership role in the monthly close and consolidated financial reporting process.

  • Strong understanding of financial controls, audit requirements, and accounting policies.

  • Ability to support and contribute to FP&A, financial metrics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

  • Strong Excel, financial systems, and data-analysis capabilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain financial concepts to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify problems, develop practical solutions, and drive projects through completion.

  • A hands-on mindset and willingness to work directly in the details when necessary.

Professional Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and demonstrated technical accounting capabilities

  • Proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accounting team members accountable

  • Ability to move beyond accounting results and understand variance analysis, margins, forecasts, KPIs, and underlying business drivers.

Cultural Competencies

jobs.title: Director, Accounting
jobs.excerpt: Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success.
jobs.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We’re looking for a Director, Accounting to own day-to-day accounting and treasury operations, reporting to the Controller.

The impact you’ll make:

A Mission Lane customer trusts that when they make a payment, it’s recorded right, that their balance reflects reality, and that the company behind their card is solid enough to keep showing up for them next month and the month after that. None of that happens on its own. It’s built close by close, reconciliation by reconciliation, by an accounting team getting the details exactly right. The Director, Accounting owns that foundation, keeping the numbers behind every customer’s progress ready to stand up to scrutiny.

In your first year, you’ll take full operational ownership of the day-to-day close and treasury accounting, tightening the close calendar and refining internal controls, audit readiness, and AI-enabled workflows toward IPO readiness demands. You’ll do that by:

  • Leading the month-end close, from pre-close prep through balance sheet reconciliations and flux analysis, shrinking the calendar as you progress
  • Owning the monthly consolidation across our multi-entity structure, keeping intercompany eliminations clean and GAAP compliance airtight
  • Directing the annual financial statement audit as our primary external liaison, managing the PBC list and keeping the whole lifecycle on schedule
  • Serving as the go-to partner for our external tax advisors and for Treasury on settlement accounting, restricted cash classifications, and reserve calculations
  • Bringing AI agents into journal entries, reconciliations, and variance reporting, turning the close into something faster and sharper rather than just another deadline
  • Building and developing a small, high-performing accounting team, working alongside them as a player-coach rather than directing from a distance

You’ll thrive in this role if:

  • You’ve run a multi-entity close from the inside and know exactly where the friction points hide.
  • You get real satisfaction from turning a messy reconciliation into a clean one, and from teaching someone else how to do the same.
  • You can lead a team through real process and culture change without losing their trust, even when the change touches how they’ve worked for years.
  • You see AI as a way to make your team’s work better, not a threat to it, and know how to bring skeptics along.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Active CPA and a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and financial management experience, including 5+ years leading a team
  • Deep, hands-on experience with month-end close, financial consolidation, and GAAP compliance in a multi-entity organization
  • Direct experience leading external financial statement audits end to end, including PBC management
  • Working knowledge of the COSO framework and PCAOB standards related to ICFR, with experience designing and testing internal controls
  • Proficiency with NetSuite or a comparable enterprise ERP, plus advanced Excel

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in financial services, consumer lending, or credit card issuing and servicing, especially with sponsor bank models, card networks, or payment processors
  • Experience with Snowflake, SQL, or a BI tool like Tableau
  • A track record of bringing AI or automation into accounting workflows

Compensation:

Annual full-time starting base salary range: $158,000 - $213,000

This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.

Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

About Mission Lane:

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.

Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Mission Lane provides reasonable accommodations to applicants who need them for medical or religious reasons, as required by law. Applicants can initiate an accommodation request by contacting .

Our cardholders trust us with their financial well-being, and this trust starts with the integrity of the people on our team. We're looking for team members who share our dedication to transparency and truth. Please verify that the information in your application is accurate and complete.

Providing any information to Mission Lane that is not completely truthful at any point during the application or hiring process may result in removal from the hiring process, disqualification from future opportunities, withdrawal of an offer or other sanctions for candidates and, in addition for employees, disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

Working closely with radiologists, application vendors, IT teams and other internal stakeholders, you'll help ensure our systems and workflows operate effectively and continue to meet the needs of the business.

You'll bring your knowledge of PACS and radiology environments to help us optimise existing applications, support integrations and identify opportunities for continuous improvement as we continue to evolve the way radiology services are delivered.

  • Work with stakeholders to identify, analyse and implement opportunities for improvement

We're looking for a collaborative and solutions-focused professional who combines strong technical capability with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Why Join IDX?

You'll work with a diverse group of clinical, operational and technology professionals, have exposure to business-critical applications and contribute to improvements in the technology and workflows that underpin the delivery of radiology services.


If you're an experienced PACS professional who enjoys solving complex problems, improving clinical workflows and working closely with stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to join IDX and help us continue to transform the way radiology is delivered.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.excerpt: The QA & Compliance Officer will work within the QA & Compliance department, supporting a wide range of compliance activities across the Software and DevOps teams.
jobs.description:
The QA & Compliance Officer will work within the QA & Compliance department, supporting a wide range of compliance activities across the Software and DevOps teams.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires excellent communication skills and the confidence to engage with colleagues at all levels of the organisation. The role holder will help ensure that agreed standards, processes and procedures are understood, followed and evidenced, carrying out regular checks and audits and working constructively with teams to address any areas requiring attention.

The role does not require a technical background; however, the successful candidate will need to develop a good understanding of how our Software and DevOps teams operate, the processes they follow and the systems they use. They will need to be comfortable asking questions, challenging where appropriate and ensuring that compliance requirements are consistently applied.

A significant part of the role will involve creating, reviewing and maintaining process and procedure documentation, ensuring that guidance remains clear, accurate and up to date.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance & Assurance

  • Support the QA & Compliance department with the day-to-day management of compliance activities across Software and DevOps.

  • Carry out detailed compliance checks and audits of work undertaken by teams, using systems including AIDP, SysAid and DevOps.

  • Review evidence to ensure that required processes and procedures have been followed and appropriately documented.

  • Identify areas where compliance requirements have not been met and work with the relevant individuals and teams to understand and resolve issues.

  • Follow up on agreed actions to ensure they are completed within appropriate timescales.

  • Help promote a strong culture of compliance and continuous improvement across the department.

  • Communicate compliance requirements clearly and confidently to colleagues at all levels.

  • Provide practical guidance and support to teams to help them understand and meet their compliance responsibilities.

Processes & Procedures

  • Create clear, practical and easy-to-follow procedure guides for processes across the department.

  • Review and maintain existing procedures, ensuring they remain accurate and reflect current working practices.

  • Work with process owners and subject matter experts to understand how activities are performed and translate this into effective documented procedures.

  • Regularly review documentation to identify where processes or guidance require updating.

  • Ensure documentation is appropriately controlled, maintained and available to the teams who need it.

  • Support teams in improving the consistency and quality of their documented processes.

ISO & ISMS Support

  • Support the ongoing operation and maintenance of the company's Integrated Management System (ISMS).

  • Work with departments and teams across the organisation to support compliance with applicable ISO standards.

  • Assist with the maintenance and updating of the ISO Toolbox and associated compliance records.

  • Support activities within Vanta, ensuring required evidence, actions and information are maintained and kept up to date.

  • Assist with monitoring and progressing company objectives relating to the management system.

  • Support the management and tracking of Corrective Actions, Opportunities for Improvement (OFIs) and non-conformities (NCs).

  • Work with relevant owners to ensure actions arising from compliance activities are appropriately documented, progressed and closed.

  • Help identify opportunities to strengthen processes, controls and ways of working.

Internal & External Audits

  • Support the preparation and coordination of internal and external ISO audits.

  • Assist with gathering, reviewing and organising evidence required for audits.

  • Work with teams across the department to ensure they are prepared for audit activities and understand what is required of them.

  • Participate in audit activities where required, providing supporting information and evidence.

  • Support the recording, communication and tracking of findings and actions arising from audits.

  • Help ensure that audit actions are progressed and completed within agreed timescales.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Confident communicating and building effective working relationships with people at all levels of an organisation.

  • Strong written skills with the ability to create clear, concise and easy-to-follow process and procedure documentation.

  • Good attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies, gaps or areas where agreed processes have not been followed.

  • Organised and methodical, with the ability to manage multiple compliance activities and follow actions through to completion.

  • Comfortable reviewing detailed information and evidence across a range of systems.

  • Able to ask appropriate questions and constructively challenge where standards or processes have not been followed.

  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across multiple teams.

  • A proactive approach to maintaining and improving processes and documentation.

  • Comfortable learning new systems, processes and terminology.

Desirable

  • Previous experience within a compliance, quality assurance, governance, audit or process-focused role.

  • Experience creating and maintaining policies, procedures, process guides or other controlled documentation.

  • An understanding of ISO standards and management systems.

  • Experience supporting internal or external audits.

  • Experience working with corrective actions, non-conformities or continuous improvement activities.

  • Experience using compliance, ticketing, development or work-management systems such as Vanta, SysAid or DevOps.

  • Previous experience working alongside Software, Development, QA or DevOps teams would be advantageous, although a technical background is not required.

Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

  • Approachable and confident – comfortable engaging with colleagues across the organisation and building positive working relationships.

  • A strong communicator – able to explain requirements clearly both verbally and in writing.

  • Detail focused – able to review work carefully and identify where evidence, documentation or processes do not meet the required standard.

  • Constructively challenging – willing to question and challenge when necessary while maintaining positive relationships with teams.

  • Organised – able to manage multiple activities, actions and deadlines without losing sight of the detail.

  • Curious – interested in understanding how teams and processes work rather than simply checking whether a box has been ticked.

  • Practical – able to interpret compliance requirements and help teams understand how they apply to their day-to-day work.

  • Proactive – able to identify areas requiring attention and take ownership of progressing them.

  • Continuous improvement focused – always looking for opportunities to make processes clearer, stronger and more effective.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means that Software and DevOps teams have clear, accurate and up-to-date procedures, compliance requirements are well understood, and regular checks provide confidence that agreed processes are being followed.

The role holder will build strong relationships across the department, becoming a trusted point of contact for compliance activities while being confident enough to challenge when required. Audit evidence and management system records will be well maintained, actions will be actively followed through, and the department will remain well prepared for both internal and external audits.

Ultimately, the role will help ensure that compliance is embedded into everyday ways of working rather than treated simply as an audit activity.

jobs.excerpt: About PeregrinePeregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes.
jobs.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the environments, the deployment path, and the platform operations beneath production data products for a federal agency. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are.

This is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms. It also requires the ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you building the environments and the deployment automation the rest of the team builds on, and supporting them through cutover. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Stand up and maintain the Azure Databricks environments, including the access, secrets, and networking they depend on.
  • Build the deployment automation that promotes work between environments, using Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles), infrastructure as code, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI and CD) pipelines.
  • Tune Delta pipelines and platform performance.
  • Run platform operations, and write the runbooks that let someone else operate what you built.
  • Support environment parity, migration, and cutover alongside the Databricks team, under Peregrine change control, including bindings, rollback, and the evidence a release review needs.

You deliver environments that behave the same way twice and a deployment path the team can use without asking you. You automate the promotion, checks, and evidence that would otherwise be assembled by hand before every release, and you leave the runbooks and controls that keep the platform supportable after cutover.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of platform engineering, DevSecOps, or cloud infrastructure experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Hands-on Azure Databricks platform work, including Unity Catalog and Delta pipeline performance
  • Deployment automation and environment promotion, including infrastructure as code and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI and CD) pipelines
  • Cloud networking, secrets management, and least-privilege access design in a governed environment
  • Platform operations for a production data platform
  • Migration and cutover support, including environment parity, rollback planning, and the evidence a release review asks for
  • Scripting in Python and Git-based version control; Bash is a plus
  • Platform or DevSecOps work in at least one cloud environment other than Databricks, for example Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud
  • Delivery experience in a federal government environment, working to its security, access, and review processes
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel
  • United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms
  • The ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements

Preferred

  • Experience on a federal system accredited at Impact Level 5 (IL-5) or higher
  • Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles), Terraform, or Azure DevOps pipelines
  • Databricks certification, or an Azure or Amazon Web Services cloud certification
  • Federal security experience supporting compliance frameworks, security controls, and authorization evidence
  • Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted developer tooling

Who you are

You treat the platform as a product the team depends on, and you would rather automate a step than document a workaround for it. You think in environments, permissions, and failure modes, and you check that a change behaves the same way in the next environment as it did in the last one. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • Hands-on work with Azure Databricks environments, including Unity Catalog and Delta performance.
  • The deployment craft around the platform, including infrastructure as code, environment promotion, and release automation.
  • Working depth in a second cloud platform, so you can judge a design on its tradeoffs rather than one vendor's defaults.
  • The operations discipline that migration and cutover demand, including parity, rollback, and evidence.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a Python coding exercise.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Data Engineer I/II - Data Analytics & Solutions (DAS) — LIS ART, Retail Solutions

We are seeking a data-driven, detail-oriented Data Engineer II to join Mutual of Omaha's Data Analytics & Solutions (DAS) team, part of the LIS Agile Release Train within the Retail Solutions segment. This role is a strong fit for a data engineering professional who wants hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and room to grow into a more senior engineering track.

The DAS team owns the data behind the scenes for our retail applications and reporting teams. You'll support production data systems, build and maintain ETL pipelines, and help lead the team's ongoing migration of our data warehouse from Teradata to Snowflake, with AWS Glue and continued mainframe decommissioning on the roadmap for the next 6–12 months.

This role will partner closely with other engineering, BA, and reporting teams that consume DAS owned data, including application teams like the Data Integration Hub, to keep data flowing reliably across the business.

We're looking for someone who already has hands-on data engineering experience and is comfortable working with real autonomy. This team moves quickly and gives engineers real ownership.

If you're energized by hands-on data engineering, cross-functional collaboration, and helping modernize a growing data platform, we encourage you to apply.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary:
    • Data Engineer I: $110,000 - $116,000
    • Data Engineer II: $130,000 – $135,000
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Primarily remote, with periodic onsite collaboration for team-building sessions and PI planning (up to four times a year).

This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as PI planning, team-building sessions, or other business-critical meetings.

  • Build, debug, and maintain ETL pipelines that move and transform data across the team's supported systems.

  • Support the active migration from Teradata to Snowflake — tracing source tables in Teradata, building equivalent Snowflake tables, and ensuring downstream consumers see a seamless transition.

  • Partner with other engineering, BA, and reporting teams that consume DAS-owned data, including application teams (e.g., the Data Integration Hub) that call on DAS data behind the scenes.
  • Participate in a daily 30-minute developer collaboration session to raise blockers and work through problems with the team.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning (roughly every 3 weeks) and PI planning.

  • Help lead and mentor other developers through technical challenges.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in data engineering / data systems development, or equivalent.
  • Advanced SQL knowledge, including writing and maintaining stored procedures.
  • Hands-on experience across multiple relational/data-warehouse platforms: Teradata, Snowflake, Oracle, and DB2.
  • Strong ETL experience, proficient with ETL tooling such as Informatica / IDMC.
  • Working knowledge of Unix scripting, sufficient to understand and support existing scripts.
  • Understanding of data warehouse concepts and cloud data environments.
  • Familiarity with GitHub for source control.
  • Strong debugging skills to support production issues.
  • Experience working on an Agile team.
  • Willingness to learn AWS and AWS Glue, and to pick up new ETL technologies as the team modernizes.
  • Able to work independently with minimal oversight — this team runs with a high degree of autonomy, so self-driven, decisive contributors do best here.
  • Able to work remotely, with the ability to travel onsite for team events up to four times a year.
  • Participation in an on-call rotation shared with the team, roughly every 5–6 weeks (one week as primary, following week as backup); after-hours pages are infrequent.

PREFERRED:

  • SAFe Agile experience.
  • Exposure to Control-M or similar job-scheduling tools.
  • Windows scripting, in addition to Unix.
  • Familiarity with mainframe environments.
  • API integration experience.
  • Located near the Mutual of Omaha office.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

jobs.description:
Applied AI Architect (Data, Systems & Governance) | Brillio

Architect the Foundations of Enterprise AI

Brillio is looking for an Applied AI Architect who can turn ambitious AI strategies into secure, scalable, enterprise-ready systems.

You'll help determine how AI solutions should be designed, what models should power them, how enterprise data should flow through them, and how they can operate safely within highly regulated environments.

About Brillio

Brillio is one of the fastest-growing digital technology service providers, helping Fortune 1000 organizations turn disruption into competitive advantage through innovative digital adoption.

Our professionals combine deep technology expertise, design thinking, and a strong commitment to client success to deliver transformative outcomes.

Brillio is recognized year after year as a Great Place to Work®, giving talented technology professionals the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and solve complex, high-impact business challenges.

The Role

As an Applied AI Architect, you'll own the technical foundations that make enterprise AI possible.

You'll bring together data architecture, AI/ML systems, cloud platforms, enterprise integration, security, privacy, and governance to design solutions that can move beyond experimentation and into production.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Design target architectures and scalable data pipelines for enterprise AI systems
  • Architect ETL/ELT, feature stores, vector databases, knowledge layers, and AI data pipelines
  • Evaluate and select AI models based on use case, performance, cost, latency, security, and governance requirements
  • Design AI solutions that integrate with enterprise platforms including EHRs, core banking systems, CRM platforms, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Define and implement AI governance, compliance, privacy, and responsible AI frameworks
  • Translate regulatory requirements into concrete technical and architectural controls
  • Embed security, privacy, IAM, and data residency requirements from day one
  • Design production environments across platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI
  • Partner closely with AI Builders and Value Engineers throughout the lifecycle — from discovery through production
  • Establish the foundations for MLOps, CI/CD, model lifecycle management, observability, monitoring, and evaluation
  • Help move AI solutions from proof-of-concept into secure, scalable production environments

Job Requirements:

  • Strong experience as an AI, ML, Data, Solutions, or Enterprise Architect, with hands-on experience designing and deploying AI solutions.
  • Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, AI orchestration, and modern AI architectures.
  • Experience designing enterprise data architectures, pipelines, integrations, and scalable AI platforms.
  • Experience evaluating AI models and understanding the tradeoffs between commercial and open-source models, as well as RAG versus fine-tuning.
  • Experience with platforms and frameworks such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, LangGraph, and LangChain.
  • Experience integrating AI with enterprise systems and APIs. Healthcare experience with FHIR/HL7, Epic, or Oracle is a plus, as is financial services experience with payment data and core banking platforms.
  • Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience working within regulated environments, with exposure to requirements such as HIPAA, GxP/CSV, AML, Basel III, or SR 11-7 highly desirable.
  • Experience with enterprise security concepts including PHI/PII governance, data residency, VPC deployment, IAM, access control, and model inference security.
  • Experience with production AI engineering, including CI/CD, MLOps, model registries, monitoring, observability, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical, business, security, and regulatory requirements into clear architectural decisions.

If you're an architect who understands both the possibilities of AI and the realities of enterprise technology, security, data, and regulation, this is an opportunity to have a major impact.

Join Brillio and help build the foundations for enterprise AI.

Als Principal Consultant verantworten Sie komplexe Projekte und Programmteile über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg – von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur Implementierung und dem Go-live.

Sorgen Sie dafür, dass Veränderungen nachhaltig wirken: Sie analysieren bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse, erkennen Optimierungspotenziale und entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Lösungen. Seien Sie die Person, der unsere Kunden vertrauen: Sie sind auf Projektebene die zentrale Ansprechperson und arbeiten an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, IT und Management. Sie leiten Workshops, führen Interviews und übersetzen die Anforderungen interdisziplinärer Teams in praxistaugliche Konzepte.

Gestalten Sie Compliance praxisnah: Sie beraten zu regulatorischen Anforderungen und Best Practices im Life-Sciences-Umfeld und entwickeln pragmatische Lösungen, die regulatorischen Anforderungen gerecht werden.

Gestalten Sie unser Wachstum mit: Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung in Presales-Aktivitäten, Angebotserstellungen und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios ein. Teilen Sie Ihr Wissen: Sie unterstützen die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Consultants, engagieren sich in unseren Communities of Practice und gestalten unser Beratungsangebot im Bereich Quality aktiv mit.

Zeigen Sie Präsenz in der Branche: Sie repräsentieren MAIN5 auf Konferenzen, Kundenveranstaltungen und Branchenevents.

ihr profil

Für die Position als Principal Consultant: Sie haben Freude an der geschäftlichen Seite der Beratung. Kundenbeziehungen weiterzuentwickeln und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen, ist für Sie der natürliche nächste Schritt.

Sie arbeiten gerne remote und wissen, wie Sie auch in einem verteilten Team gut vernetzt bleiben und erfolgreich zusammenarbeiten.

warum wir?

Warum MAIN5?

jobs.description:
For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

Our Commercial Lines team is currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst in our Worcester, MA location. Position is eligible for Hybrid/Flex work arrangement or remote location. This is a full-time, exempt role.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Incumbents serving in the Business Analysis job family are responsible for the collection, development, analysis, documentation, and communication of business needs and requirements. Throughout an assignment, Business Analysts may act like a liaison while they interface and work collaboratively with technology and business organizations. Business Analysts usually assess the needs of the assignment by directly interacting with management, leadership, technology, the business and the customer. Business Analysts are also expected to use their working understanding of information systems, business operations, and processes to analyze requirements, develop specifications, story-boarding and prototyping to facilitate the design of integrated solutions. Their knowledge of business analysis, business processes and project methodologies is applied to all of their assignments. Incumbents in this job family must have a solid understanding of their business partners existing business processes, the key drivers and measures of success for the business, and the short and long-term direction of the business and technology. They assess the needs of a business partner through direct interaction, and look for opportunities to develop and grow the business through effective use of technology. They take a broad perspective to determine how solutions will impact existing work processes and systems, and how to manage the integration. Incumbents must be innovative in identifying, proposing and executing solutions, negotiating requirements across multiple partners or departments, and must have an understanding of project scope management and prototyping. Business Analysts should have a high-level understanding of the overall IT architecture in order to understand the issues and implications of proposed system and hardware solutions.

SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST PROJECT COMPLEXITY:

  • Performs work across multiple initiatives and processes.
  • Supports and/or leads highly complex business/technical processes or multiple products, requiring design or integration of technical solutions across multiple departments or lines of business.

  • Acts as a resource to less experienced personnel in the application and execution of Best Practices.
  • Recommending improvements to Best Practices procedures.
  • Working with business partners to define needs to align with business priorities and assess impact on other business processes.
  • Leading requirements gathering sessions to identify and articulate needs/requirements i.e. JAD sessions, story-boarding.
  • Advising business partners on options, technical limitations, risks and cost vs. benefits and ensuring a structured requirements process for the business is adhered to.
  • Leading the development, of structured requirements gathering through various techniques i.e. JAD and storyboarding for the design and implementation of solutions.
