  • May provide support through the warranty period.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

TYPICAL EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Typically requires seven to ten years of relevant technical and business work experience.
  • Requires /in-depth knowledge of business operations, requirements processing, business modeling concepts, information systems and project life-cycle knowledge, and business process development.
  • Knowledge of Industry Business Analysis Best Practices preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field specialized training, certification or equivalent work experience.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES:

  • Analytical Thinking: Applies analytical techniques, e.g., separating a complex whole into its parts or elements to resolve problems or issues.
  • Communication for Results: Expresses technical and business concepts, ideas, feelings, opinions, and conclusions, so that others understand or are persuaded to act. Creates an environment that encourages and values the opinions of others and promotes sharing of information and ideas.
  • Conceptual Thinking: Synthesizes facts, trends, inferences, and key issues and/or themes in complex situations Recognizes patterns and relationships between apparently unrelated entities or situations consulting: Uses professional or technical expertise to advise, intervene, and/or influence a customer or internal partner over whom there is no direct authority.
  • Information Seeking: Thoroughly investigates and researches multiple sources to expose details and complete information about resources, issues, and problems and so forth Involves in-depth research, asking probing questions and transcending surface issues.
  • Innovation: Motivated to improve organizational performance through the introduction of new ideas, methods, processes, products, services, and so forth develops new ways of looking at a situation.
  • Mentoring/Developing Others: Shares knowledge, skills or expertise with others; coaches others. Encourages and rewards learning, growth, etc., in others. Creates an environment where employee ownership of self-development is encouraged supports continual development of staff through assignments, coaching, and training.
  • Relationship Building: Understands the importance of developing and maintaining cooperative relationships with others at all levels of the organization by making others feel their concerns and contributions are important builds positive relationships with others to accomplish organizational goals.
  • Self-Management: Effectively plans and organizes their work to achieve desired outcomes Demonstrates flexibility in applying different approaches to changing work demands is confident of own abilities to meet challenges and can maintain performance under stress seeks improvement through learning, development and feedback. Business Function Knowledge: An understanding of business functions and the corresponding strategies, benefits, risks, and costs that impact the business. Example business functions include: IT, marketing, sales, finance, HR, and engineering. Business
  • Operations Analysis: Analyzes the business impact of markets, trends, issues, technologies, economies, and competition applies that analysis to business issues and challenges.

Understands and can delineate technical design requirements for supporting information systems. Business Data Requirements Knowledge: Analyzes data requirements based on knowledge of client data needs, and defines the critical data components to be incorporated into information delivery vehicles.

jobs.description:
We, at Leggett & Platt Inc., are searching for a Voice Engineer II within our Corporate ITteam to help support our business. As a global-diversified manufacturing company, it’s sometimes hard to explain all the different things we do. We like to say, “we’re the biggest company no one has ever heard of.” We are confident you interact with one of our products in your daily life without knowing it. Whether it’s the mattress you sleep on, the car you drive, the plane you fly on, or the furniture you sit on, our high-quality components are there supporting you. If you join our team, your work will ensure people across the world have a little more comfort in their lives.

As a Voice Engineer II you will have the opportunity to support the design, implementation, migration, and operation of enterprise voice and unified communications solutions. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the business by serving as a key technical contributor for voice transformation initiatives, including migrations from legacy PBX, TDM, and analog environments to Microsoft Teams Voice and centralized SIP-based communications platforms.

The ideal candidate has experience with Microsoft Teams Voice, Direct Routing, AudioCodes SBCs and gateways, Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Avaya, Mitel, SIP technologies, and enterprise voice troubleshooting. This individual will develop technical documentation, create call flow diagrams, assist with solution design, support migration activities, and help maintain reliable voice services across the organization.

So, what will you be doing as a Voice Engineer II?

  • Support migrations from legacy PBX, TDM, PRI, and analog telephony systems to Microsoft Teams Voice and centralized SIP-based services.
  • Assist with implementing approved voice designs, migration plans, technology upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain high-level designs, low-level designs, call flow diagrams, network diagrams, migration runbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Configure and support Microsoft Teams Phone, including Direct Routing, dial plans, voice routing policies, Auto Attendants, Call Queues, Resource Accounts, and emergency calling policies.
  • Administer and maintain AudioCodes SBCs and gateways supporting Direct Routing, SIP trunking, and enterprise voice services.
  • Support AudioCodes MP-124 and other gateway solutions used to integrate analog and legacy telephony services into SIP-based environments.
  • Assist with migrations and support of analog devices including paging systems, overhead speakers, elevator phones, emergency phones, door phones, alarm dialers, and fax services.
  • Configure and support Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), including SIP trunks, route patterns, translation patterns, calling search spaces, partitions, device pools, and dial plans.
  • Support interoperability and coexistence between Microsoft Teams, Cisco UC platforms, AudioCodes infrastructure, and telecommunications carriers.
  • Assist with E911 and Dynamic Emergency Calling deployments, testing, location management, and ongoing support.
  • Troubleshoot SIP, RTP, SRTP, TLS, voice routing, call quality, codec negotiation, and interoperability issues across voice platforms.
  • Analyze SIP traces, AudioCodes logs, CUCM traces, Teams Call Analytics, CQD reports, and packet captures to identify and resolve service issues.
  • Support SIP trunk deployments, carrier integrations, telephone number porting activities, and transitions from traditional telephony services to SIP architecture.
  • Participate in system upgrades, maintenance windows, firmware updates, testing activities, disaster recovery exercises, and production cutovers.
  • Provide Tier I and Tier II operational support and collaborate with network, security, infrastructure, and carrier teams to maintain highly available voice services.

To be successful in this role, you’ll need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3-5 years of enterprise voice engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Teams Voice and Direct Routing.
  • Experience administering Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM).
  • Experience supporting AudioCodes SBCs and media gateways.
  • Experience with voice migration projects involving PBX, TDM, PRI, analog, or SIP-based technologies.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • SIP
    • RTP/SRTP
    • TLS
    • SIP Trunking
    • PSTN Connectivity
    • Voice Routing
    • QoS
    • VoIP Networking
  • Experience creating technical documentation, call flow diagrams, and implementation procedures.

Things we consider a plus:

  • Microsoft Teams Phone or Teams Voice certifications.
  • Experience with AudioCodes Mediant SBCs, MP-124 gateways, and One Voice Operations Center (OVOC).
  • Experience with analog-to-SIP and TDM-to-SIP migration projects.
  • Knowledge of E911 and Dynamic Emergency Calling.
  • Experience with carrier SIP trunk integrations and Direct Routing deployments.
  • PowerShell scripting experience.
  • Experience using Visio or similar diagramming tools.
  • Knowledge of MPLS, SD-WAN, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and firewall concepts.

What to Do Next

Now that you’ve had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available.

Our Values

Our values speak to our shared beliefs, and describe how we approach working together.

  • Put People First reflects our commitment to safety and care of each other, learning and development, and creating an inclusive environment of mutual respect, empathy and belonging.
  • Do the Right Thing focuses us on acting with honesty and integrity, delivering the results the right way, taking pride in our work, and speaking the truth – good or bad.

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all. Leggett & Platt is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veteran status, and more. Join us!

Jack Westin is a leading Medical College Admissions Test (MCAT) preparation company which is known for crafting high quality, but free, practice materials. Our Three Principles

Attention to quality

We only create courses and practice questions that we would use. That means having the best, first-class teaching content that can possibly exist. We're not satisfied with mediocrity. We're obsessed with our students. Their well-being and success drives us each day. Great customer service is not an afterthought. It is the most important service we can offer. We understand that our students come from different learning backgrounds. It's our mission to ensure that each one has an amazing experience.

Learn from anywhere at anytime

We are committed to building the future of education on the internet so that it is easily accessible to all students from around the world. Our dedication is to all students who want to learn, regardless of their pace, and no matter what time of the day it is.

Dean's Circle Admissions Expert (Part-Time Contract, Per Student)

Department: Medical Admissions

Reports to: Director of Admissions

Office: Remote

Job type: Contract (1099), part-time

Pay: $3,500 per student

Compensation

This is a per-student contract. You are paid $3,500 for each student you support through a full application cycle, released in milestones as the student progresses:

  • $1,000 when the student enrolls
  • $750 when the primary application is submitted
  • $750 when secondary applications are submitted
  • $1,000 when services are complete (end of the application cycle)

Hours are flexible, and you take on students as your availability allows. We ask that you commit to supporting each student through their full application cycle, which can run up to a year. This is a contract role and is not eligible for employee benefits.

Position Summary

The Dean's Circle Admissions Expert provides admissions support for students enrolled in our top tier, high touch Dean's Circle product line. This role is focused on top tier execution and delivery, supporting students with direct edits and reviews (with the support of our Admissions Writing Coaches) and guidance on standard application components, to maximize their chances of acceptance.

You will provide in-depth, long-term admissions guidance for highly selective students, working as part of the Dean's Circle team to maintain excellence, efficiency, and consistency across all deliverables. The role is focused on direct student delivery: advising and reviews. The position requires expertise in admissions advising and the ability to balance individualized student support with consistent, high-quality delivery.

The ideal candidate has substantial experience advising premedical students, working in medical school admissions, or both, coupled with a proven record of student success.

Responsibilities

Student Support

  • Provide one-on-one advising for assigned students applying to medical and other healthcare professional programs (PA, Dental, Pharmacy, Vet, and similar), with a primary focus on medical admissions.
  • Deliver timely, professional essay review, feedback, and support for all application components, including but not limited to:
    • Personal Statements
    • Experiences/Activities and Most Meaningful Experiences
    • Secondary Essays
    • School List Reviews
    • MD/PhD Essays
    • Letters of Intent/Interest
    • Mock Interview Prep
    • Other reviews and client materials as needed, such as review committee support and graduate school insight

Client Service and Oversight

  • Respond to student questions and provide updates within designated timelines, scheduling Zoom support calls as needed.
  • Ensure application tasks, documents, and student responsibilities are completed on time.
  • Manage first-line client service issues with the highest degree of professionalism.
  • Maintain regular, continuous communication with your students to ensure smooth progress and maximize acceptance outcomes.
  • Conduct intake assessments by Zoom, producing detailed written evaluations on application readiness, academic qualifications, and strategies to maximize competitiveness (using our onboarding feedback and opportunities documents; templates provided).
  • Independently schedule and manage student appointments.
  • Track deliverables, applicant timelines, and due dates for your own clients using the team's tracking system, and maintain accurate records of completed edits.
  • Provide excellent customer service so students feel supported throughout their entire package engagement.

Qualifications

  • Required: a minimum of five to eight years of medical admissions committee experience.
  • Medical Degree (MD or DO) desirable. A graduate-level degree (master's or above) is required.
  • Deep knowledge of the premedical path and the medical school admissions process.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple students under tight deadlines and prioritize effectively.
  • Ability to work collaboratively to achieve objectives.

  • Track record of delivering strong customer service and student success, ideally in admissions support.
  • An "always a student" attitude, constantly working to maintain expertise by reading, listening, and conferring with other experts.
  • Technically proficient with strong internet connectivity to support remote advising. Since this is a 100% remote position, high-speed internet with bandwidth to access all tools concurrently is a must.

Description

Grab your cape, become a SuperHyro!

Hyro, the leader in Responsible AI Agents for Healthcare, enables health systems to safely automate workflows and conversations across their most valuable platforms, services, and channels - including call centers, websites, SMS, mobile apps, and more. What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a VP of Account Management to lead Hyro's account management function and own the commercial health of our enterprise health system accounts. This is a revenue-bearing leadership role. You own gross and net revenue retention, you carry the expansion number for the installed base, and you build the team and the operating rhythm that deliver both.

You will establish the foundations of Hyro's account management function, including the coverage model, renewal and expansion playbooks, and forecasting rhythm, while hiring and developing the Account Managers who execute them.   • Implement a structured account planning methodology (such as LAMP) across the AM team to build documented expansion and relationship-deepening paths for every strategic account
  • Lead executive business reviews that quantify ROI, adoption, and patient experience outcomes for senior stakeholders and steering committees

  • Turn AI agent performance in production, including containment, adoption, and conversation quality, into the renewal and expansion case

  • Partner with Sales, Delivery, and Product to convert value realization into growth, and build Hyro's reference and advocacy base

  • 10+ years in enterprise account management, customer success, or strategic sales, including 3+ years leading quota-carrying Account Managers or CSMs selling to Healthcare providers
  • Demonstrated ownership of a retention and growth number: gross retention, net revenue retention, or an expansion quota
  • Track record building and running structured account planning processes (LAMP or similar) that convert relationships into documented expansion paths
  • Proven success selling and expanding B2B SaaS inside complex health systems, with multiple stakeholders, long implementation cycles, and consensus-driven procurement
  • Experience designing and scaling a QBR or executive business review cadence across a team, not just running one personally
  • Experience building the function rather than only running it: playbooks, coverage models, and forecast rhythm
  • Comfort managing cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Product, not just Sales and Delivery
  • Executive presence with C-suite health system stakeholders, and the ability to speak in business outcomes rather than product features
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Proficiency in Salesforce and customer health-score tooling

  • Familiarity with patient access, patient engagement, contact center operations, or revenue cycle inside a health system - advantage
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

This is a remote role working from home with up to 30% travel. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Director, Research Operations

Location:

About the Team

Learning & Assessment is College Board's center for researching, designing, delivering, and strengthening high-quality assessments that serve more than 7+ million students annually and advance opportunities around the world. The division brings together 150+ experts in research, psychometrics, and assessment design and development to ensure our assessments are rigorous, accessible, and grounded in evidence. In close partnership with teams across College Board, Learning & Assessment leads innovation in assessment design, ensures valid, reliable, and error-free scores, and provides the evidence and insights that guide program strategy and shape understanding of important issues in the education sector.

The Research Team designs, conducts, and disseminates research and analyses to drive decision-making within College Board and by external stakeholders. The department includes 30+ interdisciplinary experts from education, economics, political science, psychology, public policy, sociology, and survey research. Our data and evidence address topics related to College Board assessments, programs, and initiatives as well as pressing questions in the broader education ecosystem. We influence a wide array of practitioners, policymakers, and the academic research community through publications spanning academic journal articles, reports, research briefs, and applied data tools.

About the Opportunity

Research is continuing to evolve, supporting a growing portfolio of analytics and evidence designed to be actionable and influential for decisionmakers across K12, higher ed, and policy at the federal, state, district, and institutional levels. As the scale and complexity of this work increases, there is an opportunity to strengthen the operational backbone that enables consistent delivery, cross-team coherence, and future-focused evolution—while preserving deep expertise and technical leadership.

The Director, Research Operations provides function-wide operational leadership to support this evolution. This role establishes prioritization mechanisms, builds a coherent cross-team operating model, and establishes and maintains an actionable evidence base that includes both internal and external research evidence. The Director reports to the Vice President, Research and partners closely with Executive Directors, who serve as the technical leaders for research, to ensure work is delivered effectively and sustainably while creating space for forward-looking technical leadership and expertise. The scope of this role is focused on building sustainable operational infrastructure and team capacity, rather than owning research projects. 

In this role, you will:

Coordinate the Research Portfolio (50%)

  • Build and maintain infrastructure to track and manage progress toward goals that gives the Vice President and Executive Directors real-time visibility to help drive decisions and course-corrections to stay on track to achieve outcomes.
  • Refine and maintain the cross-team internal operating infrastructure, including portfolio tracking, cross-team communications, publication management, data/vendor/budget administration, reporting tools, and transparency tools.
  • Reinforce clear accountability, role clarity, timing expectations, and execution ownership across the research portfolio.

Job Title: Sr .Director - Program Management

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Description Summary

The Sr. Director, Program Management is responsible for leading the Program Management Office (PMO), driving execution excellence across the organization, and ensuring consistent delivery of strategic software and product development initiatives. This role provides leadership to a team of program managers and execution leaders, establishes and continuously improves governance and operational practices, and partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Quality, and Regulatory leaders to deliver complex software releases in a highly regulated environment.

This leader will play a critical role in both ensuring successful execution of current programs and shaping the future operating model for program management across the organization. The ideal candidate brings deep experience leading large-scale software development programs within healthcare, MedTech, or medical device along with a demonstrated ability to transform traditional project management environments into more Agile, value-focused organizations.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of program managers, establishing clear expectations and building organizational capability in program leadership, Agile execution, stakeholder management, risk management, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive successful execution of complex software product releases and strategic initiatives, ensuring commitments, milestones, and business objectives are achieved.
  • Evolve the PMO operating model, methodologies, governance structure, tools, and standard work to increase organizational effectiveness and delivery predictability.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering leadership to establish effective portfolio planning, release management, capacity planning, prioritization, and roadmap execution processes.
  • Enable effective Agile execution across cross-functional teams by improving transparency of work, dependencies, impediments, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Establish fit-for-purpose governance that integrates Agile software development practices with Quality Management System (QMS), design controls, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity, and other compliance obligations.
  • Drive portfolio visibility through meaningful metrics, dashboards, and operating reviews focused on outcomes, delivery predictability, risk management, and leadership decision-making.
  • Lead cross-functional planning and execution of complex strategic programs, ensuring alignment with customer needs, product strategy, and business priorities.
  • Identify systemic barriers to execution and partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Service, and Commercial functions to implement sustainable improvements.
  • Facilitate resolution and escalation of complex issues, resource constraints, competing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Champion Lean, Agile, SAFe, and continuous improvement principles to improve organizational effectiveness and eliminate activities that do not create customer or business value.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership regarding portfolio health, execution risks, organizational constraints, and opportunities to improve delivery performance.
  • Create transparency and alignment across all levels of the organization, ensuring teams understand priorities, commitments, decisions, and changes impacting execution.
  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Service, and Commercial functions to drive customer and business outcomes.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Healthcare, or related field, or equivalent progressive experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in program management, portfolio management, PMO leadership, product development, or operational excellence.
  • Minimum of 5 years of people leadership experience, including managing and developing high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs and portfolios within a software, SaaS, or technology-driven organization.
  • Demonstrated experience within healthcare, medical device, or MedTech industry.
  • Strong working knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), design controls, and regulatory requirements applicable to software product development.
  • Demonstrated experience leading software product development and release programs throughout the full product lifecycle, including roadmap planning, development, release, sustaining, and end-of-life activities.
  • Strong experience operating within Agile development environments and applying Agile and SAFe principles to portfolio and program execution.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation from traditional project and program management approaches to Agile and iterative delivery models.
  • Proven ability to establish governance, operating rhythms, metrics, and execution frameworks that balance speed, compliance, and business needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, build alignment across stakeholders, and operate effectively within complex matrixed organizations.
  • Strong executive communication, organizational change leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Scrum, Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent professional certifications.
  • Experience leading a PMO, portfolio management organization, or enterprise-wide transformation effort.
  • Experience integrating Agile software development with QMS, design controls, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity practices, and release governance.
  • Experience modernizing traditional program management organizations into product- and value-oriented operating models.
  • Demonstrated success using portfolio, flow, and delivery metrics to improve organizational performance and business outcomes.
  • Experience supporting healthcare IT, medical imaging, enterprise imaging, cloud-based software platforms, or complex enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Strategic leader with a hands-on approach to execution who can establish long-term direction while remaining close enough to the work to remove barriers and enable success.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments, drive alignment among diverse stakeholders, and foster a culture of accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, and customer focus.


Ideal Candidate Profile

This leader has successfully led a PMO or large-scale program management function supporting software product development within a healthcare, MedTech, or highly regulated environment. They have extensive experience overseeing software release execution, managing teams of program managers, and building governance frameworks that support both compliance and agility. They are equally comfortable influencing senior executives, driving organizational transformation, and improving day-to-day execution across complex cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Senior Security Architect — Managed Security Services
jobs.excerpt: A little bit about us Bespin Global is a top global cloud MSP recognized in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for 8 consecutive years.
jobs.description:
A little bit about us

Bespin Global is a top global cloud MSP recognized in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for 8 consecutive years. We also won the AWS MSP Partner of the Year globally and many Google Partner of the Year awards!

We have 1,300+ “Bespineers” across 16 offices and 10 countries including the U.S., South Korea, Singapore, Dubai, Indonesia, China, and Tokyo, serving more than 4,500 customers worldwide.

If you want a fun and exciting role at a fast-growing company with lots of opportunities, this is the place for you.

About the Role

Bespin Global US delivers managed security services to organizations that need enterprise-grade detection and response without building it themselves — endpoint detection and response (EDR), 24x7 SOC services, SIEM and SOAR management, security assessments, and cloud security posture management (CSPM).

This role sits at the center of that practice with a dual mandate. You will engineer the platform our services run on — the SIEM/SOAR pipelines, EDR deployments, detection content, and integrations that our analysts depend on — and you will be the senior technical voice with customers, scoping new engagements, leading onboarding, and advising security leaders on how to mature their programs.

This is not a shift-based SOC seat. You are the person who decides how the service works, then makes it work for each customer.

What You'll Do

Platform & Detection Engineering

  • Own the architecture and build-out of the multi-tenant SIEM and SOAR environments underpinning our managed detection services — primarily Google SecOps, with Elastic and Coralogix supporting customer-specific and log analytics use cases
  • Design and deploy EDR tooling across customer estates using SentinelOne and CrowdStrike; standardize policies, exclusions, and response actions
  • Build and maintain detection content — correlation rules, analytics, and use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK — and tune continuously to reduce false positives
  • Develop SOAR playbooks that automate triage, enrichment, containment, and notification workflows
  • Engineer log ingestion and normalization pipelines with BindPlane across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network sources; manage data volume, routing, and ingest cost
  • Stand up and maintain Wiz for cloud security posture management across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure; define policy baselines, risk prioritization, and remediation guidance
  • Design and maintain secure connectivity into customer environments using Tailscale, keeping collector and management access least-privilege and auditable
  • Automate deployment and configuration through infrastructure-as-code and scripting rather than manual, per-customer work
  • Evaluate new security tooling and make build-vs-buy recommendations for the practice

Customer-Facing Delivery & Advisory

  • Lead technical discovery and scoping for prospective customers; translate their environment and risk profile into a service design
  • Own the technical execution of customer onboarding — from log source integration through first tuned detections and validated response workflows
  • Serve as the escalation point and trusted advisor for the customer's security stakeholders after go-live
  • Conduct security assessments and cloud posture reviews; present findings and prioritized remediation roadmaps to technical and executive audiences
  • Partner with sales on solution design, technical proposals, and statements of work
  • Produce reference architectures, runbooks, and documentation that let the SOC and delivery teams operate what you build

The Stack You'll Work With

Layer

Platforms

SIEM / detection & response

Google SecOps, Elastic, Coralogix

Endpoint

SentinelOne, CrowdStrike

Cloud security posture

Wiz

Telemetry pipeline

BindPlane

Secure access

Tailscale

Cloud platforms

AWS, Google Cloud, Azure

We are not tool-agnostic for the sake of it — we run a deliberate stack and expect you to help shape where it goes next.

What You Bring

Required

  • 7+ years in security engineering, security operations, or security consulting, including hands-on ownership of a SIEM platform
  • Deep, hands-on experience with at least one modern SIEM — Google SecOps (Chronicle), Elastic, or Coralogix strongly preferred — including data onboarding, parsing and normalization, and detection authoring
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating EDR/XDR platforms; SentinelOne and CrowdStrike specifically preferred
  • Experience with a CSPM/CNAPP platform such as Wiz, including policy baselines and risk-based remediation workflows
  • Working knowledge of SOAR platforms and automation of security workflows
  • Strong cloud security fundamentals across AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure — native security services, identity, and posture management — with the ability to work in at least two
  • Scripting and automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or equivalent) and comfort with infrastructure-as-code
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate directly with customers — running technical workshops, presenting findings, and handling escalations with credibility
  • Working familiarity with common frameworks and standards (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2)

Preferred

  • Prior experience in an MSSP, MSP, or consulting environment supporting multiple customers concurrently
  • Incident response experience, including leading investigations end to end
  • Multi-cloud breadth across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure
  • Experience with telemetry pipeline tooling (BindPlane, OpenTelemetry, Cribl, or similar) and log cost optimization
  • Familiarity with zero-trust or mesh networking tools such as Tailscale for customer environment access
  • Certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GCDA, CISSP, OSCP, or cloud security specialty credentials
  • Experience with detection-as-code practices and CI/CD for security content
  • Exposure to pre-sales solutioning and SOW development

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: fluent in our service stack and delivery model; leading onboarding for at least one new customer; first detection content improvements shipped
  • First 6 months: owning the technical design of the SIEM/SOAR platform; measurable reduction in false-positive volume; recognized as the escalation point across the delivery team
  • First year: onboarding is faster and more repeatable than when you arrived; detection coverage is measurably broader; customers name you as a reason they stay

Why Bespin

You will have real ownership over how a growing managed security practice is built — not a narrow slice of someone else's platform. The work spans engineering depth and customer impact, and you will see the results of both across every account we run.

Bespin Global US is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: der moment Seit 2018 hat Jurafuchs Hunderttausende Jurastudierende und Referendare beim Lernen begleitet, aber was gerade passiert, ist größer als alles, was wir bisher gemacht haben.
jobs.description:
der moment

Seit 2018 hat Jurafuchs Hunderttausende Jurastudierende und Referendare beim Lernen begleitet, aber was gerade passiert, ist größer als alles, was wir bisher gemacht haben. Jurafuchs wird bald die gesamte juristische Karriere begleiten – von der ersten Vorlesung bis zur Kanzlei. Und dafür bauen wir gerade eine Infrastruktur, die es so noch nicht gibt: eigene Portale, eigene Tools, eigene Systeme. Alles mit juristischer Logik im Kern.

Dafür suchen wir dich: jemanden, der Recht nicht nur versteht, sondern eigene Systeme bauen kann.

deine mission

Du baust die juristische Infrastruktur, auf der Jurafuchs in den nächsten Jahren wächst. Portale, Tools, Systeme – eigenständig, von Idee bis Launch.

woran du bei uns arbeitest

Du verantwortest den Bau neuer Portale und interner Tools an der Schnittstelle von Recht und Software und bist nah an Architektur und strategischen Entscheidungen. Das zeigt sich zum Beispiel darin, dass:

  • Du neue Portale eigenständig von Idee bis Launch verantwortest – von gesetze.jurafuchs.de über lehre.jurafuchs.de bis zu weiteren Subdomains der Roadmap
  • Custom Software und interne Tools entstehen, die juristische Logik wirklich abbilden – Prüfungsschemata, Domänenmodelle, KI-gestützte Tools
  • juristische Anforderungen direkt in funktionierende Software übersetzt werden – ohne Umwege, weil Du beides kannst

wer du bist

  • Du hast das Erste Staatsexamen abgeschlossen und verfügst über Erfahrung im Product Management – idealerweise im LegalTech-Bereich.
  • Du kannst eigenständig Web-Portale und Custom Software bauen. Vibe-Coding ist deine Arbeitsweise und du bist tief in AI drin.
  • Du verstehst Datenbankstrukturen und Wissensmodellierung und weißt, wie man juristische Inhalte so strukturiert, dass sie skalieren.
  • Du denkst in Produkten und kannst sie managen. Was soll das hier können, für wen, warum jetzt? Bevor du baust, weißt du, was du baust und danach behältst du den Überblick.
  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Zielgruppenverständnis und baust nicht an ihnen vorbei.
  • Du willst juristische Bildung nicht nur begleiten, sondern verändern.

was du wissen solltest

Du kommst nicht in eine fertige Struktur. Die Portale, die du bauen wirst, existieren noch nicht oder müssen ausgebaut werden. Die Tools, die du entwickelst, gibt es nicht als Vorlage. Du arbeitest direkt mit einem der Gründer und unserem Legal Engineer zusammen, bist nah an der Roadmap und trägst echte Verantwortung von Tag eins.

was dich erwartet

Build Fast: Jede Woche neue Features, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine AI-First Mentalität.

Work Your Way: 100 % remote, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Fokus auf Ergebnisse statt Präsenz.

One Team: Radical Candor, Eigenverantwortung und zero Tolerance für Ego-Show. 2× im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Teamretreats in Europa.

Why We Exist: Wir glauben, dass der Zugang zu juristischer Bildung eine Frage von gesellschaftlicher & rechtsstaatlicher Relevanz ist ist. Deshalb machen wir juristische Bildung zugänglicher, wirksamer und relevanter.

jobs.title: Business Developer (Freelance)
jobs.excerpt: Krijg jij energie van klanten overtuigen en deals sluiten?
jobs.description:
Krijg jij energie van klanten overtuigen en deals sluiten?
Ben jij commercieel ingesteld en weet je vertrouwen op te bouwen bij potentiële investeerders?
Wil je als zelfstandige zelf bepalen wanneer en hoe je werkt?
En lijkt het je interessant om klanten mee te nemen in het verhaal van investeren in bouwgronden in de Ardennen?

Dan is deze commerciële uitdaging iets voor jou.

Over de klant

Onze klant is gespecialiseerd in de verkoop van bouw- en villagronden in de Ardennen en begeleidt investeerders gedurende het volledige aankooptraject. Met jarenlange ervaring en een uitgebreid aanbod ligt de focus op een persoonlijke aanpak: van het eerste contact en het bepalen van de investeringswensen tot het bezoeken van geschikte gronden en het afronden van de aankoop.

Voor de verdere groei zijn we op zoek naar een zelfstandige Sales Professional die actief klanten in Vlaanderen weet te vinden en hen warm maakt voor een investering in de Ardennen.

Wat houdt de functie in?

  • Je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten in Vlaanderen die interesse hebben in vastgoed en investeringen in de Ardennen.

  • Je bouwt zelfstandig een netwerk van potentiële investeerders op en onderhoudt bestaande contacten.

  • Je voert gesprekken met geïnteresseerde klanten en brengt hun wensen, budget en investeringsdoelstellingen in kaart.

  • Je begeleidt potentiële kopers persoonlijk en legt helder uit welke mogelijkheden er zijn binnen het aanbod van bouw- en villagronden.

  • Je gaat samen met klanten naar de Ardennen om geschikte projecten en bouwgronden te bekijken en zorgt ervoor dat zij een duidelijk beeld krijgen van hun mogelijke investering.

  • Je volgt het volledige verkoopproces op, van eerste kennismaking tot offerte en uiteindelijke deal.

  • Je bouwt vertrouwen op gedurende het traject en zorgt ervoor dat klanten met een goed gevoel een beslissing kunnen nemen.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met het team om klanten correct te begeleiden en dossiers succesvol af te ronden.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van prospectie, klantencontact en het sluiten van deals.

  • Je bent ondernemend en vindt het vanzelfsprekend om zelf actief op zoek te gaan naar nieuwe klanten.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt mensen op een professionele en overtuigende manier meenemen in een verhaal.

  • Je weet vertrouwen op te bouwen en begrijpt dat de aankoop van vastgoed een beslissing is waarbij persoonlijke begeleiding belangrijk is.

  • Je hebt interesse in vastgoed en investeringen; ervaring binnen vastgoed, financiële dienstverlening of een andere commerciële omgeving is een sterke troef.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en kunt je eigen agenda en klantenportefeuille efficiënt beheren.

  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B en bent bereid om samen met potentiële klanten naar de Ardennen te rijden.

  • Je bent bereid om op zelfstandige basis te werken en ziet flexibiliteit als een belangrijk voordeel.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?

  • Je werkt volledig op zelfstandige basis en bepaalt zelf wanneer je werkt en hoe je jouw agenda organiseert.

  • Je krijgt de vrijheid om je commerciële activiteit op jouw manier uit te bouwen, zonder vaste kantooruren.

  • Je werkt met een concreet en tastbaar product: bouw- en villagronden in de Ardennen.

  • Je krijgt de kans om een eigen klantenportefeuille en netwerk uit te bouwen en rechtstreeks impact te hebben op je verkoopresultaten.

  • Je wordt ondersteund door een ervaren organisatie en kunt rekenen op de nodige informatie en ondersteuning tijdens het verkoopproces.

  • Je begeleidt klanten persoonlijk en bent betrokken bij het volledige traject, waardoor je dicht bij de uiteindelijke deal staat.

  • Je werkt in een markt waarin de interesse van Vlaamse investeerders in de Ardennen aanwezig is en waarin vastgoed en tweede verblijven een belangrijke rol spelen.

  • Je inkomsten zijn gekoppeld aan je commerciële resultaten, waardoor je als zelfstandige rechtstreeks kunt profiteren van je eigen succes.

jobs.description:
job beschreibung

Digitale Lernprodukte für Reiter weltweit

Bei wehorse entwickeln wir als Sports-Tech-Unternehmen digitale Produkte, die Reitern helfen, gemeinsam mit ihren Pferden zu lernen, zu trainieren und besser zu werden. Stell dir eine Mischung aus Duolingo und Strava vor: hochwertige Videokurse, mobiles Lernen, Community, Tracking-Features und KI-gestützte Erlebnisse, die Trainingsfortschritte greifbar machen.

Für unser Product-Engineering-Team suchen wir einen Mobile Engineer mit klarem Fokus auf Mobile. Die Rolle passt zu dir, wenn du stark in React Native bist, richtig gute Mobile-Apps baust und genug React- und Next.js-Erfahrung mitbringst, um bei Bedarf auch auf unserer Web-Plattform mitzuarbeiten.

Du entwickelst mit uns die Zukunft unserer App, vor allem rund um Reiter- und Pferde-Tracking und KI-Features, und sorgst nebenbei dafür, dass unsere Web-Plattform stabil und gepflegt bleibt. Erfahrung mit Pferden oder Reiten brauchst du dafür natürlich nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust, pflegst und verbesserst unsere React-Native-App
  • Du arbeitest im Team mit Frontend- und Backend-Engineers, Product Ownern und Designern
  • Du entwickelst Mobile-First-Features rund um Tracking, Trainingsfortschritt und KI
  • Du setzt Produkt- und Design-Ideen in eine saubere, durchdachte Mobile-UX um
  • Du pflegst und verbesserst unser Next.js-Web-Frontend, wo es nötig ist
  • Du findest dich umsichtig in einer bestehenden Codebase zurecht und entwickelst sie weiter
  • Du nutzt KI-Coding-Tools über den ganzen Entwicklungsprozess hinweg
  • Du triffst pragmatische Entscheidungen zu Architektur, Wartbarkeit, Performance und Tempo
  • Du reviewst Code und hilfst, unsere Frontend- und Mobile-Praktiken besser zu machen

stellenanforderungen

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit React Native in einem professionellen Team
  • Solide Erfahrung mit React und Next.js, um bei Bedarf auf unserer Web-Plattform mitzuarbeiten
  • Gutes Gespür für Architektur, Refactoring, Technical Debt und Wartbarkeit
  • Erfahrung mit KI-Coding-Assistenten wie Claude Code, Cursor oder ähnlichen Tools
  • Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Deployment-Workflows und Cloud-Infrastruktur, idealerweise AWS
  • Starke Fähigkeiten beim Debuggen, Problemlösen und Code-Lesen
  • Klare Kommunikation und ein pragmatischer, unkomplizierter Arbeitsstil
  • Fähigkeit, in einem Remote-First-Umfeld eigenständig und gut zu arbeiten
  • Bereitschaft, für Team-Events ins Büro zu kommen
  • Offenheit für Feedback, Lernen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung
  • Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit nativer iOS- oder Android-Entwicklung
  • Erfahrung im Mentoring anderer Entwickler
  • Erfahrung in kleinen Teams mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

Wie wir arbeiten

Wir sind ein kleines Team aus sehr fähigen Leuten, deshalb hat jeder Entwickler echten Impact. Uns sind Eigenverantwortung, durchdachte Kommunikation und stetige Verbesserung wichtiger als schwerfällige Prozesse.

Uns ist wichtig, zu verstehen, bevor wir verändern. Heißt: Wir bevorzugen Entwickler, die sich erst in Produkt, Nutzer und bestehende Architektur einarbeiten, bevor sie große Rewrites vorschlagen.

Außerdem arbeiten wir mit modernen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungs-Workflows. Wir erwarten, dass du KI-Tools als Hebel nutzt - und dabei trotzdem dein eigenes Engineering-Urteil, kritisches Denken und die Verantwortung für das Endergebnis einbringst.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine offene, einladende Kultur: Wir sind eine sympathische Truppe, die gerne zusammenarbeitet. Uns sind klare Kommunikation, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Problemlösung ohne Ego und Politik wichtig.
  • Hoher Impact: Als Teil eines kleinen Teams prägt deine Arbeit das Produkt und das Unternehmen direkt.
  • Ein Produkt mit Sinn: Wir bauen etwas, das unseren Nutzern wirklich am Herzen liegt und das sie gerne nutzen.
  • Remote-First-Flexibilität: Unser Engineering-Team arbeitet remote-first. Du kannst komplett remote arbeiten oder unser Hamburger Büro nutzen, wenn dir das lieber ist. Wir schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, kommen aber regelmäßig für Team-Events zusammen, um uns auszutauschen und Spaß zu haben.

Unser Tech-Stack

  • Web: Next.js
  • Mobile: React Native mit Kotlin- und Swift-Anpassungen
  • Backend und Infrastruktur: PHP, Python, JavaScript, AWS

In this role, you will contribute to designing, building, and maintaining scalable software solutions that enhance our platform's functionality and performance. Reporting to the Director of Development, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality code, optimize application performance, and support the growth of our technology stack.

Qualifications

We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in Canada.

Outcome Driven: We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results.

Wide Responsibility: Our team is empowered to take ownership from problem identification to implementation.

Learning Mindset: We embrace curiosity and reject the status quo.

Strategic Speed: We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action.

Compliance Leadership

Education, Training & Certification

Sales Enablement & Live Events

Lead compliance and education at FutureFeed. You'll serve as the company's compliance authority, shape product guidance, and build scalable training and certification programs from the ground up.

ICAM Technical Product Manager – Enterprise Identity Governance Services

GDIT has an opportunity for an ICAM Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) capabilities within a large enterprise-scale Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) environment. This role supports the DoD ICAM mission by driving the evolution of IGA services that enable secure, compliant, and effective access governance for more than 4 million DoD enterprise identities.

This is a fully remote position.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
The ideal candidate has strong experience with identity governance concepts, enterprise identity platforms, and product lifecycle management. As the ICAM Product Manager for IGA, you will define product vision, build and prioritize capability roadmaps, work closely with engineering and cybersecurity teams, and ensure the IGA product delivers maximum value to mission stakeholders. This role offers the opportunity to influence ICAM modernization, shape governance capabilities, and manage an evolving product used across mission-critical environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for enterprise IGA capabilities within the ICAM ecosystem.
  • Lead product planning, backlog prioritization, and requirement definition across teams supporting access lifecycle management, entitlement workflows, role management, and access review processes.
  • Collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, architecture, and mission stakeholders to ensure IGA product capabilities meet technical, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Gather and synthesize user needs, mission priorities, and system data to guide product decisions and feature development.
  • Manage product lifecycle activities, including new capability introduction, enhancements, operationalization, and retirements.
  • Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, and capability requirements supporting engineering implementation.
  • Facilitate cross-team communication, alignment, and decision-making regarding IGA architecture, functionality, and modernization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing clear and consistent updates on roadmap progress, risks, and dependencies.
  • Support onboarding and integration of applications, mission partners, and systems requiring governance services.
  • Ensure product readiness through documentation, training materials, process updates, and change communication.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying capability gaps, elevating user feedback, and recommending enhancements aligned with Zero Trust identity principles.
  • Support reporting, metrics, and performance tracking for product adoption, health, and operational effectiveness.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Active Secret Clearance at minimum. Interim Secret Clearances are not allowed.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, technical certifications or training, or work experience.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (Security+ CE or higher)

Required Skills/Knowledge:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ICAM, IAM, IGA, identity security, or related enterprise identity programs.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technical products or capabilities in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of identity governance concepts including provisioning, deprovisioning, roles, entitlements, access certification, privileged access, and policy controls.
  • Familiarity with identity protocols and authentication technologies such as SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, and enterprise directory services.
  • Ability to create and manage product roadmaps, user stories, and intake workflows.
  • Experience working with identity workflows involving SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and modern authentication technologies.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into program deliverables, schedules, risks, and stakeholder updates.
  • Proven ability to coordinate across engineering, cybersecurity, and operational teams.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with a focus on execution and delivery.

Desired Skills/Knowledge:

  • Experience with enterprise IGA platforms such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with DoD ICAM, identity governance, or federation initiatives.
  • Understanding of NIST 800‑63 identity assurance principles.
  • Experience supporting Zero Trust Architecture with emphasis on identity governance and access controls.
  • Experience conducting access reviews, RBAC design, or governance policy development.
  • Exposure to large-scale enterprise directory environments, PKI, CAC-based authentication, or DoD credentialing.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, DevSecOps workflows, or enterprise modernization programs.

AtFoxelli Group, we're not just leading the digital marketplace - we're redefining it. With 10 years of experience and a portfolio of thriving direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands generating over $20 million USD annually, we’re pushing boundaries to achieve our next growth milestone.

We’re unapologetically ambitious. Some might call us bold, others might call us extra—but that’s exactly how we like it. Self-development, transparency, discipline, and a relentless pursuit of excellence? That’s what fuels us 24/7. And now, we’re looking for a Marketing Manager who shares our appetite for impact.

❕This role is 100% remote and you will join a team that already works from 20 different world countries.

THE ROLE

We're seeking a dynamic and results-driven Marketing Manager to join our growing e-commerce team. This role is perfect for a full-stack marketer who thrives on owning projects from conception to execution. You'll be the driving force behind our marketing initiatives, ensuring seamless collaboration with design and development teams to deliver high performing landing pages and funnels, and drive significant sales growth.

Unlike a traditional performance marketing role, this position emphasizes strategic marketing management, customer research, and the ability to bridge the gap between marketing vision and execution. You’ll be responsible for ensuring high-quality output across all marketing touchpoints, from landing pages and ad creatives to customer journeys.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Marketing Management:

    • Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with business goals.

    • Conduct thorough market and customer research to identify opportunities and optimize campaigns.

    • Analyze marketing performance data to provide actionable insights and recommendations.

    • Manage and prioritize marketing projects, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality results.

    • Ideate new ways to increase scale in our funnels and campaigns.

  • Creative & Content Oversight:

    • Write compelling marketing copy for ads, landing pages, and other marketing materials.

    • Review and provide constructive feedback on design assets, ensuring they meet brand standards and conversion goals.

    • Oversee the design and optimization of ad creatives, by managing design resources.

  • Landing Page & Website Optimization:

    • Conduct thorough QA of landing pages and website elements to ensure optimal user experience and functionality.

    • Implement and monitor A/B tests to improve conversion rates.

    • Collaborate with development teams to implement website updates and enhancements.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

    • Act as a liaison between marketing, design, and development teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment.

    • Provide clear and concise briefs to design and development teams, ensuring projects are delivered to specification.

    • Manage and track project progress, providing regular updates to stakeholders.

  • Customer Research and Analysis:

    • Gather and analyse customer feedback, and data to inform marketing strategies.

    • Identify customer pain points and opportunities for improvement.

    • Optimise towards scaling sales, and execute on new ideas to increase customer acquisition.

Requirements

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Proven experience in a marketing management or full-stack marketing role within an e-commerce environment.

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and best practices.

  • Excellent copywriting and communication skills.

  • Experience with CRO and website optimization.

  • Ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights against what sells.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills.

  • Experience working with design and development teams.

  • Ability to work remotely and manage your own time effectively.

  • A strong understanding of customer research and how to implement it.

  • A passion for e-commerce and a desire to drive growth.

  • Strong performance marketing experience.

    Bonus Points:

  • Experience with specific marketing automation tools.

  • Familiarity with heatmaps, ads managers, and analytics tools.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • 10 min online DISC assessment to identify your behavioral style, as we strongly believe in the power of diverse teams.

  • 15-30 min e-meet with the Foxelli Group Talent Acquisition Partner.

  • Home Task.

  • 60 min e-meet with the Hiring Manager and Foxelli Group CPO to discuss the vision of the role, your competencies, and technical skills, followed by a two-way Q&A session.

  • Decision & Feedback from us.

SALARY

€1,500 - €2500 after taxes (depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience) with the potential for quarterly performance-based bonuses tied to KPIs.

❕Please note that this role requires a self-employment certificate.

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and keeping your physical well-being in check.

  • A personal development budget is at your disposal for yourpersonal and professional growth to ensure you keep continuously growing.

  • Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.

  • A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.

  • Strong company cultureand a network of unique individuals that celebrates you.

  • Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting for your control of a working day, powered by Hubstaff for transparency and fairness.

ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is UTC+2 and UTC+3. We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

Currently, we are hiring in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

Arbeitsplatz: Wir möchten, dass Du Dich wohlfühlst beim Arbeiten. Deshalb bieten wir Dir ein helles und modernes Büro sowie einen hochmodern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz.

Teambuilding: Zum Arbeiten gehört auch das Miteinander. Deshalb fördern wir regelmäßig den Teamgeist, z. B. durch Betriebsausflüge, Weihnachtsfeiern oder andere Aktivitäten, wie z. B. Grillfeiern, bei denen die Chefs für das gesamte Team grillen.

Kurze Auszeit während der Arbeitszeit: Du hast bei uns die Möglichkeit Dich einmal die Woche während der Arbeitszeit von einer Physiotherapeutin in den Kanzleiräumen massieren zu lassen.

Fortbewegung: Deinen eigenen kostenlosen Parkplatz für Dich gibt’s bei uns sowieso. On top besteht die Möglichkeit ein Jobrad zu leasen.

Kanzlei-Buddy: Aller Anfang ist schwer, aber nicht bei uns. Bei uns bekommst Du deinen eigenen Ansprechpartner, der Dich während deiner gesamten Einarbeitungszeit unterstützt.

Wellpass: Mit dem Wellpass bieten wir Dir Zugang zu einer breiten Auswahl an Gesundheits- und Fitnessangeboten, von Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaften bis hin zu Wellnessbehandlungen. jobs.description:
Summary:

The Senior Manager, Administration helps to ensure effective performance and cohesive operations, through the management of administrative responsibilities for Senior Vice Presidents in the Program Division of the ASPCA.

Are you a highly-organized, proactive, and driven individual – attentive to detail while keeping the big picture top of mind as you support projects, manage systems, and continually elevate your team’s work? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, accomplishing your tasks with urgency and efficiency while being empathetic toward the perspectives of others? Do you want to serve as administrative anchor and support a myriad of teams addressing animals’ needs throughout the nation? If so, we encourage you to apply and join our team!


Application Deadline: We will be accepting applications until Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 9:00pm ET.

Who We Are

The Program division encompasses multiple verticals and works to: expand veterinary care; advance animal welfare locally and nationally; set standards for consistent, efficient, high-quality veterinary medicine; and provide vision and leadership to position behavioral care as a core component of animal welfare, as well as other initiatives critical to the care of animals.

What you’ll do

The ASPCA is currently hiring two Senior Manager, Administration positions (SM), each of which will report to the Director of Administration, Program Operations, and has no direct reports. Working closely with leadership as well as other administrative staff, each role includes providing support to two Senior Vice Presidents across the Program division, scheduling and coordinating meetings, tracking and maintaining data, and helping manage projects, among other key duties. The Senior Vice Presidents this role may directly support include at least two of the following: Community Centered Medicine, Shelter & Rehabilitation Operations, Animal Behavior, and Veterinary Medicine.

The Senior Manager, Administration, must be very organized, flexible, resourceful, and efficient with top-notch administrative, written and verbal communication skills, sound judgement, and great people skills.

Where and When You’ll Work

This remote-based position requires the ability and willingness to travel up to 15% annually and is open to all eligible candidates based within the United States. While remote, this position does require working primarily on East Coast business hours.

What You’ll Get

Compensation

The target hiring range is based on where the employee works, which for remote roles is the employee’s primary location of residence, and its respective cost of labor. You can view which zone applies to you based on your location (aspca.app.box.com/v/aspcazonetable). For questions regarding locations not on the list, please send an email to for more information.

Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of factors, including but not limited to education, training, experience, location, business needs, internal equity, market demands or budgeted amount for the role. The target hiring range is for new hire offers only, and compensation may increase beyond the maximum hiring range based on performance over time. The maximum of the hiring range is reserved for candidates with the highest qualifications and relevant experience. The expected hiring salary ranges for this role are set forth below and may be modified in the future.

  • Zone 1: $35.84 - $37.82 per hour
  • Zone 2: $39.59 - $41.77 per hour
  • Zone 3: $43.49 - $45.89 per hour

Benefits

At the ASPCA, you don’t have to choose between your passion and making a living. Our comprehensive benefits package helps ensure you can live a rewarding life at work and at home. Our benefits include but are not limited to:

  • Affordable health coverage, including medical, employer-paid dental and optional vision coverage.
  • Flexible time off that includes vacation time, sick and bereavement time, paid parental leave, 10 company paid holidays and paid personal time off that allows flexibility to observe the days that mean the most to you.
  • Competitive financial incentives and retirement savings, including a 401(k) plan with generous employer contributions — we match dollar-for-dollar up to 4% and provide an additional 4% contribution toward your future each year.
  • Robust professional development opportunities including classes, on-the-job training, coaching and mentorship with industry-leading peers, internal mobility, opportunities to support in the field and so much more.

For more information on our benefits offerings, visit our website.

Responsibilities:

Responsibility buckets are listed in general order of importance, and include but are not limited to:

Executive Support

  • Manage complex scheduling for senior leadership and cross-functional meetings. Protect SVPs’ calendars; anticipate and resolve scheduling conflicts with discretion and efficiency. Juggle frequent last-minute changes and coordinate with internal and external constituents.
  • Complete SVPs’ travel logistics and itineraries and facilitate preparation for travel.
  • Take notes, track decisions, and document next steps during meetings to lead follow-up, keeping SVPs and teams apprised of progress.
  • Monitor, flag, and take action on incoming communication.
  • Prepare and submit monthly expense reports for SVPs.
  • Maintain an understanding of SVPs’ priorities and workflow to help ensure time is appropriately allocated for meetings, skip levels, visits, and quarterly check-ins throughout the year. Bring forward issues, opportunities and trends to the SVPs’ attention
  • Monitor the organizational calendar and manage schedules to prepare SVPs and teams for routine requirements - including but not limited to - goal setting, quarterly and annual performance reviews, calibration, compliance training, annual planning, and budget preparation.
  • Partner with Director and administrative colleagues to advance and elevate the efficiency and effectiveness of admin functions across Program. Cross train to facilitate learning and provide back up support to one another.
  • Monitor new technologies in use at the ASPCA, learn them, and support them, in partnership with the IT team, to help guide SVPs in implementation for maximum efficiency/effectiveness.

Meeting and Event Scheduling and Coordination

  • Assist SVPs in planning meetings to advance work against our shared goals, including with both internal and external partners and stakeholders. Ensure meeting participants are informed of the context for meetings, the agendas, and any prep work with ample time to prepare so that meetings are making the highest and best use of everyone’s time. Proactively suggest an asynchronous approach when that will be a better use of time.
  • Manage and provide planning and on-site, in-person logistical support including travel arrangements, supplies, room setup, A/V needs, and catering
  • Routinely gather input and feedback on meetings, communications, and team processes to reinforce what’s working; create, improve or replace processes to ensure teams deliver on shared goals.

Budget and Data Support

  • Support timely collection and review of budget details and information, and provide initial analysis.
  • Collect and help maintain data that informs the performance across departments.
  • Support regular reporting: flag key tasks and keep involved stakeholders informed; help to draft communications and coordinate next steps.
  • Serve as the primary resource for planned and timely data and budget inquiries across departments.

Project Coordination

  • Provide administrative project management support including tracking timelines, deliverables, note-taking, and scheduling.
  • Facilitate communication between teams and escalate issues as needed to keep projects on schedule.
  • Manage documentation for key projects, including archiving notes, decisions, and action steps.
  • Create slide decks or other visual representations of information.

Qualifications:

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, work within set deadlines, and adapt to changing circumstances.
  • Exercise sound judgment, diplomacy, sensitivity, and respect for confidentiality when managing SVPs calendars, travel, budget, data and communications.
  • Ability to see the big picture and connect the dots, with the ability to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Ability to spot opportunities for bringing order, consistency, and predictability through simple processes to support communications and teamwork.
  • Ability to seek and build positive and productive relationships that allow coordination of activities and communications.
  • Skilled in planning, organizing, and facilitating meetings.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including grammar, editing and proofreading, and working with multiple individuals with a range of communication styles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook and Teams.
  • Ability to learn new software quickly
  • Ability to exemplify ASPCA’s core values and behavioral competencies
  • Familiarity with Workday, Airtable, Box and Canva, preferred

Education and Work Experience:

  • High School, GED or equivalent work experience required
  • 4 years of experience providing administrative support with at least 1 year of experience providing administrative support at the executive level, including managing calendars for others and providing logistic support for ongoing work and priorities required
  • 1 year of experience booking travel arrangements for others (e.g., booking flights, hotels, etc.) required
  • 1 year of experience making meeting arrangements (virtual and on-site) for others, required
  • 2 years of experience taking meeting notes and outlining and helping lead next steps required
  • 1 year of experience supporting budget preparation and review required
  • 1 year of experience completing expense reports for others required
  • Experience with event or conference planning, set-up and execution preferred
  • Experience collecting and managing data sets preferred
  • Background in animal sheltering, veterinary medicine or animal welfare a plus

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Business Intelligence (BI) Developer will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.


The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering advanced reporting, analytics, visualizations, statistical modeling, and AI/ML capabilities that provide data-driven decision-support tools and actionable insights to users and stakeholders of the CMM application. This role oversees design, development, integration, and continuous enhancement of dashboards, reporting tools, predictive analytics, and AI/ML capabilities in alignment with strict federal compliance requirements.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Business Intelligence (BI) Developer will execute the following responsibilities:


Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and integrate configurable dashboards, self-service reporting capabilities, and predictive analytics within the CMM application.
  • Designs intuitive, interactive dashboards and visualizations that communicate business insights effectively.
  • Coordinate and implement data replication or feeds required to support downstream stakeholders and external systems.

  • Drive user adoption of dashboards and reporting tools, with monthly usage across targets users.
  • Collaborate with product owners, data engineers, and UX designers to ensure seamless integration of analytics features into the CMM user experience.
  • Partner with business leaders, data engineers, analysts, and program leadership to translate business requirements and KPIs into actionable technical designs and insights.
  • Build and enhance dashboards and reports in approved BI tools, ensuring performance and usability at scale.
  • Implement and validate SQL logic, calculations, and metric definitions across reporting products.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineering to resolve upstream data issues and curate data for reporting.
  • Apply visualization standards and documentation so reports are consistent, interpretable, and support adoption.
  • Ensure reporting artifacts comply with privacy, access control, and data handling requirements.
  • Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, standards, and best practices ensuring data accuracy, consistency, classification, and security.
  • Drive continuous improvement of BI platforms through performance tuning, automation, metadata management, and advanced analytics (predictive and self-service BI).
  • Support delivery of architecture design documents, governance artifacts, data lineage, and metadata catalog processes.

AI/ML Capabilities

  • Support and consume AI/ML solutions with adherence to government compliance standards.
  • Establish, maintain, and oversee a master AI/ML Capability Register documenting all proposed, in-review, approved, and rejected capabilities, including status tracking, submission dates, and authorization history.
  • Implement responsible AI/ML practices aligned with federal requirements, ensuring transparency, risk mitigation, fairness, and compliance.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • MA/MS degree with 5+ years or BS/BA degree with 7+ years of general experience in information systems and 5+ years of specialized experience.

  • Expertise in python, SQL & data transformations supporting large-scale analytical data systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with BI tools such as Qlik (preferred), AWS QuickSight (preferred), Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with analytical data models and semantic layers.
  • Experience delivering reporting in regulated or high-sensitivity data environment.
  • Experience assisting with testing, by writing acceptance criteria & confirming test cases results.
  • Experience with producing relevant and current requirements, sizing user stories correctly, and removing roadblocks prior to sprints start.

REQUIRED COMMUNICATION & ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS

  • Excellent presentation and communication (oral and written) skills.
  • Consultant mindset with the ability to work with high level customer stakeholders and build excellent customer relationships.
  • Experience identifying and applying industry tools, solutions, methods best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills with the ability to formulate and communicate recommendations for improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS

One or more of the following certifications is preferred:

  • Data Visualization and Data Story Telling certifications
  • Qlik Sense Business Analyst
  • Qlik Sense Data Architect
  • Qlik Cloud Analytics Certified Business Analyst
