jobs.description:
Build Your Future with Hyphen While Our Clients Build Homes with Your Support.

We Build a Trusted Homebuilder Network, Unifying the Construction Supply Chain.

GENERAL DESCRIPTION:

Designs, develops, and tests new features and enhancements across web and mobile applications, contributing to technical design decisions and architecture. Utilizes technologies such as C#, ASP.NET MVC, Flutter, Web API, SQL Server, and AWS services to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.


Collaborates with QA, Product Management, and Customer Care teams to support and enhance existing applications, troubleshoot issues, and implement effective solutions. Plays an active role in API development and integration, with a strong emphasis on leveraging AWS-based services and architectures.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
  • Build and integrate serverless backend services using services like AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and S3.
  • Collaborate with product owner to translate UI/UX designs into responsive, pixel-accurate interfaces.
  • Consume and integrate RESTful APIs and handle offline-first and caching scenarios.
  • Implement authentication and authorization flows (e.g., OAuth/OIDC).
  • Write clean, testable, well-documented code and participate in code reviews.
  • Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and memory usage across devices.
  • Manage app store releases and CI/CD pipelines for mobile builds.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues across the mobile and serverless stack.
  • Stay current with Flutter, Dart, and AWS best practices and bring improvements to the team.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each of the essential duties described above. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bachelor’s or Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • 3+ years of professional mobile development experience, with hands-on Flutter and Dart expertise.
  • Proven experience building and deploying serverless applications on AWS, especially Lambda.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services such as API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Strong understanding of state management patterns in Flutter (e.g., Provider, Riverpod, Bloc).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and handling asynchronous data flows.
  • Experience developing applications using C#, ASP.NET, MVC, and SQL Server.
  • Familiarity with mobile CI/CD, app store submission, and release management.
  • Solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals, testing, and version control (Git).
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a collaborative, agile environment.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Codex) to improve productivity and code quality.
  • Native iOS/Android experience, infrastructure-as-code (CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform), and exposure to push notifications and analytics tooling.
  • Industry knowledge of residential construction, homebuilding, or construction management software is a plus.

jobs.excerpt: You desire impactful work. You’reRGA readyRGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration.
jobs.description:
You desire impactful work.

You’reRGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

The Software Engineering Manager, Investment Technologies leads one or more agile engineering teams responsible for designing, delivering, operating, and continuously improving technology solutions that support RGA’s global Investments organization and investment accounting operations. This role combines people leadership, delivery accountability, engineering depth, and working knowledge of the investment lifecycle to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, resilient, and auditable technology outcomes.


The manager partners with Product Management, investment professionals, operations, accounting, architecture, data, security, risk, and vendor teams to modernize applications, workflows, APIs, integrations, and data capabilities spanning the front, middle, and back office. The role establishes a high-performing engineering culture, develops talent, manages capacity and financial commitments, and ensures teams deliver in alignment with RGA’s technology strategy, Product Delivery Operating Model, engineering standards, and regulatory obligations.


Principal Duties


  • Engineering Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop software engineers across the full employee lifecycle; set clear expectations, strengthen technical capability, promote inclusion and accountability, and build succession and workforce plans aligned to the product roadmap.
  • Delivery Accountability: Own predictable delivery and operational outcomes for the team’s products and services, balancing business features, regulatory commitments, platform modernization, technical debt, reliability, and production support.
  • Investment Business Partnership: Develop trusted relationships with Investments, Investment Operations, and Investment Accounting leaders; understand business processes and control points across portfolio management, trading, settlement, positions, valuations, performance, risk, cash, securities accounting, reconciliation, and financial reporting.
  • Product and Agile Execution: Partner with Product Management and Product Owners to shape roadmaps, refine outcomes, manage dependencies, plan capacity, and translate investment-business needs into well-defined engineering work within an agile, product-oriented operating model.
  • Architecture and Technical Direction: Partner with solution, enterprise, data, cloud, and security architects to implement target-state architecture and approved patterns across applications, APIs, integration, data, and infrastructure. Ensure teams make sound design decisions without shifting architectural accountability away from designated architecture roles.
  • Software Engineering Excellence: Establish and uphold standards for secure coding, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, documentation, release management, and maintainability. Remain technically close enough to delivery to evaluate designs, coach engineers, remove impediments, and make informed trade-offs.
  • Cloud, Data, and Integration Delivery: Guide delivery of modern web applications, services, data pipelines, and integrations using cloud-native, serverless or containerized patterns; API-first services; event-driven, streaming, batch, and file-based integration; and modern analytical data platforms.
  • Vendor Ecosystem Management: Oversee engineering around investment platforms and external providers—including order and portfolio management, investment accounting, private markets, market data, custodians, and analytics solutions—and contribute to build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions, vendor performance, upgrades, and integration strategies.
  • Reliability and Operations: Ensure production services meet expectations for availability, recoverability, performance, monitoring, incident response, problem management, and disaster recovery. Use operational metrics and root-cause analysis to improve service health and reduce recurring issues.
  • Risk, Security, and Controls: Embed security, privacy, segregation of duties, data lineage, traceability, logging, evidence retention, and other control requirements into delivery. Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Finance to support SOX ITGC, SOC 1/2, model governance, and related obligations.
  • Financial and Resource Management: Manage team budget, vendor spend, staffing mix, hiring, capacity, and forecasts; make transparent trade-offs and ensure resources are aligned to the highest-value business outcomes.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging technologies—including generative AI and agentic engineering tools—and introduce them responsibly to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and investment workflows while adhering to security, data, legal, and model-risk requirements.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate delivery progress, operational health, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and decisions clearly to audiences ranging from engineers and business specialists to senior executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Required.
  • Master’s degree in a relevant technology, engineering, business, finance, or quantitative discipline. Preferred.

Work Experience


  • 9+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, application development, platform engineering, data engineering, or related technology disciplines. Required.
  • 3+ years of formal people-management experience leading software engineering teams, including performance management, coaching, hiring, workforce planning, and talent development. Required.
  • Demonstrated accountability for delivering and operating business-critical technology products or platforms in a complex enterprise environment. Required.
  • Experience supporting investments, asset management, investment accounting, capital markets, treasury, finance, or other financially oriented business capabilities. Required.
  • Experience in insurance or reinsurance, an insurer general account, asset management, banking, pension, or an investment-platform provider. Preferred.
  • Experience operating in an agile, product-oriented technology organization and partnering with Product Management, architecture, security, data governance, risk, and business stakeholders. Required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities


  • Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including object-oriented and functional design, modular services, APIs, event-driven architecture, automated testing, secure software development, source control, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure as code.
  • Working fluency across modern application, data, and cloud technologies. Relevant experience may include Python, Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, React-class front ends, SQL, REST or GraphQL APIs, Terraform, containers, serverless computing, workflow orchestration, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Hands-on understanding of AWS or a comparable public-cloud ecosystem, including compute, containers, serverless services, eventing, identity and access management, networking, monitoring, resilience, and cost management.
  • Practical knowledge of investment data and processes, including trade lifecycle, positions and transactions, security master and reference data, pricing and valuations, cash, corporate actions, performance and risk, reconciliation, and interfaces between investment operations and investment accounting.
  • Understanding of front-, middle-, and back-office operating models and of investment-book and accounting-book concepts such as IBOR and ABOR; familiarity with performance or planning books and multi-basis accounting is beneficial.
  • Knowledge of one or more asset classes such as fixed income, public equity, derivatives, structured assets, private credit, real estate, or other private markets investments.
  • Ability to lead engineering teams integrating with major investment platforms, accounting systems, market-data providers, custodians, and internal data platforms. Experience with platforms such as Aladdin, Bloomberg, SimCorp, Eagle, Clearwater, PAM-class systems, or comparable products is beneficial but not required for every candidate.
  • Understanding of financial and insurance control environments, including auditability, data lineage, access controls, change management, segregation of duties, model governance, SOX ITGC, and SOC reporting.
  • Strong judgment in balancing delivery speed, business value, architectural alignment, risk, quality, operational resilience, and total cost of ownership.
  • Advanced leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate between investment, accounting, risk, and engineering audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and dependencies, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and create clarity for teams operating through transformation.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, inclusive leadership, constructive feedback, and a culture in which engineers are empowered to own outcomes.

Preferred Experience

  • Insurance or reinsurance general-account investments, including statutory, GAAP, or other multi-basis investment accounting and reporting.
  • Asset-liability management and the interface among Investments, Finance, Risk, Treasury, and Actuarial functions.
  • Private credit, private markets, structured assets, or alternative-investment platforms and workflows.
  • Large-scale modernization of legacy investment applications, integrations, and data platforms.
  • Responsible adoption of generative AI, agentic tooling, or AI-assisted software engineering and business workflows.
  • Managing a blended workforce of employees, consultants, strategic partners, and software vendors across locations or time zones.

What you can expect from RGA:

  • Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

  • Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

  • Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

We’re excited to get to know you and connect your unique skills with our global opportunities. To create a modern and seamless experience, we use artificial intelligence (AI) in parts of our preliminary screening process. This technology helps us personalize job recommendations, automate interview scheduling, evaluate candidates based solely on experience—without considering name, gender, or other personal details—and provide real-time answers through our chatbot. AI is used only during early screening and never makes hiring decisions. Your RGA recruiter will work closely with you every step of the way to ensure the process feels personal, thoughtful, and focused on you.

Compensation Range:

$107,060.00 - $159,390.00 Annual

Base pay varies depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and market location. In addition, RGA provides an annual bonus plan that includes all roles and some positions are eligible for participation in our long-term equity incentive plan. RGA also maintains a full range of health, retirement, and other employee benefits.

RGA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, gender identity or expression, sex, disability, veteran status, religion, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

jobs.excerpt: Position Summary Cardinal Health is seeking a visionary and strategic Solution Architect to join a high-growth business unit with visibility to Executive leadership.
jobs.description:
Position Summary


Cardinal Health is seeking a visionary and strategic Solution Architect to join a high-growth business unit with visibility to Executive leadership. This is a pivotal role where you will be at the forefront of technologically transformed landscape, shaping the future of our logistics, retail freight-pay, and audit solutions. We are in the final phase of modernizing our technology ecosystem, transitioning from a legacy landscape of .NET and Java microservices to a modern platform powdered by SAP BRIM, Salesforce, Java based portal solutions and Google Cloud (GCP) for business analytics.


As a Solution Architect, you will be more than a technologist, you will be a strategic partner and a trusted advisor, and key influencer across business and technology organizations. You will translate complex business processes into scalable, innovative, future-ready architectural solutions while driving business strategy, shaping product and technology roadmaps, assessing end-to-end process impacts, and guiding future-state architecture decisions.


Success in this role requires the ability to communicate complex technical concepts with clarity and impact, enabling informed decision-making among business leaders, external customers, and executive stakeholders. You will play a critical role in aligning technology investments with business objectives while driving modernization, innovation, and operational excellence across the portfolio.


Experience influencing senior stakeholders and presenting architectural strategies, technology investments, and transformation roadmaps to executive Leadership is essential for success in this role.


Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and own the end-to-end architectural vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and our long-term technology transformation.
  • Executive Communication: Simplify and present complex architectural concepts, technical-debt implications, and strategic roadmaps to executive leadership, business stakeholders, and external customers, ensuring clarity and buy-in.
  • Solution Design & Architecture: Lead the design and evolution of modern technology landscape, ensuring effective integration across SAP BRIM, Salesforce, .NET and Java-based applications, and GCP data and analytics platforms.
  • Customer & Partner Integration: Architect robust, scalable integration solutions enabling our healthcare partners to seamlessly connect their ERPs and pharmacy management systems with our retail freight offerings.
  • Technical Governance: Serve as the primary technical authority on the program, providing architectural guidance, quality assurance, and mentorship to project teams.
  • Innovation & Modernization: Champion an innovation mindset, continuously identifying opportunities for automation, process optimization, and technical debt reduction through strategic architectural decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work intimately with business product owners, technical leads, and enterprise architects to translate business strategy into technical requirements and architectural designs.
  • Business Process Insights: Develop a deep understanding of end-to-end business processes and data flows to assess impacts, identify challenges, and guide solution design across a complex application landscape.
  • Adoption of AI: Drive the adoption of AI and automation capabilities by identifying high-value use cases and integrating scalable, secure AI-enabled solutions into the overall technology roadmap.

Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTufin is standing up a governed, enterprise-scale AI program that spans ChatGPT, Claude, Workato eMCP, and a growing ecosystem of third-party AI applications.
jobs.description:
Description

Tufin is standing up a governed, enterprise-scale AI program that spans ChatGPT, Claude, Workato eMCP, and a growing ecosystem of third-party AI applications. The AI System Architect is the most senior technical role in this program — the person who defines the architecture, enforces the governance model, and owns the integration surface that every AI agent in the company operates through.

This role sits inside Enterprise Technology, reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Technology. That placement is intentional. The AI System Architect is not a researcher, a prompt engineer, or a standalone AI strategist — they are an enterprise systems leader who happens to be building at the frontier of agentic AI. They own the AI integration strategy across Tufin's core platforms (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, HiBob, Jira), the MCP governance model, the persona-scoped token design, and the integration patterns that connect AI capabilities to those systems without creating point-to-point dependency risk.

You will manage the AI Platform Engineer(s), set the technical standards for the AI Power User group's citizen development program, and serve as the connective tissue between business leadership, platform owners, and development teams. You will shape the multi-year AI architecture roadmap while also rolling up your sleeves to conduct architecture reviews, resolve blockers, and move use cases from concept to production. This is a role for someone who can think big and execute — and who understands that in an enterprise context, the quality of your governance is inseparable from the quality of your architecture.

What You'll Own

Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and own the enterprise AI integration strategy — identifying opportunities to embed intelligent automation, agentic workflows, predictive analytics, and generative AI capabilities across Tufin's core platforms
  • Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and the AI architecture decision log that governs how AI models connect to enterprise systems and what they are permitted to do
  • Consult on enterprise system architecture and implement best practices for the Enterprise Business Systems team to leverage in their day-to-day execution.
  • Lead Proof-of-Concept initiatives for new AI tools and platform-native AI features, evaluating them against build-vs-buy criteria before recommending adoption
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate operational pain points into AI use cases with clear ROI framing and sequencing criteria
  • Contribute to Tufin's enterprise data strategy, ensuring AI initiatives are supported by clean, accessible, and well-governed data pipelines

Integration Architecture & Delivery

  • Design and own the Workato eMCP layer — the MCP governance model, persona-scoped token framework, workspace isolation strategy, and the single sanctioned action surface through which all AI agents write back to enterprise systems
  • Define integration patterns and standards for AI model connectivity (Claude, ChatGPT) to Salesforce, NetSuite, HiBob, and Jira — specifying what agents can read, what they can write, through which surfaces, and with what confirmation and audit requirements
  • Design and oversee API strategies, event-driven architectures, and middleware patterns that support scalable AI feature delivery — including agentic workflows, intelligent data transformation, anomaly detection, and natural language interfaces layered onto ERP and CRM data
  • Collaborate with Engineering during build phases, conducting architecture reviews, providing hands-on guidance, and resolving complex technical blockers
  • Define non-functional requirements — latency, security, auditability, model drift monitoring — for AI components embedded in mission-critical business processes
  • Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices appropriate for Tufin's enterprise environment: model versioning, observability, and rollback procedures for production AI workloads

Governance & Risk

  • Translate Tufin's AI governance framework into enforceable runtime controls: confirmation gates, role-scoped permissions, audit trails, and rate limiting across all production agents
  • Own the AI intake process — the structured gate through which new AI use cases, agent deployments, and integration requests are reviewed, approved, and sequenced
  • Lead AI impact assessments for enterprise use cases, accounting for data privacy, regulatory compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, and applicable industry mandates), and responsible AI principles
  • Partner with Tufin's Security and Compliance teams and AI Governance Committee to define guardrails for agents operating with write access to critical systems — including human-in-the-loop checkpoints and audit trail requirements
  • Define the promotion criteria that citizen-built recipes must meet before the AI Platform Engineer can approve them for production, and hold that bar consistently across all value streams
  • Monitor for shadow AI and unauthorized usage — and treat its presence as an architectural signal, not just a policy violation

Team Leadership & Citizen Development

  • Manage and mentor the AI Platform Engineer(s) — setting technical direction, reviewing their work, and creating space for them to grow into the program's complexity
  • Set the technical standards and guardrails for the AI Power User group's citizen development program — defining what Power Users can build, on which platforms, with what approvals required before production promotion
  • Run architectural reviews for high-complexity citizen-built workflows and serve as the escalation point when the Platform Engineer identifies patterns outside established standards
  • Actively prevent shadow AI from taking root — not by blocking access, but by making the governed path so well-designed that it has no serious competition

Strategic Technical Leadership

  • Advise the Head of Enterprise Technology on AI integration strategy, platform evolution, and technology decisions as the enterprise AI tooling market continues to shift rapidly
  • Evaluate and recommend third-party AI tooling, LLM providers, and platform-native AI features — maintaining awareness of MCP ecosystem developments, Workato's AI platform roadmap, and the capabilities of the AI models Tufin has deployed
  • Maintain documentation standards and AI architecture protocols that satisfy both engineering teams and enterprise architecture review processes
  • Contribute to Tufin's AI governance framework as a living document, revising and extending it as new agent capabilities, regulatory signals, and organizational needs emerge

Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise solutions architecture, systems integration, or a closely related discipline — with a strong track record of designing and delivering production-grade integration platforms at scale
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Workato or a comparable enterprise iPaaS platform (MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services) — including workspace design, governance configuration, and operational management
  • Demonstrated experience building and integrating across CRM (Salesforce preferred), ERP (NetSuite preferred), and iPaaS platforms at the enterprise level — in production, not just proof-of-concept
  • Hands-on experience designing or deploying AI/ML features in production enterprise environments — including at least one of: agentic AI systems, LLM-powered workflows, predictive analytics, or intelligent document processing
  • Strong command of integration patterns: REST/GraphQL APIs, event streaming, ETL/ELT pipelines, webhook-based automation, and API security best practices
  • Experience designing and enforcing integration governance: access control models, audit logging, approval workflows, and token management
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or direct experience connecting AI models to enterprise systems in a production context
  • Proven ability to lead distributed technical teams and communicate architecture clearly to both executive sponsors and engineering teams — you can hold a technical standard without becoming a bottleneck
  • Experience with the requisite AI-related Audit Management frameworks (ISO42001, ISO27001, SOC 2, etc.)

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Workato's AI Hub and/or eMCP enterprise connector offerings
  • Experience with vector databases, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) architectures, or fine-tuning workflows in an enterprise data context
  • Working knowledge of AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act considerations), privacy controls, and secure SDLC practices
  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or enterprise platforms (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato)
  • Experience designing citizen development programs — defining guardrails, review processes, and promotion criteria for non-engineer builders
  • Background in network security, cybersecurity, or compliance-adjacent enterprise environments — familiarity with Tufin's domain is a meaningful advantage
  • Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, or manufacturing) where AI governance requirements are non-negotiable

How You Lead

  • You design for the long run — your architectures are opinionated enough to prevent sprawl and flexible enough to absorb what comes next
  • You govern by making the right path easy, not by making the wrong path hard — the best control is one that people follow because it serves them
  • You can hold a technical position in a room of non-technical executives and explain why it matters without losing either the nuance or the audience
  • You review other people's work with the same rigor you apply to your own — and you give feedback that makes people better, not just feedback that makes things compliant
  • You treat shadow AI as a design failure, not a user problem — if the governed path isn't being used, that's an architectural signal worth investigating
  • You think big and execute — strategy and hands-on delivery are not separate modes for you
  • You flag risks early, document decisions thoroughly, and operate with the understanding that the choices you make now will be someone else's production system for years

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionNous recrutons ! DiXiO s'est donné pour mission de simplifier et securiser le domaine de la messagerie financière.
jobs.description:
Description

Nous recrutons !

DiXiO s'est donné pour mission de simplifier et securiser le domaine de la messagerie financière. Dans le cadre de la croissance de notre pipeline clients, nous recherchons un(e) DevOps Engineer pour garantir la fiabilité et la sécurité de nos infrastructures cloud au service de la réussite de nos partenaires.

Pourquoi vous allez aimer travailler avec nous :

Si vous recherchez une organisation qui investit réellement dans votre carrière, ne cherchez plus. Nous mettons à la disposition de nos experts les outils et les ressources nécessaires pour concrétiser leurs aspirations professionnelles. De plus, nous opérons en 100 % télétravail, vous offrant la liberté de travailler d'où vous le souhaitez tout en évitant les contraintes des trajets quotidiens. Afin de garantir un équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée, notre équipe bénéficie également de jours de congés illimités.

À propos de DiXiO

DiXiO est une société d'experts SWIFT présente dans plus de 50 pays. Ces dernières années, DiXiO s'est imposée comme la référence dans le secteur de la messagerie financière et est officiellement agréée en tant qu'agent SWIFT. Aujourd'hui, DiXiO constitue le premier réseau mondial d'experts de confiance, rendant la messagerie financière simple et sécurisée grâce à des services spécialisés et des solutions cloud innovantes.

Requirements

1. Objectif du rôle

Renforcer l'équipe DevOps pour absorber la croissance du pipeline clients (déploiements, fiabilité, sécurité) et structurer le support IT interne. Le rôle repose sur une double dimension explicite : une dominance Infra/Cloud (70%) et une composante IT/Support (30%). Il s'agit d'un profil opérationnel autonome, capable de gérer des chantiers de bout en bout sans encadrement quotidien.

2. Responsabilités principales

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) : Maintenir et faire évoluer les modules Terraform sur une architecture multi-tenant (AWS). Garantir la documentation et la qualité des revues de code infra.
  • Opérations & Déploiements : Piloter le provisioning des nouveaux environnements clients et assurer la maintenance préventive/curative des clusters existants.
  • Sécurité & Compliance : Être le moteur technique de la mise en conformité ISO 27001 et SWIFT CSP. Mettre en œuvre la remédiation infra et préparer les audits sous l'impulsion du CISO.
  • Fiabilité & Run : Optimiser le monitoring, la gestion des backups (HA), le patching et la réduction des coûts cloud.
  • Gestion IT & Support (La part "30%") : Administrer l'Azure AD, gérer le parc de postes de travail (onboarding/offboarding technique) et assurer le support utilisateur quotidien avec pragmatisme.

3. Compétences attendues

  • Techniques : Maîtrise solide de la stack AWS, Terraform, Linux et de la gestion de clusters. Expertise sur les problématiques de haute disponibilité et de sauvegarde.
  • Approche : Posture "opérationnelle" : capacité à réfléchir avant d'agir, rigueur dans l'exécution et aucune frustration à passer du build (nouveaux projets) au run (maintenance/IT).
  • Compliance : Une expérience ou une forte sensibilité aux référentiels de sécurité est indispensable.

4. Plan de mission (30-60-90 jours)

  • 30 jours : Prise en main de l'architecture Terraform actuelle et gestion autonome de l'onboarding IT des nouveaux collaborateurs.
  • 60 jours : Participation active aux chantiers de remédiation ISO 27001 et exécution des premiers déploiements de nouveaux environnements clients.
  • 90 jours : Autonomie complète sur le périmètre infra, force de proposition sur l'optimisation du monitoring et de la stratégie de backup.

5. Ce que le rôle n'est PAS

  • Un rôle de "Lead" ou de pur "Architecte".
  • Un poste de pur "Sysadmin" traditionnel.
  • Un rôle où la partie support IT est déléguée (elle fait partie intégrante de la mission).

6. Pourquoi ce rôle est clé chez DiXiO

Dans un environnement Fintech où la sécurité est le produit, le DevOps est le garant de la confiance client. En stabilisant l'infrastructure et en fluidifiant l'IT interne, ce rôle permet à l'ensemble de l'équipe technique de se concentrer sur la création de valeur sans friction opérationnelle.

jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the USA EST time zones only.

Senior Software Engineer - Session Replay

The Opportunity:

The Session Replay squad is building a new Grafana Cloud product that helps our customers to understand what users actually experienced when something goes wrong.

Session Replay connects frontend signals (errors, performance, synthetic checks) to concrete session-level evidence, enabling faster and more confident investigation of production issues.

This team works at the intersection of:

  • frontend observability,
  • backend data processing and storage at scale,
  • debugging workflows across products,
  • privacy and access control,
  • performance and cost constraints at scale.

Session Replay is still early, which means you’ll help shape both what we build and how it fits into Grafana Cloud. A key part of our next phase is evolving the backend architecture of capturing sessions, including a migration toward columnar/analytical solution as a primary storage and query engine for high-volume session data.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Senior Software Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.

What You’ll Be Doing:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will operate as a technical leader and systems thinker, driving both product direction and architectural evolution, specifically, you will:

  • Own end-to-end technical direction for Session Replay, spanning frontend, backend, and data systems
  • Drive the evolution of our backend architecture, including:
    • Designing systems around columnar/analytical data storage for large-scale session data
    • Defining data models, ingestion pipelines, and query patterns
  • Lead the design of investigation workflows, connecting replay with logs, metrics, traces and other telemetry across Grafana Cloud
  • Make high-leverage architectural decisions that impact multiple teams and products
  • Partner with teams across Grafana (Frontend Observability, Synthetic Monitoring, Core Grafana) to build cohesive cross-product experiences
  • Engage directly with customers - joining calls, gathering structured feedback, and helping customers instrument and adopt Session Replay successfully.
  • Improve engineering standards, patterns, and operational practices within the team
  • Mentor engineers and help grow technical leadership within the team

Technologies you'll work with:

  • Go (backend services and APIs)
  • Columnar/Analytical data storage (core data storage and querying)
  • Object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage) and MySQL
  • TypeScript / React (user-facing workflows)
  • Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Tempo, etc.)

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first company; communication is key.
  • For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team’s decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.
  • Ability to reason about data-intensive systems (ingestion, storage, querying, cost trade-offs)
  • You are comfortable owning features in ambiguous problem spaces. We are a small team, working remotely, on a product that will be used by engineers all over the world – the ability to work on your own is crucial.
  • You have a good understanding of a software development process that takes a user-centered approach. You easily build an understanding of the users’ context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.
  • You enjoy working on complex solutions – Grafana is a highly technological solution and has avid followers who rely on it every day and who care deeply about their workflows. You value code maintainability, readability & automation.
  • You use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with columnar/analytical databases
  • Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.).
  • Experience building debugging or developer-focused tools.
  • Familiarity with privacy, security, and access control in data-heavy systems
  • Experience working on performance-sensitive systems (large datasets, real-time queries, session data)

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is USD 154,445- USD 185,334. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

jobs.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Hybrid Cloud Architect to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Hybrid Cloud Architect
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Experience: 8+ years
Salary - $100K – $150K
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Hybrid Cloud Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers — AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI — for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define multi-cloud strategy, target-state architecture, and adoption guardrails across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI as relevant.
  • Design federated identity, SSO, and cross-cloud authorization patterns that let workloads and engineers move between providers without compromising on least-privilege, auditability, or operational simplicity.
  • Architect cross-cloud networking including transit hubs, private connectivity, and zero-trust patterns.
  • Establish reusable infrastructure-as-code patterns that abstract cloud-specific implementations where appropriate.
  • Define container, Kubernetes, and serverless strategies that work consistently across providers.
  • Design data architecture strategies for cross-cloud data movement, residency, and analytics.
  • Drive multi-cloud observability, security monitoring, and unified policy enforcement, designing approaches that work consistently across providers and avoid the complexity of fragmented per-cloud tooling stacks.
  • Establish FinOps practices that operate consistently across multiple cloud providers.
  • Lead disaster recovery and business continuity strategies that span clouds.
  • Partner with security architects on multi-cloud security models, KMS strategies, and key management.
  • Provide guidance to engineering teams on when to use cloud-agnostic versus cloud-native patterns.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Engage with cloud providers and partners to evaluate roadmap alignment.
  • Stay current with multi-cloud platform and tooling developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in cloud architecture roles.
  • Hands-on architecture experience across at least two major cloud providers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security across multiple providers.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code across clouds.
  • Experience designing federated identity and SSO across cloud platforms.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container platforms, and managed cloud services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Multiple cloud certifications across providers.
  • Track record of leading multi-cloud architecture initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with abstraction platforms (Crossplane, Pulumi, Terraform CDK).
  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic observability platforms.
  • Experience driving large-scale cloud-to-cloud migrations.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with multi-cloud mandates.
  • Public talks or writing on multi-cloud architecture.
How to Apply

For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Every career journey is personal. That's why we empower you with the tools and support to create your own success story.

Be challenged. Be heard. Be valued. Be you ... be here.

Job Summary

The Staff Cyber Security Engineer is a senior individual contributor who will provide technical leadership in the design and advancement of cyber security solutions across complex environments. This role will lead cross-team security initiatives, influence architectural decisions, and address elevated security risks through deep technical expertise and collaboration.

Demonstrated expertise in AI Detection & Response (AIDR) and AI Security Posture Management (AISPM). Leads the design and implementation of security strategies for AI and machine learning ecosystems, including threat detection, model security, adversarial attack mitigation, and risk management. Proven ability to build scalable security programs that protect AI applications, data pipelines, and cloud environments while ensuring regulatory compliance and operational resilience.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design and implement resilient security controls across infrastructure, cloud, and application environments; address complex threat scenarios and incorporate emerging cybersecurity and technology trends. - (40%)

  • Lead security initiatives across multiple teams; provide technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to engineers and security practitioners. - (25%)

  • Leads investigation and response to complex security incidents; drive root cause analysis and long‑term risk remediation. - (15%)

  • Contribute to development and refinement of security standards, patterns, and controls aligned with risk and business objectives. - (10%)

  • Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and platform teams to embed security into system design and delivery. - (10%)

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering; or related field of study or equivalent, relevant work experience

  • 8+ years of experience working in cybersecurity, security operations, IAM, PAM, cyber defense, or related technical roles.

  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining security controls across infrastructure, cloud, and application environments.

  • Proven ability to lead complex technical work, operate independently, and influence security outcomes across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering; or related field of study or equivalent, relevant work experience

  • Possession of industry-recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, and/or cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security)

  • 2+ years of experience applying frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI Risk Management.

Skills

  • Artificial Intelligence Technologies

  • MITRE ATT&CK Framework

jobs.excerpt: Product DesignerAbout TetonOn a night shift, three carers can be responsible for a hundred residents, each behind a closed door.
jobs.description:
Product Designer

About Teton

On a night shift, three carers can be responsible for a hundred residents, each behind a closed door. Teton tells them what’s going on in every room, so they know who to check on first.

We put a sensor in the ceiling of each room: an infrared camera wired to a small computer. The computer turns what the sensor sees into facts, like who is in bed, how fast someone is breathing, or whether someone has fallen.

We train one model in our office and copy it to every device, so every site improves at once. Staff get the facts through a mobile app on the floor, a desktop app for leaders and planning, and a screen on the wall. Around that sits the service: installation, onboarding, training, and a support chat any member of staff can use.

Around 10,000 care staff use Teton in care homes and hospitals in the US, Denmark, the UK, and Switzerland. Many of the falls we help prevent come from staff seeing what’s going on and planning their shift around it, rather than from alarms.

The Role

You’ll design the apps care staff use every day, from the alarm a carer hears in the corridor to the overview a regional leader uses for every home they cover. You’ll report to Julius, who leads design, work alongside Balazs, our other product designer, and build directly with our engineers.

You’ll work with the AI team that trains our models and the engineers who run them at the edge, on what the models can see and how it reaches staff. Few product design jobs sit this close to the technology.

Most of our users are floor staff, and many are new or temporary. Most never go deeper into the app than reacting when something happens, so it can’t have a learning curve. A smaller group of leaders, nurses and physiotherapists dig into the data, and the same product has to serve both.

What you’ll work on:

  • Agency with oversight. Good results only come from staff actually engaging with the product. To do this you have to design a product that gives accountability and agency to staff, whilst still giving the oversight to the leadership. It's a tricky balance to create for each workflow.

  • The same facts at every level. A night carer can finish a shift thinking it went well, then hear from a manager about a problem that was only visible on an executive’s dashboard. Everyone has to have a shared understanding of a community and how its running, at the level of detail their job needs.

  • Health data people can read. We track sleep, breathing, movement and more for every resident, but most staff aren’t used to reading a respiration trend. The design challenge is making this information tractable and showing it in the right place at the right time.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years designing software people use daily, ideally a product that had to stay coherent as it grew.

  • Precision. You structure things well: information architecture, states, edge cases, components. You can say exactly what a design does and why.

  • You go and see. You’ll travel to customers in Denmark, the UK and the US, sometimes for a night shift. You look forward to it, and what you see changes your designs.

  • You learn how the technology works. Some things are hard for any sensor to tell apart, like a visitor and a member of staff. You find out where those limits are and design with them in mind.

  • You help define the problem. When a brief is unclear, you work it out with engineers and product instead of waiting, then pick what it needs: a site visit, a prototype, or just building it.

  • You prototype in code. We expect it, and beyond that you can work however you like. If you can also ship front-end work in React or our component library, even better.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

What It’s Like Working at Teton

We’re a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged — it’s expected. It’s a hands-on environment where you’ll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning.

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job – jump on board 😊

How to Apply

Please make sure to include a link to your portfolio or personal website in your application. We’d also love to see one project where something you observed first-hand changed what you designed.

jobs.excerpt: Managing twenty-five scheduler cells by hand does not scale, and we are not going to try.
jobs.description:
Managing twenty-five scheduler cells by hand does not scale, and we are not going to try. NVIDIA is building a config-as-code foundation for its EDA compute farm, and we need an automation engineer to own it end to end. You are joining at the point where this is still partially manual and inconsistently applied across cells. That is the interesting version of the problem — you will be migrating off partial systems and reconciling drift, not starting from a blank repository.

What you'll be doing:

  • Designing and owning the configuration schema for LSF cell deployment, so that a policy change is written once, reviewed, tested, and applied identically everywhere it belongs.

  • Building the deployment pipeline that takes scheduler configuration from merge to production across a federated estate, including staged rollout and rollback.

  • Eliminating configuration drift across cells, and building the tooling that keeps it eliminated.

  • Standing up the regression suite that lets us upgrade LSF on a schedule rather than on a dare.

  • Working alongside our LSF internals engineer to encode hard-won scheduler knowledge into templates and policy, so that expertise lives in the repository instead of in one person's head.

What we need to see:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • 6+ years in infrastructure engineering with strong config management depth — Ansible, Salt, Puppet, Chef, or comparable.

  • Real experience with GitOps practice at scale: review workflow, environment promotion, drift detection, and safe rollback.

  • Proficiency in Go, Python and shell, and comfort building the tooling rather than only using it.

  • Experience automating stateful, long-lived infrastructure where you cannot simply destroy and recreate.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • You have brought a manually administered estate under configuration management while it stayed in production.

  • Familiarity with LSF, Slurm, or another batch scheduler as a configuration target.

  • CI/CD experience for infrastructure, including test environments that meaningfully resemble production.

  • Observability instincts — you instrument what you automate.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. We are looking for an Associate Machine Learning Scientist with a strong foundation in machine learning and hands-on experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and related technologies.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are looking for an Associate Machine Learning Scientist with a strong foundation in machine learning and hands-on experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and related technologies. The ideal candidate is passionate about applying AI to solve high-impact societal challenges and has experience developing, adapting, and evaluating modern ML and LLM-based systems beyond prompt engineering and basic RAG pipelines. They should enjoy working in cross-functional teams, translating real-world problems into deployable AI solutions, and continuously learning from advances in the rapidly evolving LLM ecosystem.
  • As an Associate Machine Learning Scientist, you will build machine learning solutions to problems of societal importance under the guidance of senior ML scientists. You will participate in understanding stakeholder requirements, problem definition, model development, evaluation, and deployment of AI solutions, with a particular focus on LLMs and foundation models.
  • To apply machine learning and LLM technologies for social good, you will need to understand user challenges and their context, curate and transform data, adapt and evaluate models, design meaningful evaluation benchmarks, conduct experiments, and derive insights from data. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable AI systems and work closely with engineering, solutions, domain experts, and designers to ensure that solutions are technically sound and practically useful. You will also interact with social sector organisations and stakeholders to understand real-world needs and help ensure successful deployment of AI solutions.
  • You will be encouraged to stay current with advances in LLMs and foundation models, explore new techniques where appropriate, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the team's technical capabilities. Excellence as an individual contributor goes together with strong collaboration, curiosity, and a willingness to both learn from and share knowledge, ideas, and emerging practices with the team.

Requirements

  • Passion for applying AI and machine learning to solve large societal challenges.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline, with 1–4 years of relevant work or research experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience developing and applying machine learning models in an industry or research setting.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) or foundation models through industry projects, research, or significant open-source contributions.
  • Strong understanding of deep learning fundamentals, including Transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, and modern representation learning techniques.
  • Experience with one or more LLM adaptation techniques such as supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA/QLoRA), instruction tuning, preference optimization, retrieval-augmented systems, structured generation, or tool-using agents. Experience should extend beyond prompt engineering alone.
  • Experience designing and implementing evaluation methodologies for LLM systems, including benchmarking, model analysis, and iterative experimentation.
  • Solid software engineering skills in Python and experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, or equivalent.
  • Experience building end-to-end ML systems, including data preparation, experimentation, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Track record of applied machine learning projects addressing real-world problems. Experience applying LLMs to practical use cases is highly desirable.
  • Experience building and evaluating conversational or multi-turn AI systems is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity:Team Liquid is looking for a Business Analyst to help teams across the organization make better, data-informed decisions.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Team Liquid is looking for a Business Analyst to help teams across the organization make better, data-informed decisions.

In this role, you’ll work closely with teams across Sales & Partnerships, Talent Management, Athletics, Social Media, and our executive team to track performance, analyze data, and surface insights that support business decisions. You’ll contribute to reporting and measurement across projects and campaigns, including setting KPIs, CPMs, media value forecasts, and other performance targets.

You’ll also help improve how we collect, manage, and use data by developing dashboards, automating reporting and workflows, and identifying opportunities to leverage new tools and technologies, including AI.

The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable communicating insights and recommendations, and able to independently identify opportunities to improve how we use data across the organization.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Maintain tracking and measurement systems across partners and projects, ensuring relevant accounts, platforms, posts, videos, and other assets are actively monitored.

  • Create reports tailored to project and campaign KPIs, and continuously improve reporting processes with a focus on automation and efficiency.

  • Support teams with ad hoc data requests, such as information on past work or consumer insights, and provide actionable recommendations from planning through post-mortem stages.

  • Develop tools that make information easier to access and understand, including dashboards, web tools, and automated scripts.

  • Analyze micro- and macro-trends across the esports industry and communicate relevant findings to teams across the organization.

  • Improve and iterate on existing processes using new tools and technologies, including AI.

  • Contribute to the strategic direction of major campaigns by identifying learnings from previous initiatives and translating them into actionable insights.

  • Advise teams on key measurement and target-setting exercises, including KPIs, CPMs, media value forecasts, deliverable targets, and campaign goals.

  • Assist in developing and maintaining internal data repositories and managing data cleanliness and flow.

What You’ll Need:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Management, Economics, or a related field.

  • 1+ years of experience working in esports, gaming, streaming, or digital media.

  • Familiarity with data types and sources relevant to esports, including social media, streaming, and media value data.

  • Experience creating reports and presenting insights for executive, internal, and external partner audiences.

  • Strong knowledge of the gaming and esports ecosystem, including esports tournaments, streaming, social media, influencer marketing, and event management.

  • Ability to use AI tools, such as Claude or similar platforms, to create tools, scripts, or other solutions that automate or improve workflows.

  • Ability and willingness to learn new tools, platforms, APIs, and standards that support Team Liquid’s data ecosystem.

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Fluency in English.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively depending on project needs.

You'll Earn Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience with sponsorship measurement, including brand lift studies and media value measurement.

  • Experience using AI tools to develop efficient process solutions, including automation scripts and API-based workflows.

  • Familiarity with Team Liquid’s existing sponsors and the types of KPIs used to measure partnership performance.

  • Experience with Google Apps Script, Python, or Google Cloud.

  • Strong creative problem-solving skills, particularly when identifying opportunities to improve processes and workflows.

  • Availability during US or EU business hours.

This is a position with a PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) type of contract.
